zh.tag: 自改进的递归语言模型编程代理，支持长期自主任务
zh.what: Prime Agent 是一个开源的编码与研究代理，专为通用和长期运行的工作设计。它基于递归语言模型（RLM）和持续工作台（Continual Harness）两大核心抽象，将上下文视为变量，工具视为函数调用，在持久的 REPL 环境中运行。代理结合了持久化的 Python 控制环境和可持久化的工作台状态，使得有用的工作上下文和可复用的操作模式能够超越单个聊天窗口而存在。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理实现、文档（packages/coding-agent/docs）、CI 配置和构建脚本。代理支持程序化的一切操作，包括内置的持久化 IPython 工具、子代理调用（rlm(...)）、技能系统（可导入的 Python 包）以及后台守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Python 环境（IPython）作为模型工具，并与 verifiers、PRIME-RL 等 Prime Intellect 生态组件集成。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2293 星，总星数达 6510，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第一。其自改进的 RLM 架构和长期自主任务能力吸引了大量开发者关注，尤其是对 AI 代理工具链感兴趣的人群。
uses: 开发者：用于编码工作流自动化，如代码生成、重构和测试，可长期后台运行。
研究人员：作为研究代理，执行需要多步骤推理和工具调用的复杂任务。
AI 工程师：探索 RLM 和持续学习机制，构建自改进的代理系统。
团队协作：通过技能系统共享可复用的工作流，提升团队效率。

en.tag: A self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks.
en.what: Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent designed for general and long-running work. It is built around two core abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) treats context as variables and tools as function calls within a persistent REPL, and the Continual Harness stores supplemental prompts, memories, and skills as durable state. By combining a persistent Python control environment with durable harness state, it enables useful context and reusable patterns to outlive a single chat session.
en.content: The repository contains the core agent implementation, documentation (packages/coding-agent/docs), CI configuration, and build scripts. The agent supports programmatic everything, including a persistent IPython tool, subagent calls via rlm(...), a skill system with importable Python packages, and background daemon sessions.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, it relies on a Python environment (IPython) as the model tool and integrates with Prime Intellect ecosystem components like verifiers and PRIME-RL.
en.hot: With 2,293 stars added today and a total of 6,510, it ranks #1 on GitHub Trending daily. Its self-improving RLM architecture and capability for long-running autonomous tasks have attracted significant attention from developers interested in AI agent toolchains.
uses: Developers: Automate coding workflows like code generation, refactoring, and testing, with long-running background execution.
Researchers: Use as a research agent for complex tasks requiring multi-step reasoning and tool use.
AI engineers: Explore RLM and continual learning mechanisms to build self-improving agent systems.
Teams: Share reusable workflows via the skill system to boost productivity.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打包资深工程师工作流与质量门禁
zh.what: 这个仓库提供一套生产级工程技能，将资深工程师的流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为 AI 代理可遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发，覆盖从规格定义到发布的完整开发生命周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含 24 个技能，每个技能对应一个开发阶段或关注点（如代码审查、测试驱动开发、Web 性能审计），并提供 8 个斜杠命令（/spec、/plan、/build 等）来激活相应技能。还包含一个 CLI 安装工具，支持 70+ 代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，依赖 Vercel Labs 的 skills CLI（npx skills add）进行安装，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编码代理。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上获得 8.3 万星标，今日新增 593，位居趋势榜第二。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏工程纪律的痛点，将资深工程师的经验系统化，受到开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理进行开发的工程师，希望提升代码质量和一致性
团队想将内部最佳实践标准化并让代理自动遵循
对 AI 辅助开发流程感兴趣的技术管理者或架构师

en.tag: Packaging senior-engineer workflows and quality gates for AI coding agents
en.what: This repo provides production-grade engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices of senior engineers for AI agents to follow. It covers the full development lifecycle from spec to ship via slash commands and automatic triggers.
en.content: The repo contains 24 skills, each mapped to a development phase or concern (e.g., code review, TDD, web performance), and 8 slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, etc.) to activate them. It also includes a CLI installer supporting 70+ agents.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, relies on the Vercel Labs skills CLI (npx skills add) for installation, compatible with major AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
en.hot: With 83k stars and +593 today, ranking #2 on trending, it addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking engineering discipline by systematizing senior engineer experience, gaining wide attention.
uses: Engineers using AI coding agents who want to improve code quality and consistency
Teams looking to standardize internal best practices and have agents follow them automatically
Technical managers or architects interested in AI-assisted development workflows

zh.content: 仓库按学段和学科分类，如小学/数学/人教版等，包含各年级上下册PDF文件，并附有项目由来和学习数学的说明。
zh.stack: 主要文件为PDF，仓库使用Roff语言（可能用于README格式），依赖GitHub存储和分发。
zh.hot: 因其直接回应教育资源不平等问题，提供免费教材下载，迅速获得大量关注，star数已达77.9k，今日新增118。

海外华人：让孩子接触国内教材，保持母语和文化认同。
教育工作者：方便获取教材内容用于备课或研究。
公益人士：传播教育资源，促进教育公平。

en.tag: Free open-source PDF library of Chinese textbooks for all grades
en.what: This is an open-source repository collecting PDF textbooks for Chinese primary, middle, high school, and university subjects, aiming to break down barriers to educational resources, promote educational equity, and help overseas Chinese children stay connected with domestic education.
en.content: The repository is organized by level and subject, e.g., primary/math/People's Education Press, containing PDF files for each grade's volumes, along with project origin and math learning notes.
en.stack: Main files are PDFs; the repo uses Roff (likely for README formatting) and relies on GitHub for storage and distribution.
en.hot: It quickly gained attention by directly addressing educational resource inequality and offering free textbook downloads, amassing 77.9k stars with 118 new today.
uses: Students and parents: free access to official textbook PDFs for study or preview.
Overseas Chinese: expose children to domestic textbooks, maintaining language and cultural identity.
Educators: convenient access to textbook content for lesson planning or research.
Advocates: spread educational resources to promote equity.

zh.content: 仓库内包含多个技能目录，涵盖 Google Cloud 入门、多产品解决方案、AI/ML 平台管理等，每个技能以 Markdown 文件形式提供详细指南。

zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，开发者需要标准化的技能库来增强代理能力，Google 官方出品使其备受关注，star 数迅速增长。

en.tag: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
en.what: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, offering reusable skill modules that enable AI agents to perform cloud platform operations, solution architecture, and more. Skills can be installed via npx command with selective installation.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories covering Google Cloud onboarding, multi-product solutions, AI/ML platform management, etc., with each skill provided as detailed Markdown files.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, installed via npx, with skills written in Markdown.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agent capabilities, and Google's official offering has gained significant attention, leading to rapid star growth.
uses: Developers: Add Google Cloud operational skills to AI agents for quick cloud integration.
Solution architects: Use pre-built skill templates to design cloud architectures and data analytics workflows.
AI platform admins: Manage model deployment, tuning, and monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。

zh.hot: 凭借 18.6 万+ Star 和每日 2251 新增，该项目因解决 AI 编程中“真实工程”痛点而爆火，提供比 GSD、BMAD 等更可控、可定制的方案。

en.tag: AI agent skills for real engineers
en.what: A set of AI agent skills designed by a senior engineer for real engineering work, not vibe coding. It offers small, composable, and customizable skill modules that work with any model, installable via skills.sh or as a Claude Code plugin.
en.content: The repo contains multiple optional skill modules (e.g., /triage, /setup-matt-pocock-skills), a quick install script, and a Claude Code plugin configuration. Users select skills via npx and run a setup wizard to configure.

en.hot: With 186k+ stars and 2251 daily additions, this project exploded by addressing the pain point of 'real engineering' in AI coding, offering a more controllable and customizable alternative to GSD, BMAD, etc.

AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控身份认证基础设施的个人或团队。
中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架
zh.what: TradingAgents 是一个基于多智能体 LLM 的金融交易框架，模拟真实交易公司中分析师、研究员、交易员和风险管理者的协作流程。它利用多个 LLM 代理进行市场分析、交易决策和风险管理，旨在提供更稳健和透明的交易策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、示例配置、文档和测试，支持多种数据供应商（如 Alpha Vantage、FRED、Polymarket）和 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Groq）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 LangChain 等 LLM 编排库，支持 OpenAI 兼容 API 和多种模型提供商。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上获得 96k+ 星标，因其将多智能体 LLM 应用于金融交易这一热门领域，且持续更新，吸引了大量开发者和量化交易爱好者。
uses: 量化交易研究者：探索 LLM 驱动的交易策略和风险管理。
AI 开发者：学习多智能体系统在金融领域的应用。
金融科技爱好者：评估 AI 在真实交易场景中的潜力。

en.tag: Multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading
en.what: TradingAgents is a multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading that simulates the collaborative workflow of analysts, researchers, traders, and risk managers in a real trading firm. It leverages multiple LLM agents for market analysis, trade decision-making, and risk management, aiming to provide more robust and transparent trading strategies.
en.content: The repository includes complete framework code, example configurations, documentation, and tests, supporting multiple data vendors (e.g., Alpha Vantage, FRED, Polymarket) and LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, NVIDIA, Groq).
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging LangChain and other LLM orchestration libraries, with support for OpenAI-compatible APIs and multiple model providers.
en.hot: With 96k+ stars, this repo is hot because it applies multi-agent LLMs to financial trading, a trending domain, and its continuous updates attract developers and quant trading enthusiasts.
uses: Quant researchers exploring LLM-driven trading strategies and risk management.
AI developers learning multi-agent systems in finance.
Fintech enthusiasts evaluating AI's potential in real trading scenarios.

zh.tag: Google 核心 Java 库，集合、并发、I/O 等工具集
zh.what: Guava 是 Google 提供的一组核心 Java 库，包含新的集合类型（如 multimap 和 multiset）、不可变集合、图库，以及并发、I/O、哈希、基本类型、字符串等工具。它被 Google 内部大多数 Java 项目广泛使用，也被许多其他公司采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Guava 的源代码、构建配置（Maven/Gradle）、文档和示例，分为 JRE 和 Android 两个版本，支持通过 Maven 或 Gradle 依赖引入。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，支持 JDK 1.8+，提供 JRE 和 Android 两种 flavor，使用 Maven 和 Gradle 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Java 开发的事实标准库，Guava 拥有超过 5.1 万 star，今日新增 13 个，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Java 开发者：在日常项目中简化集合、并发和 I/O 操作
Android 开发者：使用 Android flavor 获得兼容支持
库作者：利用 Guava 的工具类提高代码质量和效率

en.tag: Google core Java libraries: collections, concurrency, I/O, and more
en.what: Guava is a set of core Java libraries from Google that includes new collection types (such as multimap and multiset), immutable collections, a graph library, and utilities for concurrency, I/O, hashing, primitives, strings, and more. It is widely used in most Java projects at Google and by many other companies.
en.content: The repository contains Guava's source code, build configuration (Maven/Gradle), documentation, and examples, with two flavors: JRE and Android, and can be added via Maven or Gradle dependencies.
en.stack: Developed in Java, requires JDK 1.8+, offers JRE and Android flavors, built with Maven and Gradle.
en.hot: As a de facto standard library for Java development, Guava has over 51k stars, with 13 new stars today, remaining popular among developers.
uses: Java developers: simplify collections, concurrency, and I/O in daily projects
Android developers: use the Android flavor for compatibility
Library authors: leverage Guava's utilities to improve code quality and efficiency

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 运行时
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects。每个对象都是一个独立的 SQLite 数据库，按名称寻址，并复制到你拥有的 S3 兼容存储桶中；节点仅通过该存储桶协调，无需控制平面或共识。
zh.content: 仓库包含 celld 的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置以及文档。它嵌入 V8 引擎执行 Wrangler 构建的 Worker 包，并通过 S3 存储桶实现状态复制和所有权协调。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 V8 引擎和 S3 兼容对象存储（如 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2）。使用 esbuild 打包 Worker 项目。
zh.hot: 今日新增 516 星，总星数 2202，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。它解决了分布式 Durable Objects 的痛点，通过去中心化设计简化了部署和运维。
uses: 希望在自有基础设施上运行 Cloudflare Workers 的开发者
需要分布式持久化状态且不想依赖云厂商锁定的团队
对边缘计算和 Durable Objects 感兴趣的研究者
寻求低成本、可扩展的分布式应用架构的架构师

en.tag: Self-hosted distributed Durable Objects runtime
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database, addressed by name and replicated to an S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with no control plane or consensus.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source code, installation scripts, Docker image config, and docs. It embeds V8 to execute Wrangler bundles and coordinates state and ownership via an S3 bucket.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging V8 and S3-compatible object storage (e.g., AWS S3, Cloudflare R2). Uses esbuild for bundling Worker projects.

zh.tag: 法律AI代理基准测试，评估真实法律任务能力
zh.what: Harvey LAB 是一个开源基准测试，用于评估 LLM 代理在真实法律工作环境中的能力。它包含一个任务数据集（包含指令、文档和评分标准）以及一个执行框架，用于运行和评估代理。该项目旨在推动法律领域 AI 代理的发展。
zh.content: 仓库包含任务数据集（覆盖 24+ 法律实践领域，共 1671 个任务）、执行框架（支持模型适配器、工具、报告和扫描）、文档（教程、架构、评估方法）以及贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 LLM 推理（如 OpenAI API），可能涉及数据验证（GitHub Actions）和报告生成。
zh.hot: 今日新增 47 星，总星数 666，登上 GitHub Trending（Python 日榜第 11）。作为首个法律领域开源代理基准，填补了空白，吸引法律科技和 AI 社区关注。
uses: AI 研究人员：评估和比较不同 LLM 代理在法律任务上的表现
法律科技公司：测试自家代理在法律场景中的能力，优化产品
法律从业者：了解 AI 代理在真实法律工作中的潜力与局限
开源贡献者：参与任务集扩充、模型适配器开发或文档改进

en.tag: Open-source benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on real legal work
en.what: Harvey LAB is an open-source benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to perform legal work in realistic environments. It consists of a dataset of tasks with instructions, documents, and rubrics, plus an execution harness for running and evaluating agents. The project aims to advance AI agents in the legal domain.
en.content: The repo contains a task dataset (covering 24+ legal practice areas, 1671 tasks), an execution harness (with model adapters, tools, reports, and sweeps), documentation (tutorial, architecture, evaluation methodology), and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relies on LLM inference (e.g., OpenAI API), may involve data validation (GitHub Actions) and report generation.
en.hot: Gained 47 stars today, total 666, trending on GitHub (Python daily #11). As the first open-source legal agent benchmark, it fills a gap, attracting legal tech and AI communities.
uses: AI researchers: evaluate and compare LLM agents on legal tasks
Legal tech companies: test their agents' capabilities in legal scenarios and improve products
Legal professionals: understand the potential and limitations of AI agents in real legal work
Open-source contributors: expand task set, develop model adapters, or improve docs

zh.tag: 为自主AI智能体提供策略执行、零信任身份、沙箱与可靠性保障的治理工具包
zh.what: 这是一个由微软推出的AI智能体治理工具包，帮助开发者将自主AI智能体安全地部署到生产环境。它提供策略执行、零信任身份验证、执行沙箱和可靠性工程等功能，覆盖OWASP Agentic Top 10的全部10项风险。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文档、快速入门指南、规范说明、变更日志，以及Python包（PyPI）和多种SDK（npm、NuGet）。支持多语言（英文、日文、简体中文、韩文），并提供架构合规文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为Python，提供pip安装的Python包，同时支持npm和NuGet的SDK。依赖包括策略引擎、身份验证、沙箱技术等，与框架无关。
zh.hot: 随着AI智能体在生产环境中的普及，治理和安全成为刚需。该工具包由微软推出，覆盖OWASP Agentic Top 10全部风险，上线即获得5801星，今日新增56星，位列GitHub Trending日榜Python第12名。
uses: 开发自主AI智能体的团队，需要确保合规和安全
平台工程师，需要为智能体提供统一的治理层
安全工程师，关注智能体风险缓解和策略执行
企业用户，希望将AI智能体安全部署到生产环境

en.tag: Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, sandboxing, and reliability for autonomous AI agents
en.what: A toolkit by Microsoft for governing autonomous AI agents, enabling safe production deployment. It provides policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and reliability engineering, covering all 10 items of the OWASP Agentic Top 10.
en.content: The repo includes full documentation, quick start guide, specifications, changelog, Python package (PyPI), and SDKs for npm and NuGet. Multi-language support (English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean) and compliance architecture docs are provided.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, with a pip-installable package and SDKs for npm and NuGet. Dependencies include policy engine, identity, sandboxing, and is framework-agnostic.
en.hot: As AI agents proliferate in production, governance and security are critical. Backed by Microsoft and covering all OWASP Agentic Top 10 risks, it gained 5801 stars with 56 new today, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (Python) daily.
uses: Teams developing autonomous AI agents needing compliance and safety
Platform engineers requiring a unified governance layer for agents
Security engineers focusing on agent risk mitigation and policy enforcement
Enterprises aiming to deploy AI agents to production securely

zh.tag: 为长期运行的 AI 代理团队打造的轻量级循环工程状态内核
zh.what: LoopX 是一个本地优先的控制平面，用于管理长期运行的 AI 代理工作。它保持目标、门禁、待办事项、证据、配额和交接的稳定，而 Codex、Claude Code 等代理执行有界回合。它不替代代理运行时，而是提供可审查、可重启、易于交接的循环工程。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心状态内核、控制平面看板、文档（包括概念入门、产品发布就绪度）、示例循环、以及 Python 包（pyproject.toml）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python（3.11+），依赖包括用于状态管理的库，可能涉及异步处理，但具体依赖未列出。
zh.hot: 今日新增 847 星，总星数 2944，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。它解决了 AI 代理长期运行中的关键痛点，如目标漂移、证据过期和交接困难，因此受到关注。
uses: 开发者和团队使用 Codex、Claude Code 等编码代理进行长期项目，需要管理目标和进度。
需要将多个代理的工作进行交接和协作的团队。
对代理工作流进行监控、复盘和持续改进的工程管理者。
希望在不更换代理运行时的情况下，增加控制层和可审计性的用户。

en.tag: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams
en.what: LoopX is a local-first control plane for managing long-running AI agent work. It keeps objectives, gates, todos, evidence, quota, and handoffs stable while agents like Codex or Claude Code execute bounded turns. It doesn't replace agent runtimes but provides reviewable, restartable, and handoff-friendly loop engineering.
en.content: The repo includes the core state kernel, control-plane board, docs (concept primer, release readiness), example loops, and a Python package (pyproject.toml).
en.stack: Primary language is Python (3.11+), with dependencies for state management, possibly async, but specifics not listed.
en.hot: Gained 847 stars today, total 2944, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses critical pain points in long-running AI agent work like objective drift, stale evidence, and handoff difficulties, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers and teams using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code for long-running projects needing goal and progress management.
Teams that need to hand off work between multiple agents or peers.
Engineering managers who want to monitor, review, and continuously improve agent workflows.
Users who want to add a control layer and auditability without replacing their agent runtime.

zh.tag: 用 Claude 自动审查 PR 代码安全漏洞的 GitHub Action
zh.what: 这是一个基于 Claude 的 GitHub Action，自动分析代码变更中的安全漏洞。它利用 Claude 的深度语义理解，提供上下文感知的安全分析，并在 PR 上留下评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Action 的源码、配置文档和示例工作流。核心是一个 Python 脚本，调用 Claude Code 进行 diff 分析，并支持 PR 评论、结果上传、目录排除等配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 GitHub Actions 环境、Claude API 和 Claude Code 工具。
zh.hot: 由 Anthropic 官方发布，将 AI 安全审查集成到 CI/CD 流程中，star 数达 5.8k，今日新增 27，登上 Python 趋势榜。
uses: 开发团队：在 PR 合并前自动检查安全漏洞，减少人工审查负担。
安全工程师：快速获取 AI 辅助的漏洞分析，提高代码安全性。
开源维护者：为外部贡献的 PR 提供额外的安全审查层。

en.tag: AI-powered GitHub Action for security review of PRs using Claude
en.what: This is a GitHub Action that uses Claude to automatically analyze code changes for security vulnerabilities. It leverages Claude's deep semantic understanding to provide context-aware security analysis and leaves comments on pull requests.
en.content: The repository contains the Action's source code, configuration docs, and example workflows. The core is a Python script that invokes Claude Code for diff analysis, with options for PR comments, result uploads, directory exclusions, and more.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on GitHub Actions, the Claude API, and the Claude Code tool.
en.hot: Officially released by Anthropic, integrating AI security review into CI/CD pipelines. With 5.8k stars and 27 new today, it's trending on the Python daily list.
uses: Development teams: automatically check for security vulnerabilities before merging PRs, reducing manual review burden.
Security engineers: quickly get AI-assisted vulnerability analysis to improve code security.
Open-source maintainers: add an extra security review layer for external contributor PRs.

zh.tag: Claude Code 的通用 SEO 技能包，含 25 个子技能与 18 个专家代理
zh.what: 这是一个为 Claude Code 设计的开源 SEO 分析插件，可并行运行 25 个子技能和 18 个专家代理，覆盖技术 SEO、内容质量（E-E-A-T）、Schema.org 标记、AI 搜索优化（GEO）、本地 SEO、电商和国际 SEO。每次审计都会生成优先行动计划，并附有基于 Google 官方指南的可测试建议。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、子代理配置、测试套件（410 个通过测试）、示例资产（如封面图、增长图表）以及文档。还提供可选的 DataForSEO、Firecrawl 和 Banana 扩展。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，依赖 Claude Code 环境，可选集成 DataForSEO、Firecrawl 和 Banana 等外部服务。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2943 星，总星数达 13527，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 17 名。其 AI 搜索优先的方法论和并行执行能力在 SEO 社区引发关注。
uses: SEO 专业人士：快速进行全面的网站审计，生成可操作的优化建议。
内容创作者：提升内容的 E-E-A-T 和 AI 搜索可见性。
开发者：集成到 Claude Code 工作流，实现自动化 SEO 分析。
营销团队：利用本地 SEO、地图智能和电商 SEO 功能优化多站点。

en.tag: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code: 25 sub-skills + 18 sub-agents for technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, backlinks, local SEO, maps, semantic clustering, e-commerce, international SEO, Google APIs, and PDF/Excel reporting.
en.what: An open-source SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code that runs 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents in parallel across technical SEO, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org markup, AI search optimization (GEO), local SEO, e-commerce, and international SEO. Every audit produces a prioritized action plan with testable recommendations grounded in Google's primary-source guidance.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, sub-agent configurations, a test suite (410 passing tests), example assets (cover, growth charts), and documentation. Optional extensions for DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana are included.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on Claude Code, with optional integrations for DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana.
en.hot: Gained 2,943 stars this month, reaching 13,527 total, ranking #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its AI-search-first methodology and parallel execution capability have sparked interest in the SEO community.
uses: SEO professionals: conduct comprehensive site audits and get actionable recommendations quickly.
Content creators: improve E-E-A-T and AI search visibility of their content.
Developers: integrate into Claude Code workflows for automated SEO analysis.
Marketing teams: leverage local SEO, maps intelligence, and e-commerce SEO for multi-site optimization.

zh.tag: 微软开源前沿语音 AI，统一 TTS 与 ASR
zh.what: VibeVoice 是微软推出的开源语音 AI 项目，涵盖语音识别（ASR）和语音合成（TTS）两大核心能力。其 ASR 模型支持超长音频（60分钟）单次处理，输出结构化转录（说话人、时间戳、内容），并支持 50 多种语言；TTS 模型则提供流式合成能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、推理引擎（如 VibeASR.cpp）、微调代码、Colab 演示、文档及 Hugging Face 模型集合。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers、Gradio、Colab 等；ASR 推理引擎使用 C++（VibeASR.cpp）并支持异构量化（I8_S + I2_S）。
zh.hot: 微软背书、开源前沿语音模型，支持超长音频与多语言，且提供边缘 CPU 推理，Star 数超 5.2 万，热度持续攀升。
uses: 语音识别开发者：需要高精度、多语言、长音频转录的 ASR 集成
边缘计算场景：在无 GPU 的 CPU 设备上实时运行语音识别
语音合成应用：需要流式 TTS 的聊天机器人或语音助手
研究人员：探索语音模型微调与量化技术

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source frontier voice AI, unifying TTS and ASR
en.what: VibeVoice is Microsoft's open-source voice AI project, covering automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS). Its ASR model handles long-form audio (up to 60 minutes) in a single pass, generating structured transcripts (speaker, timestamps, content) and supporting 50+ languages; the TTS model offers streaming synthesis.
en.content: The repository includes model code, inference engines (e.g., VibeASR.cpp), finetuning code, Colab demos, documentation, and Hugging Face model collections.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers, Gradio, and Colab; the ASR inference engine is C++ (VibeASR.cpp) with heterogeneous quantization (I8_S + I2_S).
en.hot: Backed by Microsoft, open-sourcing frontier voice models with long-form audio and multilingual support, plus edge CPU inference; 52K+ stars and rising.
uses: ASR developers needing high-accuracy, multilingual, long-form transcription
Edge computing scenarios running real-time ASR on CPU-only devices
TTS applications requiring streaming synthesis for chatbots or voice assistants
Researchers exploring finetuning and quantization of voice models

zh.tag: 面向 MCP 的本地代码智能图谱，让 AI 编码工具只读关键上下文
zh.what: code-review-graph 通过 Tree-sitter 解析代码库，构建持久的结构化代码地图并增量追踪变更。它作为 MCP 服务器运行，让 AI 编码助手在代码审阅或处理大型仓库时只获取真正相关的上下文，从而显著减少 token 消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具与 MCP 服务器实现，提供 build、install 等命令，并附带 benchmark 数据、GitHub Action 集成文档及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+ 开发，使用 Tree-sitter 进行代码解析，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 工具通信，支持 pip/pipx 安装。
zh.hot: 项目精准击中 AI 编程“token 燃烧”痛点，宣称在真实仓库中实现 38 倍至 528 倍的上下文压缩；凭借近 2 万星标与单日 74 星增速登上 Trending 前十，反映出开发者对低成本、高精度 AI 代码审阅的强烈需求。
uses: 使用 AI 编码助手（如 Cursor、Claude Code）的开发者 —— 降低代码审阅时的 token 消耗与等待时间
大型代码库维护者 —— 在 monorepo 或遗留项目中为 AI 提供精准、增量更新的代码上下文
追求数据隐私的团队 —— 通过 Local-first 架构在本地构建代码图谱，避免上传源码至云端
CI/CD 集成场景 —— 借助 GitHub Action 在自动化流程中嵌入智能代码审查

en.tag: Local-first code intelligence graph feeding AI tools precise context via MCP to cut tokens
en.what: It parses your codebase with Tree-sitter to build a persistent, structural code map and tracks changes incrementally. Serving as an MCP server, it feeds AI coding assistants only the relevant context during reviews or large-repo workflows, dramatically cutting token usage.
en.content: The repo ships a CLI tool and MCP server implementation with commands like build and install, plus benchmark data, GitHub Action integration docs, and multi-language READMEs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, it uses Tree-sitter for parsing and speaks to AI tools via the MCP protocol, installable through pip or pipx.
en.hot: It directly tackles the “token burn” pain point in AI coding, claiming 38×–528× context reduction on real repos; its nearly 20k stars and 74-star daily growth landed it on Trending Top 10, showing strong demand for low-cost, high-precision AI code reviews.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) — slash token costs and wait times during code reviews
Large codebase maintainers — serve AI precise, incrementally-updated context in monorepos or legacy projects
Privacy-conscious teams — keep code intelligence local and avoid uploading source code to the cloud
CI/CD integrators — embed smart code reviews into automation pipelines via the provided GitHub Action

zh.tag: 高吞吐、内存高效的 LLM 推理与服务引擎
zh.what: vLLM 是一个专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计的推理和服务引擎，旨在提供快速、易用的 LLM 部署体验。它通过 PagedAttention 等技术高效管理注意力键值内存，实现高吞吐量和低延迟的模型服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 vLLM 的核心源码、文档、示例和测试，支持多种模型架构和硬件平台，并提供 OpenAI 兼容的 API 服务器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 和 C++/CUDA，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers 等，支持多种量化方案和优化内核。
zh.hot: vLLM 凭借其卓越的性能和广泛的应用场景，在 GitHub 上获得了 88.5k 的星标，成为 LLM 推理领域最受欢迎的项目之一。
uses: 需要高效部署 LLM 的开发者，用于生产环境的推理服务
研究机构，用于大规模模型实验和基准测试
企业用户，需要 OpenAI 兼容 API 的私有化部署

en.tag: High-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
en.what: vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models (LLMs), designed to provide fast and easy deployment. It leverages techniques like PagedAttention to efficiently manage attention key-value memory, achieving high throughput and low latency.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code, documentation, examples, and tests for vLLM, supporting various model architectures and hardware platforms, and providing an OpenAI-compatible API server.
en.stack: Primarily Python and C++/CUDA, relying on PyTorch, Transformers, and supporting various quantization schemes and optimized kernels.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and wide applicability, vLLM has gained 88.5k stars on GitHub, making it one of the most popular projects in LLM inference.
uses: Developers needing efficient LLM deployment for production inference
Research institutions for large-scale model experiments and benchmarking
Enterprises requiring OpenAI-compatible API for private deployment

zh.tag: 统一商业协议，让 AI 代理与商家无缝交易
zh.what: UCP 是一个开放标准，旨在解决商业生态碎片化问题，为平台（如 AI 代理和应用）、商家、支付服务商和凭证提供商提供统一的通信语言和功能原语。它支持商家声明能力、促进安全结账、实现个性化购物体验，并原生支持 AI 代理自主完成交易。
zh.content: 仓库包含 UCP 的规范文档、概述、关键特性说明，以及相关讨论链接。主要形式是 Markdown 文档和规范文本，可能包含示例和架构说明。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，但作为规范仓库，技术栈以文档为主，可能涉及 JSON Schema 或类似格式来定义能力。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理购物兴起，UCP 提供了标准化的互操作层，解决定制集成痛点。3280 星表明开发者对代理式商业基础设施的强烈兴趣。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理能自主发现商家并完成购买
电商平台：需要与多种支付和凭证提供商无缝集成
商家：希望被 AI 代理自动发现并支持安全结账
支付服务商：希望提供符合标准的支付能力

en.tag: Open standard for interoperable, agentic commerce
en.what: UCP is an open standard addressing fragmented commerce by providing a common language and functional primitives for platforms (like AI agents and apps), businesses, PSPs, and CPs. It enables businesses to declare capabilities, facilitate secure checkout, offer personalized experiences, and is designed from the ground up for agentic commerce.
en.content: The repo contains the UCP specification, overview, key features, and links to discussions. It's primarily documentation in Markdown, with potential examples and architecture descriptions.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but as a spec repo, it's documentation-heavy, possibly using JSON Schema or similar for capability definitions.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agent shopping, UCP offers a standardized interoperability layer, addressing custom integration pain points. 3.28k stars indicate strong developer interest in agentic commerce infrastructure.
uses: AI agent developers: enabling agents to autonomously discover merchants and complete purchases
E-commerce platforms: needing seamless integration with various PSPs and CPs
Merchants: wanting to be discoverable by AI agents and support secure checkout
Payment service providers: offering standardized payment capabilities

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.

zh.tag: 免费开源的 AI 图像与视频生成工作室
zh.what: 这是一个开源的 AI 图像和视频生成平台，提供 500 多种模型（如 Flux、Midjourney、Kling、Sora、Veo），无内容过滤，可自托管，采用 MIT 许可证。它旨在作为商业 AI 视频平台的免费替代品，用户无需订阅即可使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个完整的 Web 应用，集成 14 个工作室（图像、视频、音频等），支持白标转售功能，并提供 MuAPI 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，可能涉及 Node.js、React 等前端技术，以及 MuAPI 作为模型 API 后端。
zh.hot: 凭借免费、开源、无过滤的特性，吸引了大量对 AI 生成感兴趣的用户，25.8k 星标表明其受欢迎程度，今日新增 83 星，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜。
uses: AI 创作者：免费生成图像和视频，无需付费订阅
开发者：自托管或二次开发，集成到自己的应用
创业者：利用白标功能快速推出自己的 AI 工作室并收费

en.tag: Free open-source AI image & video generation studio
en.what: An open-source AI image and video generation platform offering 500+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo) with no content filters. Self-hosted and MIT licensed, it serves as a free alternative to commercial AI video platforms without subscription fees.
en.content: The repo contains a full web app with 14 studios (image, video, audio, etc.), white-label reselling capability, and MuAPI integration.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely with Node.js and React for frontend, and MuAPI as the model API backend.
en.hot: Its free, open-source, and unfiltered nature attracts many AI generation enthusiasts; 25.8k stars show popularity, with 83 new stars today, ranking #10 on JavaScript trending.
uses: AI creators: generate images/videos for free without subscriptions
Developers: self-host or customize for integration
Entrepreneurs: use white-label to launch branded AI studio and charge users

zh.tag: 模块化 SenseNova 技能，构建 AI 办公助手与效率工作流
zh.what: 该仓库提供一系列模块化的 SenseNova 技能，用于构建 AI 驱动的办公助手和生产力工作流。每个技能独立目录，通过 SKILL.md 声明触发条件、能力和执行流程，可单独使用或组合成端到端工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含图像生成与可视化、幻灯片（PPT）生成、Excel 数据分析、深度研究等技能，并附有示例画廊和文档。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，遵循 Agent Skills 约定，可接入 OpenClaw 和 hermes-agent 等代理运行时。
zh.hot: 近 5 千星标，今日新增 29，登上 JavaScript 日榜第 11 名，因其提供即用型办公技能并集成到 Raccoon 产品，降低 AI 办公助手开发门槛。
uses: 开发者：快速构建 AI 办公助手，无需从零开发技能。
办公自动化：集成到工作流中实现 PPT 生成、Excel 分析、深度研究。
产品集成：通过 Raccoon 直接使用，无需配置环境。

en.tag: Modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows
en.what: This repository provides a collection of modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows. Each skill lives in its own directory and declares triggers, capabilities, and execution flow via a SKILL.md file, usable standalone or composed into end-to-end workflows.
en.content: The repo includes skills for image generation & visualization, slide-deck (PPT) generation, Excel data analysis, and deep research, along with an example gallery and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, following the Agent Skills convention, plugging into agent runtimes like OpenClaw and hermes-agent.
en.hot: With nearly 5k stars and 29 added today, ranking #11 on the JavaScript daily trending, it's hot for offering ready-to-use office skills and integration into the Raccoon product, lowering the barrier to building AI office assistants.
uses: Developers: quickly build AI office assistants without building skills from scratch.
Office automation: integrate into workflows for PPT generation, Excel analysis, deep research.
Product integration: use directly via Raccoon without environment setup.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，支持 DWG/DXF 与 GPU 渲染
zh.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) 是一个用 Rust 编写的 CAD 应用，用于 2D 制图和 3D 建模。它原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，并提供 GPU 加速渲染，还推出了可在浏览器中运行的 Web 版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 功能集：2D 绘图命令（LINE、CIRCLE、HATCH 等）、3D 建模（EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、LOFT 等）、标注与尺寸、图纸空间布局，以及 DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF 等文件格式支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPU 加速渲染（可能通过 wgpu 或类似库），并支持编译为 WebAssembly 以提供 Web 版本。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 194 星，总星数达 577，登上 Rust 语言日榜第 2。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现专业级 CAD 功能，且提供 Web 版，吸引开发者关注。
uses: CAD 爱好者或专业人士，希望使用开源、跨平台的 2D/3D 设计工具
Rust 开发者，对图形编程、CAD 内核或 WebAssembly 感兴趣
需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件的工程师或设计师，寻找免费替代方案
教育场景，用于学习 CAD 概念或 Rust 在复杂应用中的实践

en.tag: An open-source CAD application built with Rust, supporting DWG/DXF and GPU-accelerated rendering
en.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) is a CAD application written in Rust for 2D drafting and 3D modeling. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files, offers GPU-accelerated rendering, and also has a web version that runs in the browser.
en.content: The repository includes a full-featured CAD suite: 2D drafting commands (LINE, CIRCLE, HATCH, etc.), 3D modeling (EXTRUDE, REVOLVE, LOFT, etc.), annotations and dimensions, paper space layouts, and support for file formats like DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, leveraging GPU-accelerated rendering (likely via wgpu or similar), and compiles to WebAssembly for the web version.
en.hot: It's gaining rapid traction on GitHub, with 194 stars added today and a total of 577, ranking #2 on the Rust daily trending list. Its appeal lies in delivering professional CAD features in Rust with a web version, drawing developer attention.
uses: CAD enthusiasts or professionals seeking an open-source, cross-platform 2D/3D design tool
Rust developers interested in graphics programming, CAD kernels, or WebAssembly
Engineers or designers who need to work with DWG/DXF files and want a free alternative
Educational use, to learn CAD concepts or Rust in complex applications

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写 Postgres，性能超越原版与 ClickHouse
zh.what: pgrust 是 Postgres 的 Rust 重写版本，旨在展示如果 Postgres 在 2026 年构建会是什么样子。它与 Postgres 完全兼容（包括 wire 协议和 SQL 方言），并通过了 Postgres 的全部 46,066 个回归测试。它引入了向量化执行、JIT 编译、线程并发模型和内置 OOM killer 等新架构，性能优于 Postgres 和 ClickHouse。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码，实现了 Postgres 的核心功能，并附有回归测试套件、文档和在线试用链接。当前版本 v0.2，尚未生产就绪，但已通过全部回归测试。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，针对 Graviton4 进行优化，JIT 编译器仅支持 Graviton4。依赖包括 SIMD 指令集和向量化执行引擎。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 173 星，总星数达 4227，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。其宣称的性能超越和 100% 回归测试通过率吸引了大量关注。
uses: 对数据库内核感兴趣的开发者，想了解如何用 Rust 重写 Postgres 并优化性能
需要高性能分析查询的团队，可评估 pgrust 作为 Postgres 的替代方案
希望参与开源项目，为 Postgres 生态贡献 Rust 实现的开发者

en.tag: A Rust rewrite of Postgres that's faster than Postgres and ClickHouse
en.what: pgrust is a Rust rewrite of Postgres, aiming to show what Postgres would look like if built in 2026. It is wire and SQL dialect compatible with Postgres, passing all 46,066 regression tests. It introduces a vectorized push-based JIT-compiled executor, thread-based concurrency, a query scheduler, and a built-in OOM killer, making it faster than Postgres and ClickHouse.
en.content: The repo contains the full Rust source code implementing Postgres core features, along with a regression test suite, documentation, and a browser-based demo. Current version v0.2, not production-ready but passing all regression tests.
en.stack: Written in Rust, tuned for Graviton4, with JIT compiler targeting only Graviton4. Dependencies include SIMD instructions and a vectorized execution engine.
en.hot: The project gained rapid popularity on GitHub, with 173 stars today and 4,227 total, ranking #3 on the Rust trending list. Its claimed performance superiority and 100% regression test pass rate have attracted significant attention.
uses: Developers interested in database internals, to learn how to rewrite Postgres in Rust and optimize performance
Teams needing high-performance analytical queries, to evaluate pgrust as a Postgres alternative
Open-source contributors wanting to participate in a Rust implementation of Postgres

zh.tag: 面向云工作负载的 Rust 虚拟机监视器
zh.what: Cloud Hypervisor 是一个开源虚拟机监视器（VMM），运行在 KVM 或微软 Hypervisor 之上，专注于现代云工作负载。它支持 CPU、内存和设备热插拔，可运行 Linux 和 Windows 客户机，并通过 vhost-user 实现设备卸载，具有极小的内存占用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 VMM 实现，基于 Rust VMM 系列 crate，支持 x86-64 和 AArch64 架构（riscv64 实验性）。提供预编译二进制、包管理及从源码构建的指南，并包含详细的文档、状态和路线图。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 rust-vmm 项目，依赖 KVM 或 MSHV 作为底层虚拟化接口。
zh.hot: 该项目以安全性和极简设计著称，在云原生领域备受关注。今日新增 11 个 star，总星数达 6062，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 14 名。
uses: 云服务提供商：用于构建轻量级、安全的虚拟机运行时
边缘计算场景：需要低内存占用和快速启动的虚拟化
开发者和研究者：探索 Rust 在虚拟化领域的实践

en.tag: A Rust-based VMM for modern cloud workloads
en.what: Cloud Hypervisor is an open-source Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM) that runs on KVM or Microsoft Hypervisor, focusing on modern cloud workloads. It supports CPU, memory, and device hotplug, runs Linux and Windows guests, and offloads devices via vhost-user with a minimal footprint.
en.content: The repository contains a full VMM implementation built on Rust VMM crates, supporting x86-64 and AArch64 (riscv64 experimental). It provides pre-built binaries, packages, and build-from-source instructions, along with extensive documentation, status, and roadmap.
en.stack: Written in Rust, based on the rust-vmm project, leveraging KVM or MSHV as the underlying virtualization interface.
en.hot: Known for its security focus and minimal design, it's gaining traction in cloud-native circles. With 11 new stars today and 6,062 total, it ranks #14 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud providers: building lightweight, secure VM runtimes
Edge computing: virtualization with low memory footprint and fast boot
Developers and researchers: exploring Rust in virtualization

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理与协作应用的有状态工作负载原语
zh.what: Rivet 提供轻量级、长期运行的 Actor 进程，专为有状态工作负载设计。状态保存在内存中并自动持久化，每个代理、会话或用户可创建一个 Actor，内置工作流、队列和调度功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心运行时、TypeScript SDK（用于后端和客户端）、文档和示例。支持 WebSockets、工作流、队列和定时任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 TypeScript SDK，依赖 SQLite 或自带数据库进行持久化，支持全局边缘网络部署。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和协作应用的兴起，开发者需要简单可靠的有状态执行方案。Rivet 以 5961 颗星迅速走红，今日新增 111 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第五。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为每个代理创建独立 Actor，管理持久上下文和工具调用调度。
协作应用开发者：利用 WebSockets 实现实时双向通信和状态同步。
需要可靠异步处理的团队：使用内置队列和工作流简化任务编排。
追求成本效益的部署：利用自动休眠和缩容到零的特性节省资源。

en.tag: The primitive for stateful workloads, built for AI agents, collaborative apps, and durable execution.
en.what: Rivet provides lightweight, long-running Actor processes designed for stateful workloads. State lives in memory with automatic persistence, and you can create one Actor per agent, session, or user, with built-in workflows, queues, and scheduling.
en.content: The repository contains the core runtime implemented in Rust, TypeScript SDKs for backend and client, documentation, and examples. It supports WebSockets, workflows, queues, and scheduling.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, with TypeScript SDKs, uses SQLite or BYO database for persistence, and supports global edge network deployment.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and collaborative apps, developers need a simple and reliable solution for stateful execution. Rivet has gained traction with 5,961 stars, adding 111 today, ranking #5 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: create a dedicated Actor per agent to manage persistent context and schedule tool calls.
Collaborative app developers: leverage WebSockets for real-time bidirectional communication and state sync.
Teams needing reliable async processing: use built-in queues and workflows to simplify task orchestration.
Cost-conscious deployments: benefit from auto-hibernation and scale-to-zero to save resources.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 把每个任务变成可打开应用的桌面 AI 代理
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，它将代码代理的深度与通用任务能力相结合，不仅限于软件开发。它能为每个任务创建专属界面（如图表、看板、表单），并将对话绑定到该界面的实时状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心代理运行时、桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，桌面应用可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架，支持跨平台。依赖包括 MCP、Skills/Hooks 等定制机制，以及用于快速搜索的 flashgrep。
zh.hot: BitFun 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 19 颗星，总星数达 1496，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 10。其独特的 Agentic Mini Apps 概念和自托管多设备控制功能吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望使用 AI 代理进行编码、调试和代码审查，并享受桌面应用的便利。
办公人员：需要 AI 辅助研究、写作、制作演示文稿和会议记录。
技术爱好者：喜欢自托管服务，希望控制自己的数据和设备同步。
AI 应用开发者：希望基于 BitFun 构建自定义 Agent 和 Mini Apps。

en.tag: A desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that combines the depth of a code agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development. It creates a dedicated interface for each task—such as charts, boards, forms, or panels—and binds a conversation to that interface's live state.
en.content: The repository contains a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust, a polished desktop application for macOS/Windows/Linux, a Mini Apps framework, a self-hostable device-sync server, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: The primary language is Rust, with a desktop app likely built on Tauri or similar, supporting cross-platform. It leverages MCP, Skills/Hooks for customization, and flashgrep for fast search.
en.hot: BitFun is gaining traction on GitHub, with 19 new stars today and a total of 1496, ranking #10 on the Rust trending list. Its unique Agentic Mini Apps concept and self-hosted multi-device control are drawing developer attention.
uses: Developers: who want an AI agent for coding, debugging, and code review with a desktop app.
Office workers: needing AI assistance for research, writing, presentations, and meeting notes.
Tech enthusiasts: who prefer self-hosting and controlling their data and device sync.
AI app builders: looking to create custom agents and Mini Apps on top of BitFun.

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它强调极快的响应速度和流畅的多人实时协作体验，旨在让开发者“以思维的速度编码”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析，使用 cargo-about 管理开源许可证，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: 统一实时服务编排与观测平台
zh.what: iii 是一个实时服务编排与观测平台，旨在简化后端服务的组合、扩展和监控。它通过共享运行时将队列、定时任务、HTTP、状态、可观测性、代理和沙箱等集成到一个统一系统中，减少集成成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、命令行工具（iii worker add）、SDK（支持 npm、PyPI、crates.io）、Docker 镜像和 Console 控制台。提供 Agent Skills 和资源文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供多语言 SDK（JavaScript/TypeScript、Python、Rust），支持 Docker 部署，并集成 Workers 和 Agent Skills。
zh.hot: iii 以 18.5k stars 位居 Rust 趋势榜前列，因其简化微服务集成和实时观测的独特价值而受到关注。
uses: 后端开发者：快速搭建和扩展微服务，无需处理复杂集成。
DevOps 工程师：统一监控和观测所有服务，提升运维效率。
AI 应用开发者：利用内置的代理和沙箱功能构建智能服务。
技术团队：降低多服务集成成本，加速项目交付。

en.tag: Unified real-time service composition, extension, and observability platform
en.what: iii is a real-time service orchestration and observability platform that simplifies composing, extending, and monitoring backend services. It collapses queues, cron, HTTP, state, observability, agents, and sandboxes into one unified system via a shared runtime, reducing integration overhead.
en.content: The repository includes the core runtime, CLI tools (iii worker add), SDKs (npm, PyPI, crates.io), Docker images, and a Console. It also provides Agent Skills and resource documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with multi-language SDKs (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust), Docker deployment, and integration with Workers and Agent Skills.
en.hot: With 18.5k stars, iii ranks high on the Rust trending list, gaining attention for its unique value in simplifying microservice integration and real-time observability.
uses: Backend developers: quickly build and scale microservices without complex integrations.
DevOps engineers: unify monitoring and observability across services for better ops efficiency.
AI application developers: leverage built-in agents and sandboxes for intelligent services.
Tech teams: reduce integration costs and accelerate project delivery.

zh.tag: 为AI代理与编辑器打造的超快文件搜索库

zh.what: UpSnap 是一个基于 Web 的局域网唤醒（WOL）工具，允许用户通过浏览器远程开启网络中的设备。它支持定时任务、端口扫描、设备发现和自定义关机命令，并提供用户管理和多语言界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端（SvelteKit）、后端（Go）和 PocketBase 数据库，提供 Docker 镜像和二进制发布，支持多架构。
zh.stack: 技术栈：SvelteKit（前端）、Go（后端）、PocketBase（数据库/API），依赖 nmap 进行网络扫描。

uses: 家庭或小型办公室用户，希望通过网页远程唤醒电脑或服务器
自托管爱好者，喜欢用 Docker 部署自己的工具
需要定时开关机或监控设备状态的 IT 管理员

en.tag: Self-hosted Wake-on-LAN web app
en.what: UpSnap is a web-based Wake-on-LAN (WOL) tool that lets users power on devices on their network from a browser. It supports scheduled tasks, port pinging, network scanning, and custom shutdown commands, with user management and i18n.
en.content: The repo contains a SvelteKit frontend, a Go backend, and PocketBase, with Docker images and binaries for multiple architectures.
en.stack: Tech stack: SvelteKit (frontend), Go (backend), PocketBase (database/API), with nmap for network scanning.
en.hot: With a clean UI and robust features, UpSnap has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing over 6,100 stars and ranking #5 on today's Go trending list.

Self-hosting enthusiasts who prefer Docker deployment
IT admins needing scheduled power-on/off or device monitoring

zh.tag: Kubernetes 与 OpenShift 的 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作集群
zh.what: 这是一个实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的服务器，专为 Kubernetes 和 OpenShift 设计，允许 AI 助手（如 Claude）通过标准工具接口管理集群资源。它支持对任意资源的 CRUD 操作，以及 Pod、命名空间、事件、Helm、Tekton 等特定功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器源码，提供多种工具（如 list/get/delete pods、logs、exec、top、run、helm install/list/uninstall、tekton pipeline/task 操作），并支持自动检测 kubeconfig 变化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Kubernetes client-go 和 MCP Go SDK，同时提供 npm 和 PyPI 包，方便不同生态使用。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者希望 AI 能直接管理集群，该仓库正好填补了 Kubernetes 与 MCP 生态的空白，上线不久即获近 2 千星，今日新增 10 星。
uses: 开发者：让 AI 助手（如 Claude）通过自然语言执行 kubectl 操作，提高效率
平台工程师：将 MCP 服务器集成到内部工具，实现自动化运维
AI 应用开发者：构建能感知集群状态的智能代理，用于故障排查或部署

en.tag: MCP server for Kubernetes and OpenShift, enabling AI to operate clusters directly
en.what: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Kubernetes and OpenShift, enabling AI assistants to manage cluster resources through standard tool interfaces. It supports CRUD on any resource, plus Pod, namespace, events, Helm, and Tekton specific operations.
en.content: The repo contains Go source code for the MCP server, offering tools like list/get/delete pods, logs, exec, top, run, helm install/list/uninstall, and Tekton pipeline/task operations, with automatic kubeconfig change detection.
en.stack: Primarily Go, using Kubernetes client-go and MCP Go SDK, with npm and PyPI packages for different ecosystems.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants gain traction, developers want AI to manage clusters directly; this repo fills the gap between Kubernetes and MCP, quickly gaining ~1.9k stars with 10 new today.
uses: Developers: use AI assistants (e.g., Claude) to run kubectl operations via natural language, boosting productivity
Platform engineers: integrate the MCP server into internal tools for automated ops
AI app developers: build agents that understand cluster state for troubleshooting or deployment

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，提供统一的配置格式和命令行工具，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和出站方式。它旨在简化代理配置和管理，适用于各种网络环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 sing-box 的源代码、文档（位于 docs 目录）以及构建脚本。主要组成部分是核心代理引擎、命令行界面和配置文件示例。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 libsagernet 等库，支持跨平台编译，包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。
zh.hot: sing-box 因其强大的功能和灵活性而广受欢迎，star 数已超过 36k，今日新增 35 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 7。它被广泛用于科学上网和网络代理场景。

开发者可将其作为库集成到自己的应用中，实现代理功能

需要跨平台统一代理解决方案的用户

en.tag: Universal proxy platform supporting multiple protocols and platforms
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform that provides a unified configuration format and command-line tool, supporting multiple proxy protocols (such as Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, etc.) and outbound methods. It aims to simplify proxy configuration and management for various network environments.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of sing-box, documentation (in the docs directory), and build scripts. The main components are the core proxy engine, command-line interface, and configuration file examples.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it depends on libraries like libsagernet and supports cross-platform compilation for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: sing-box is popular for its powerful features and flexibility, with over 36k stars and 35 new stars today, ranking 7th on the Go trending list. It is widely used for circumventing censorship and network proxying.
uses: Users who need to set up personal proxy servers with quick configuration of multiple protocols
Developers can integrate it as a library into their applications for proxy functionality
Network enthusiasts can learn about proxy protocols and implementation principles
Users needing a unified cross-platform proxy solution

zh.tag: Go 编写的开源漏洞扫描器，对接 OSV 数据库
zh.what: OSV-Scanner 是一个用 Go 编写的漏洞扫描工具，它利用 OSV.dev 提供的开源漏洞数据库，自动检测项目依赖中已知的安全漏洞。它支持多种语言、包管理器和容器镜像，并提供修复建议。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 OSV-Scalibr 库，支持多种生态系统的解析器，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。

安全团队用于审计项目依赖和容器镜像的安全性
需要快速获取修复建议的开发者，利用引导式修复功能

en.tag: Open-source vulnerability scanner in Go, backed by OSV database
en.what: OSV-Scanner is a vulnerability scanner written in Go that uses the open-source OSV database to detect known security vulnerabilities in project dependencies. It supports multiple languages, package managers, and container images, and provides remediation guidance.
en.content: The repository contains the full CLI tool source code, documentation, example configurations, and CI workflows, with core functionality implemented via the extensible OSV-Scalibr library.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on the OSV-Scalibr library, supports parsers for various ecosystems, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As an officially maintained Google scanner, it directly leverages the high-quality open-source OSV database with broad coverage and continuous updates, making it popular among developers, with over 10k stars.
uses: Developers integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to automatically scan dependency vulnerabilities
Security teams use it to audit project dependencies and container images for security
Developers needing quick remediation advice can leverage guided remediation features

zh.tag: 开源个人云操作系统，让 AI 代理运行在你自己的硬件上
zh.what: Olares 是一个开源的个人云操作系统，基于 Kubernetes 构建，将你的设备转变为自托管的 AI 平台。它允许用户通过自然语言操作，在自有硬件上运行 AI 代理和本地大语言模型，同时提供计算、存储、网络和应用管理的统一入口。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Olares 操作系统源码、安装脚本、文档（中英日多语言）、以及用于构建个人云环境的 Kubernetes 配置。还集成了 Olares Market，可一键安装开源 AI 应用和模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes 进行容器编排，支持 GPU 加速管理（时间切片、内存切片、独占模式）。前端可能涉及 Web 技术，但核心后端为 Go。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和本地 LLM 的兴起，用户对数据隐私和硬件自主权的需求增加。Olares 提供了一种自托管 AI 解决方案，star 数已达 5186，今日新增 21，登上 Go 语言趋势榜第 9 名，反映了社区对个人云 OS 的兴趣。
uses: 个人用户：希望在自有硬件上运行 AI 代理和本地 LLM，保护数据隐私。
小团队：需要统一管理计算、存储和应用的轻量级云平台。
开发者：想基于 Kubernetes 构建自托管 AI 基础设施或贡献开源项目。
AI 爱好者：希望一键安装开源 AI 应用和模型，体验本地 AI 的便捷。

en.tag: Open-source personal cloud OS to run AI agents on your own hardware
en.what: Olares is an open-source personal cloud OS built on Kubernetes that turns your devices into a self-hosted AI platform. It lets you operate in plain language, run AI agents and local LLMs on hardware you own, and provides a unified place for compute, storage, networking, and apps.
en.content: The repo contains the full Olares OS source code, installation scripts, documentation (multi-language), and Kubernetes configurations for building a personal cloud environment. It also integrates Olares Market for one-click installation of open-source AI apps and models.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes for container orchestration, with GPU acceleration management (time-slicing, memory-slicing, exclusive modes). The core backend is Go, with web-based frontend likely.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and local LLMs, users demand data privacy and hardware ownership. Olares offers a self-hosted AI solution, reaching 5,186 stars with 21 new today, ranking #9 on the Go trending list, reflecting community interest in personal cloud OS.
uses: Individual users: want to run AI agents and local LLMs on their own hardware to protect data privacy.
Small teams: need a lightweight cloud platform to manage compute, storage, and apps centrally.
Developers: interested in building self-hosted AI infrastructure on Kubernetes or contributing to open source.
AI enthusiasts: want one-click installation of open-source AI apps and models for local AI convenience.

zh.tag: 订阅转API网关，拼车共享AI订阅
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 和 Grok 等订阅统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享，让多个用户分摊订阅成本。它允许用户通过标准 API 无缝使用这些模型，并兼容 Claude Code 等原生工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端、Vue 3 前端、PostgreSQL 和 Redis 数据库，以及 Docker 部署配置。提供完整的 API 网关功能，包括订阅配额分配、用户管理和多语言文档（英文、中文、日文）。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Go 1.25、Vue 3、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+ 和 Docker。后端使用 Go 构建高性能网关，前端使用 Vue 3 提供管理界面，数据库用于存储用户和配额数据。
zh.hot: 该项目以 36k+ 星标迅速走红，因为 AI 订阅费用高昂，拼车共享需求强烈。它提供了一种经济高效的解决方案，让用户共享订阅，同时保持 API 兼容性，吸引了大量开发者和团队。
uses: 个人开发者：希望以更低成本使用 Claude、OpenAI 等 API 的开发者。
小型团队：需要共享 AI 订阅以分摊成本，同时保持 API 兼容性。
AI 工具用户：使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具，希望统一接入多个模型。
技术学习者：对 API 网关和订阅管理感兴趣，用于学习和研究。

en.tag: Subscription-to-API gateway for sharing AI plans
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscriptions from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and Grok into unified API endpoints, enabling shared usage and cost splitting among multiple users. It allows seamless use of these models via standard APIs, compatible with native tools like Claude Code.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend, PostgreSQL and Redis databases, and Docker deployment configurations. It provides full API gateway features including subscription quota distribution, user management, and multilingual documentation (English, Chinese, Japanese).
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go 1.25, Vue 3, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, and Docker. The backend is built with Go for high-performance gateway, frontend with Vue 3 for admin UI, and databases for user and quota data.
en.hot: The project gained 36k+ stars rapidly due to the high cost of AI subscriptions and strong demand for shared plans. It offers a cost-effective solution to share subscriptions while maintaining API compatibility, attracting many developers and teams.
uses: Individual developers: who want to use Claude, OpenAI APIs at lower cost.
Small teams: needing to share AI subscriptions to split costs while keeping API compatibility.
AI tool users: using Claude Code, Codex, etc., wanting unified access to multiple models.
Tech learners: interested in API gateways and subscription management for study.

zh.tag: 最易用的自托管通行密钥身份认证提供商
zh.what: Pocket ID 是一个基于 OpenID Connect 和 OAuth 2.0 的身份认证提供商，支持用户通过通行密钥（passkeys）登录你的应用。它旨在简化自托管身份认证，避免像 Keycloak 等复杂方案。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能使用现代 JavaScript 框架，依赖 Docker 进行部署，支持通行密钥（WebAuthn）和 OpenID Connect 协议。
zh.hot: Pocket ID 在 GitHub 上获得 8723 颗星，本月新增 472 颗，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 9。它因提供简单易用的通行密钥认证方案而受到自托管社区欢迎。

家庭或小型团队：统一管理多个自托管服务的身份认证。

en.tag: The most user-friendly self-hosted passkey authentication provider
en.what: Pocket ID is an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider that allows users to sign in to your applications using passkeys. It aims to simplify self-hosted authentication, avoiding the complexity of solutions like Keycloak.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Pocket ID, including backend (Go) and frontend (Web), with Docker deployment support, documentation, and a demo site.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern JavaScript frontend, deployed via Docker, supporting WebAuthn passkeys and OpenID Connect protocol.
en.hot: Pocket ID has 8,723 stars on GitHub, with 472 added this month, ranking 9th on the Go trending list. It is popular among self-hosting enthusiasts for its simple passkey authentication solution.

Families or small teams: Centralize authentication for multiple self-hosted services.
Security enthusiasts: Use hardware keys like YubiKey to sign in to all services.

zh.tag: 本地媒体一键投屏到智能电视与 Chromecast
zh.what: Go2TV 是一个命令行工具，让你直接从电脑或手机将视频、音频和图片文件播放到智能电视或 Chromecast 设备上。它支持 DLNA/UPnP 协议的电视（如三星、LG、索尼）以及 Chromecast 设备，无需复制文件到 U 盘或搭建媒体服务器。

zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 FFmpeg 进行转码，支持 DLNA/UPnP 和 Chromecast 协议。通过 GitHub Actions 构建多平台二进制文件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 19 星，总星数 1032，登上 Go 语言日榜第 12 名。它解决了智能电视投屏的痛点，提供简单易用的命令行工具，且支持多种设备和格式。

使用 Chromecast 或 DLNA 电视的媒体爱好者，希望播放各种格式。
开发者或高级用户，喜欢命令行工具和自动化脚本。

en.tag: Cast local media files to Smart TVs and Chromecast devices
en.what: Go2TV is a command-line tool that lets you play video, audio, and image files directly from your computer or phone to Smart TVs or Chromecast devices. It supports DLNA/UPnP TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony, etc.) and Chromecast devices, eliminating the need for USB drives or media servers.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, cross-platform build configurations (Windows, macOS, Linux, ARM, Android), and documentation. Key features include auto-discovery, transcoding (requires FFmpeg), subtitle support, playlists, looping, and an RTMP server.
en.stack: Written in Go, relies on FFmpeg for transcoding, supports DLNA/UPnP and Chromecast protocols. GitHub Actions builds binaries for multiple platforms.
en.hot: Gained 19 stars today, total 1032, ranking #12 on Go daily trending. It solves the pain point of casting to smart TVs with a simple CLI, supporting many devices and formats.
uses: Users who want to cast local videos to TV without USB drives.
Media enthusiasts with Chromecast or DLNA TVs who need format flexibility.
Developers or power users who prefer CLI tools and automation.

zh.hot: 凭借 27k+ Stars 和每日新增，Crush 在开发者中迅速走红，因为它将 AI 编程助手无缝集成到终端，且支持多模型和高度可定制。
