多模型用户：需要灵活切换不同 LLM（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的开发者，可保留上下文。
项目维护者：需要管理多个项目会话和上下文的开发者，支持 LSP 和 MCP 扩展。
跨平台用户：在 macOS、Linux、Windows 等多种系统上工作的开发者，Crush 提供一流支持。

en.tag: Your coding bestie in the terminal, wired to any LLM
en.what: Crush is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that connects your tools, code, and workflows to the LLM of your choice. It supports multiple models, session management, LSP enhancement, and MCP extensions, bringing intelligent coding to your terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and example configurations for Crush. Built on the Charm ecosystem, it offers cross-platform support and includes NixOS and Home Manager modules.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the Charm ecosystem (e.g., Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss) for terminal UI, supporting OpenAI and Anthropic-compatible APIs, and extending functionality via MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 27k+ stars and daily additions, Crush is rapidly gaining popularity among developers for seamlessly integrating AI coding assistance into the terminal, with multi-model support and high customizability.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: Developers who prefer working in the terminal and want AI assistance without switching apps.
Multi-model users: Developers who need to switch between different LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) while preserving context.
Project maintainers: Developers managing multiple project sessions and contexts, with LSP and MCP extensions.
Cross-platform users: Developers working on macOS, Linux, Windows, and more, with first-class support.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上自动扩缩容的 GitHub Actions 自托管运行器控制器
zh.what: ARC 是一个 Kubernetes 操作器，用于编排和扩缩容 GitHub Actions 的自托管运行器。它允许创建运行器规模集，根据仓库、组织或企业中运行的工作流数量自动扩缩。由于运行器可以是临时的且基于容器，新实例可以快速、干净地上下伸缩。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ARC 的源代码、Helm 图表、文档和示例，用于在 Kubernetes 上部署和管理运行器规模集。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，基于 Kubernetes Operator 模式，利用控制器和自定义资源定义（CRD）来管理运行器生命周期。
zh.hot: 随着 GitHub Actions 的广泛使用，对高效、可扩展的自托管运行器需求增加。ARC 提供了原生的 Kubernetes 集成和自动扩缩容能力，尽管今日新增 star 不多，但总星数 6424 表明其持续受欢迎。
uses: 需要在 Kubernetes 上运行 GitHub Actions 的团队，希望利用容器化运行器实现弹性伸缩。
希望降低 CI/CD 成本、避免固定运行器闲置的企业，通过按需扩缩容优化资源使用。
对自托管运行器有安全或合规要求，需要隔离和临时运行器的组织。

en.tag: Kubernetes operator for autoscaling self-hosted GitHub Actions runners
en.what: ARC is a Kubernetes operator that orchestrates and scales self-hosted runners for GitHub Actions. It enables creating runner scale sets that automatically scale based on the number of workflows running in your repository, organization, or enterprise. Because runners can be ephemeral and container-based, new instances can scale up or down rapidly and cleanly.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, Helm charts, documentation, and examples for deploying and managing runner scale sets on Kubernetes.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it follows the Kubernetes Operator pattern, using controllers and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) to manage runner lifecycles.
en.hot: With the widespread adoption of GitHub Actions, there is growing demand for efficient, scalable self-hosted runners. ARC offers native Kubernetes integration and autoscaling capabilities, and despite modest daily stars, its 6424 total stars indicate sustained popularity.
uses: Teams running GitHub Actions on Kubernetes, leveraging containerized runners for elastic scaling.
Enterprises looking to reduce CI/CD costs and avoid idle fixed runners by scaling on demand.
Organizations with security or compliance needs requiring isolated and ephemeral runners.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关，聚合分发多模型 API
zh.what: New API 是一个下一代 LLM 网关和 AI 资产管理平台，用于聚合和分发各种大语言模型。它可以将不同模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容的格式，提供统一的 API 入口，支持个人和企业级模型管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端界面（位于 web 目录）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等），以及 API 网关、认证、计费、日志等核心功能模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，前端可能使用 React 或 Vue 等现代框架（具体未在摘要中说明）。
zh.hot: 拥有 44,691 颗星，今日新增 73 颗，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 17 名。其热度源于为多模型管理提供了统一网关，解决了 AI 开发者管理多个 API 的痛点。
uses: 个人开发者：统一管理多个 LLM API，简化调用流程
企业团队：集中管控模型访问权限，实现成本核算与审计
AI 应用开发者：将不同模型转换为标准格式，快速集成

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway for aggregating and distributing multiple LLM APIs
en.what: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management platform for aggregating and distributing various large language models. It converts different models into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats, providing a unified API endpoint for personal and enterprise-level model management.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web frontend (in the web directory), Docker deployment configs, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), and core modules for API gateway, authentication, billing, and logging.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with Docker for containerized deployment. The frontend likely uses a modern framework like React or Vue (not specified in the summary).
en.hot: With 44,691 stars and 73 new stars today, it ranks #17 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily. Its popularity stems from providing a unified gateway for multi-model management, solving the pain point of managing multiple APIs for AI developers.
uses: Individual developers: unify multiple LLM APIs to simplify call workflows
Enterprise teams: centrally manage model access, cost accounting, and auditing
AI application developers: convert different models to standard formats for quick integration

zh.tag: 开源个人音乐流媒体服务器，打造你的专属 Spotify
zh.what: Navidrome 是一个开源的基于 Web 的音乐收藏服务器和流媒体播放器，让你可以从任何浏览器或移动设备自由收听自己的音乐库。它相当于一个个人版的 Spotify，提供音乐管理和播放功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务器、Web 前端界面、Docker 镜像、安装文档、主题支持以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能涉及 JavaScript/HTML/CSS，支持 Docker 部署，依赖 Subsonic API 兼容。
zh.hot: 拥有 2.2 万+ Star，今日新增 25，因其提供免费、自托管的音乐流媒体解决方案，满足用户摆脱付费订阅的需求，且活跃的社区和持续更新保持热度。
uses: 音乐爱好者：希望自建音乐库，摆脱 Spotify 等订阅服务的用户
家庭用户：在家庭网络中共享音乐收藏，多设备访问
开发者：对 Go 或音乐服务器开发感兴趣，可参与贡献或定制

en.tag: Open-source personal music streaming server, your own Spotify
en.what: Navidrome is an open-source web-based music collection server and streamer that lets you listen to your music library from any browser or mobile device. It's like a personal Spotify, offering music management and playback.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend server, web frontend, Docker images, installation docs, theme support, and translation files.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, frontend likely uses JavaScript/HTML/CSS, supports Docker deployment, and is Subsonic API compatible.
en.hot: With 22k+ stars and 25 added today, it's popular for offering a free, self-hosted music streaming solution that lets users avoid subscriptions, backed by an active community and continuous updates.
uses: Music enthusiasts who want to self-host their music library and avoid subscriptions
Home users sharing music across devices on a home network
Developers interested in Go or music server development, can contribute or customize

zh.tag: 轻量便携的多格式命令行数据处理工具
zh.what: yq 是一个用 Go 编写的命令行工具，用于处理 YAML、JSON、XML、CSV、TOML、HCL 和 properties 等多种格式。它采用类似 jq 的语法，支持读取、更新、合并和格式转换等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 yq 的源代码、文档、示例和安装脚本。主要提供单一可执行文件，支持多种安装方式，如二进制下载、包管理器、Docker 和 Podman。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 jq 的语法风格，但独立实现。支持通过 Go 模块构建，并提供跨平台二进制。
zh.hot: yq 是处理 YAML 等格式的必备工具，star 数达 1.5 万，虽然今日新增不多，但长期稳定受欢迎，尤其在 DevOps 和 CI/CD 场景中广泛使用。
uses: DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 管道中解析和修改 YAML 配置文件
开发者：快速查看或转换 YAML/JSON 数据，无需打开编辑器
脚本编写者：在 shell 脚本中处理配置文件，支持环境变量注入

en.tag: Lightweight portable CLI for YAML/JSON/XML/CSV/TOML processing
en.what: yq is a Go-based command-line tool for processing YAML, JSON, XML, CSV, TOML, HCL, and properties formats. It uses jq-like syntax and supports reading, updating, merging, and converting between formats.
en.content: The repository contains yq's source code, documentation, examples, and installation scripts. It provides a single executable with multiple installation options including binary downloads, package managers, Docker, and Podman.
en.stack: Developed in Go, inspired by jq's syntax but independently implemented. Built with Go modules and provides cross-platform binaries.
en.hot: yq is an essential tool for YAML processing, with 15.8k stars. Though today's increment is small, it remains consistently popular, especially in DevOps and CI/CD workflows.
uses: DevOps engineers: parse and modify YAML configs in CI/CD pipelines
Developers: quickly view or convert YAML/JSON data without an editor
Script writers: process config files in shell scripts with env var support

zh.tag: 容器镜像与文件系统漏洞扫描器
zh.what: Grype 是一款开源漏洞扫描器，用于扫描容器镜像、文件系统和 SBOM，以发现已知漏洞。它支持多种操作系统包和语言特定包，并提供威胁与风险优先级排序。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Grype 的 Go 源代码、文档、示例和 CI/CD 配置。核心功能包括扫描目标支持、漏洞数据库集成、结果解释和 OpenVEX 支持。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Syft（用于 SBOM 生成）、多个漏洞数据库（如 NVD）以及 EPSS/KEV 数据源。
zh.hot: Grype 拥有 12.7k 星标，因其在容器安全领域的关键作用而广受欢迎，是 Anchore 开源生态的核心组件。
uses: DevOps 工程师在 CI/CD 管道中集成漏洞扫描，确保镜像安全
安全团队对现有镜像和文件系统进行定期安全审计
开发者快速检查本地构建的镜像是否存在已知漏洞
平台工程师结合 SBOM 进行供应链安全分析

en.tag: A vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems
en.what: Grype is an open-source vulnerability scanner for container images, filesystems, and SBOMs. It supports major OS and language-specific packages, and provides threat and risk prioritization.
en.content: The repository contains Grype's Go source code, documentation, examples, and CI/CD configs. Core features include scan target support, vulnerability database integration, result interpretation, and OpenVEX support.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it leverages Syft for SBOM generation, multiple vulnerability databases (e.g., NVD), and EPSS/KEV data sources.
en.hot: With 12.7k stars, Grype is popular for its critical role in container security, being a core component of the Anchore open-source ecosystem.
uses: DevOps engineers integrate vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines to ensure image security
Security teams conduct regular audits of existing images and filesystems
Developers quickly check local images for known vulnerabilities
Platform engineers analyze supply chain security with SBOMs

zh.tag: 高人气内网穿透与反向代理工具，支持 TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS 及 P2P 模式
zh.what: frp 是一个快速反向代理工具，用于将位于 NAT 或防火墙后的本地服务器暴露到公网。它支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议，并允许通过域名将请求转发到内网服务，同时提供 P2P 直连模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 frps（服务端）和 frpc（客户端）二进制及源码，提供完整的配置文件示例、文档（含中文）以及多种协议转发和 P2P 穿透的实现代码。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言为主开发，支持跨平台编译部署，依赖 Go 标准库及网络协议栈实现高性能内网穿透。
zh.hot: 作为内网穿透领域的事实标准工具，frp 已积累超过 10.8 万 Star，本月新增 879 Star，稳居 Go 语言月榜前列，深受开发者与运维人员信赖。
uses: 远程办公与家庭服务器运维——将内网 SSH、NAS、Web 服务安全暴露到公网
本地开发调试——让前端、后端、Webhook 在公网可访问
云原生与 IoT 场景——为无公网 IP 的容器、边缘设备提供稳定入口
技术爱好者与极客——快速搭建个人博客、图床、游戏服务器等内网穿透服务

en.tag: Popular fast reverse proxy for NAT traversal, supporting TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS and P2P mode
en.what: frp is a fast reverse proxy that exposes local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, forwards requests to internal services via domain names, and offers a P2P connect mode.
en.content: The repository contains frps (server) and frpc (client) binaries and source code, complete configuration examples, documentation (including Chinese), and implementations for multi-protocol forwarding and P2P tunneling.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go with cross-platform compilation support, relying on Go's standard library and networking stack to deliver high-performance NAT traversal.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for NAT traversal, frp has accumulated over 108K stars, gaining 879 this month alone and ranking high on the Go monthly trending list, trusted by developers and ops worldwide.
uses: Remote work and homelab ops — securely expose internal SSH, NAS, and web services to the internet
Local development and debugging — make frontend, backend, and webhook endpoints publicly accessible
Cloud-native and IoT scenarios — provide stable ingress for containers and edge devices without public IPs
Hobbyists and geeks — quickly tunnel personal blogs, image hosting, and game servers from behind NAT

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生作业排队与准入管理器
zh.what: Kueue 是一组 API 和控制器，用于在 Kubernetes 上实现作业级别的排队与准入控制。它决定作业何时可以启动（创建 Pod）以及何时应停止（删除活跃 Pod），从而优化集群资源利用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kueue 的核心控制器、API 定义、文档站点以及示例。主要组件包括 ClusterQueue、LocalQueue 和 Workload 等 CRD，以及用于集成多种作业类型的适配器。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 Kubernetes 的 controller-runtime 构建，依赖 Prometheus 进行指标监控，并支持与 cluster-autoscaler 等组件集成。
zh.hot: Kueue 解决了多租户集群中作业排队的痛点，提供公平共享和抢占策略，随着 Kubernetes 在 AI/ML 工作负载中的普及，其需求日益增长。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但总星数 2785 表明其持续受到关注。
uses: 平台团队：为多租户 Kubernetes 集群提供统一的作业排队和资源配额管理
AI/ML 工程师：管理 Kubeflow、Ray 等训练作业的排队与优先级
SRE/运维：通过公平共享和抢占策略优化集群资源利用率

en.tag: Kubernetes-native job queueing and admission manager
en.what: Kueue is a set of APIs and controllers for job-level queueing and admission control on Kubernetes. It decides when a job should be admitted to start (pods can be created) and when it should stop (active pods deleted), optimizing cluster resource utilization.
en.content: The repository contains the core controller, API definitions, documentation site, and examples. Main components include CRDs like ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, and Workload, along with adapters for integrating various job types.
en.stack: Developed in Go, built on Kubernetes controller-runtime, uses Prometheus for metrics, and integrates with components like cluster-autoscaler.
en.hot: Kueue addresses the pain point of job queueing in multi-tenant clusters, offering fair sharing and preemption policies. As Kubernetes becomes prevalent in AI/ML workloads, its demand grows. Despite modest daily stars, the total 2785 indicates sustained interest.
uses: Platform teams: provide unified job queueing and resource quota management for multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters
AI/ML engineers: manage queueing and priorities for training jobs like Kubeflow and Ray
SRE/ops: optimize cluster resource utilization with fair sharing and preemption policies

zh.tag: 行业标准的容器运行时，强调简单、健壮与可移植
zh.what: containerd 是一个行业标准的容器运行时，专注于简单性、健壮性和可移植性。它以守护进程形式运行于 Linux 和 Windows，管理宿主机的完整容器生命周期，包括镜像传输与存储、容器执行与监管、底层存储与网络挂载等。它设计为嵌入到更大的系统中，而非直接供开发者或最终用户使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 containerd 的源代码、文档（如架构设计）、CI 配置和贡献指南。它还包括用于构建和测试的脚本，以及历史设计文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 Linux 和 Windows 的系统调用，并集成 CNCF 生态。项目使用 GitHub Actions 进行 CI，并遵循 CII Best Practices 和 OpenSSF Scorecard 标准。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，containerd 是容器生态的核心组件，被 Docker、Kubernetes 等广泛采用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但其 21k+ 的 star 数反映了其长期稳定的重要性和社区信任。
uses: 平台开发者：将 containerd 嵌入到自己的容器平台或编排系统中，管理容器生命周期。
云原生工程师：作为 Kubernetes 等编排系统的运行时，优化镜像管理和容器执行。
系统集成商：利用其底层存储和网络能力，构建定制化容器解决方案。
贡献者：参与开源社区，帮助文档、安全、子项目开发等。

en.tag: Industry-standard container runtime emphasizing simplicity, robustness, and portability
en.what: containerd is an industry-standard container runtime with an emphasis on simplicity, robustness, and portability. It is available as a daemon for Linux and Windows, managing the complete container lifecycle of its host system: image transfer and storage, container execution and supervision, low-level storage and network attachments, etc. It is designed to be embedded into a larger system, rather than being used directly by developers or end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation (e.g., architecture design), CI configuration, and contribution guidelines for containerd. It also includes scripts for building and testing, as well as historical design documents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Linux and Windows system calls and integrates with the CNCF ecosystem. The project uses GitHub Actions for CI and adheres to CII Best Practices and OpenSSF Scorecard standards.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, containerd is a core component of the container ecosystem, widely adopted by Docker, Kubernetes, and others. Despite modest daily star gains, its 21k+ stars reflect its long-term importance and community trust.
uses: Platform developers: Embed containerd into their container platform or orchestration system to manage container lifecycle.
Cloud-native engineers: Use it as the runtime for orchestration systems like Kubernetes, optimizing image management and container execution.
System integrators: Leverage its low-level storage and networking capabilities to build customized container solutions.
Contributors: Join the open-source community to help with documentation, security, subprojects, etc.

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: Google 开源的高性能键值存储库
zh.what: LevelDB 是 Google 开发的一个快速键值存储库，提供从字符串键到字符串值的有序映射。它支持任意字节数组的键值、按键排序、原子批量操作、快照和迭代等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LevelDB 的完整源代码、文档（doc/index.md）、CMake 构建配置，以及用于测试的辅助文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Snappy 压缩库（可选 Zstd），支持 CMake 构建系统，可在 POSIX 和 Windows 平台编译。
zh.hot: 作为经典存储引擎，长期被广泛使用，今日新增 11 星，仍位列 C++ 趋势榜第二，体现其持久影响力。
uses: 嵌入式数据库开发，需要高效键值存储的应用
学习 LSM 树和存储引擎实现的开发者
需要有序键值存储且要求高性能的场景

en.tag: Google's high-performance key-value storage library
en.what: LevelDB is a fast key-value storage library developed by Google, providing an ordered mapping from string keys to string values. It supports arbitrary byte arrays for keys and values, sorted storage, atomic batch operations, snapshots, and iteration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of LevelDB, documentation (doc/index.md), CMake build configuration, and auxiliary files for testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Snappy compression library (Zstd optional), supports CMake build system, and compiles on POSIX and Windows platforms.
en.hot: As a classic storage engine, it has been widely used for a long time. With 11 new stars today, it still ranks second on the C++ trending list, reflecting its enduring influence.
uses: Embedded database development for applications needing efficient key-value storage
Developers learning LSM tree and storage engine implementation
Scenarios requiring ordered key-value storage with high performance

zh.tag: 跨平台图形化代理客户端，基于 sing-box 内核
zh.what: Throne 是一款基于 Qt 的跨平台图形化代理工具，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。它利用 sing-box 和 Xray 内核，提供丰富的协议支持和订阅管理功能。作为已归档的 Nekoray 项目的延续，它带来了大量改进和新特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt 桌面应用源码，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、VLESS、Hysteria 等），提供订阅解析、自定义配置、链式出站等功能。还包含 Linux 安装脚本和 RPM 仓库配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 sing-box 和 Xray-core 作为代理内核，并集成 simple-protobuf、fkYAML、quirc、QHotkey、sqlitecpp 等库。
zh.hot: 作为 Nekoray 的活跃继任者，它吸引了大量原用户，star 数已达 6695，今日新增 18，位列 C++ 日榜第 4。其丰富的协议支持和跨平台特性使其在代理工具社区中备受关注。
uses: 需要跨平台图形化代理客户端的用户，替代已归档的 Nekoray
依赖 sing-box 或 Xray 内核的高级用户，需要自定义配置和链式出站
希望使用订阅链接管理多个代理服务器的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform GUI proxy client powered by sing-box
en.what: Throne is a Qt-based cross-platform GUI proxy utility supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It leverages sing-box and Xray cores, offering extensive protocol support and subscription management. As a continuation of the archived Nekoray project, it brings many improvements and new features.
en.content: The repository contains the full Qt desktop application source code, supporting numerous proxy protocols (e.g., Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS, Hysteria), with subscription parsing, custom configs, and chaining outbounds. It also includes Linux install scripts and RPM repository setup.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, relying on sing-box and Xray-core as proxy cores, and integrating libraries like simple-protobuf, fkYAML, quirc, QHotkey, and sqlitecpp.
en.hot: As an active successor to Nekoray, it attracts many former users, with 6695 stars and 18 new today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending. Its extensive protocol support and cross-platform nature make it popular in the proxy tool community.
uses: Users needing a cross-platform GUI proxy client, replacing the archived Nekoray
Advanced users relying on sing-box or Xray cores, requiring custom configs and chaining outbounds
Users who want to manage multiple proxy servers via subscription links

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 实时投屏与控制工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款通过 USB 或网络显示和控制 Android 设备的软件，无需 root 权限。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 三大平台，注重轻量、高性能、低延迟和非侵入性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QtScrcpy 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Windows/macOS/Ubuntu）、截图、文档（如按键映射脚本规则），以及作者开发的更专业的投屏软件 QuickMirror 的推广信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，依赖 adb 进行设备通信，支持 GPU 视频渲染（在 QuickMirror 中提及）。
zh.hot: 作为 scrcpy 的 Qt 图形化版本，它提供了更友好的界面和按键映射功能，方便游戏玩家和开发者使用。今日新增 174 星，总星数超 3.1 万，位列 C++ 日榜第三，持续受到关注。
uses: 安卓开发者：无需 root 即可调试和演示应用，实时查看设备屏幕。
游戏玩家：通过按键映射脚本，用键盘鼠标玩手机游戏（如 PUBG Mobile）。
技术支持：远程协助或批量管理多台 Android 设备（结合 QuickMirror 可管理 500+ 台）。

en.tag: Cross-platform Android real-time display and control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a software that displays and controls Android devices via USB or over the network, requiring no root privileges. It supports GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, focusing on lightness, performance, low latency, and non-intrusiveness.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of QtScrcpy, cross-platform build configurations (Windows/macOS/Ubuntu), screenshots, documentation (e.g., key mapping script rules), and promotional info for the author's more professional screen casting software QuickMirror.
en.stack: Developed primarily with C++ and Qt framework, relies on adb for device communication, and supports GPU video rendering (mentioned in QuickMirror).
en.hot: As a Qt graphical version of scrcpy, it offers a friendlier UI and key mapping features, appealing to gamers and developers. With 174 stars today and over 31k total, it ranks #3 on the C++ daily trending list, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Android developers: debug and demo apps without root, view device screen in real time.
Gamers: play mobile games (e.g., PUBG Mobile) with keyboard and mouse via key mapping scripts.
Tech support: remote assistance or batch management of multiple Android devices (with QuickMirror, manage 500+ devices).

zh.tag: ROCm 系统项目统一仓库，简化开发与 CI
zh.what: rocm-systems 是 AMD ROCm 平台系统组件的统一仓库，将多个独立的系统项目集中管理，以简化开发、持续集成和集成流程。首个重点是满足 PyTorch 构建所需的基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hipfile、hipother、hip-tests、rdc、rocdbgapi、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler、rocprofiler-compute 等项目的迁移状态和 CI 健康度表格。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成，涉及 ROCm 软件栈的多个底层组件。
zh.hot: 作为 ROCm 生态的集中入口，统一管理多个关键系统项目，对 PyTorch 等 AI 框架在 AMD GPU 上的支持至关重要，因此受到开发者关注。
uses: AMD GPU 开发者：需要构建或调试 ROCm 系统组件
PyTorch 用户：在 AMD GPU 上运行 PyTorch 需要这些底层库
ROCm 贡献者：希望参与系统组件开发或了解迁移状态

en.tag: Super-repo consolidating ROCm systems projects for streamlined dev & CI
en.what: rocm-systems is a super-repo for AMD ROCm platform system components, consolidating multiple independent projects to streamline development, CI, and integration. The initial focus is on components required for building PyTorch.
en.content: The repo contains a table showing migration status and CI health for projects like amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hipfile, hipother, hip-tests, rdc, rocdbgapi, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, rocprofiler, and rocprofiler-compute.
en.stack: Primarily C++, uses GitHub Actions for CI, covering various low-level components of the ROCm software stack.
en.hot: As a central hub for the ROCm ecosystem, it consolidates key system projects critical for PyTorch support on AMD GPUs, drawing attention from developers.
uses: AMD GPU developers building or debugging ROCm system components
PyTorch users running on AMD GPUs needing these low-level libraries
ROCm contributors wanting to develop or track migration status

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个用于优化和部署深度学习模型的开源工具包，支持从边缘到云端的多种硬件平台。它能够提升计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 和 NLP 等任务的推理性能，并支持主流框架训练的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenVINO 的完整源代码、文档、教程、集成示例和基准测试工具。还提供了 Python、C++、Node.js 等多种语言的 API 和安装包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等接口，支持 ONNX、PyTorch、TensorFlow 等模型格式，并集成 Hugging Face Optimum Intel。
zh.hot: OpenVINO 作为英特尔官方的 AI 推理工具，拥有超过 1 万星标，今日新增 6 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 11 名。其广泛的硬件兼容性和对生成式 AI 的支持持续吸引开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：在边缘设备或云端部署优化后的推理模型，提升性能。
计算机视觉工程师：利用 OpenVINO 加速图像分类、目标检测等任务。
生成式 AI 爱好者：通过 OpenVINO GenAI 部署大语言模型和扩散模型。
嵌入式系统开发者：在 Intel CPU、GPU 和 NPU 上实现高效推理。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, supporting a range of platforms from edge to cloud. It boosts inference performance for tasks like computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, and supports models trained with popular frameworks.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, tutorials, integration examples, and benchmark tools for OpenVINO. It also provides APIs and packages for multiple languages including Python, C++, and Node.js.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with interfaces for Python, C++, Node.js, etc. Supports model formats like ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and integrates with Hugging Face Optimum Intel.
en.hot: As Intel's official AI inference toolkit, OpenVINO has over 10k stars, with 6 added today, ranking 11th on the C++ trending list. Its broad hardware compatibility and support for generative AI continue to attract developers.
uses: AI application developers: deploy optimized inference models on edge or cloud for better performance.
Computer vision engineers: accelerate tasks like image classification and object detection with OpenVINO.
Generative AI enthusiasts: deploy large language models and diffusion models via OpenVINO GenAI.
Embedded systems developers: achieve efficient inference on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.

zh.tag: 实时、纳秒级、远程遥测的混合帧与采样分析器
zh.what: Tracy 是一个面向游戏和其他应用程序的实时性能分析器，提供纳秒级分辨率的 CPU、GPU、内存分配、锁、上下文切换等分析。它支持远程遥测，并支持多种语言的绑定。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tracy Profiler 的完整源代码、文档（tracy.pdf）、Windows 预编译二进制文件、交互式演示以及示例截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持集成 C、C++、Lua、Python 和 Fortran，并有 Rust、Zig、C# 等第三方绑定。支持多种图形 API，如 OpenGL、Vulkan、Direct3D、Metal 等。
zh.hot: Tracy 因其强大的功能和广泛的语言/API 支持而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上有 16.5k 星标，并持续出现在趋势榜上。
uses: 游戏开发者：用于实时分析 CPU/GPU 性能瓶颈
性能工程师：需要远程遥测和纳秒级精度的分析
跨语言项目：支持多种语言绑定，便于集成

en.tag: Real-time, nanosecond-resolution, remote telemetry, hybrid frame and sampling profiler
en.what: Tracy is a real-time performance profiler for games and other applications, offering nanosecond-resolution analysis of CPU, GPU, memory allocations, locks, context switches, and more. It supports remote telemetry and has bindings for many languages.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Tracy Profiler, documentation (tracy.pdf), precompiled Windows binaries, an interactive demo, and example screenshots.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with direct support for C, C++, Lua, Python, and Fortran, and third-party bindings for Rust, Zig, C#, etc. Supports major graphics APIs including OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D, Metal, and more.
en.hot: Tracy is popular for its powerful features and broad language/API support, with 16.5k stars on GitHub and consistent presence on trending lists.
uses: Game developers: for real-time analysis of CPU/GPU bottlenecks
Performance engineers: needing remote telemetry and nanosecond precision
Cross-language projects: supports multiple language bindings for easy integration

zh.tag: 在 Windows 上原生运行 Linux 的官方子系统
zh.what: WSL 是微软官方推出的 Windows 子系统，允许用户在 Windows 上直接运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具、实用程序和应用程序，无需传统虚拟机或双系统。它通过轻量级虚拟化技术提供完整的 Linux 内核，实现无缝集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WSL 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（如贡献指南、开发者文档）以及相关资源，如 WSL2 内核和 WSLg 的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows 内核接口和虚拟化平台，与 WSL2-Linux-Kernel 和 WSLg 等组件协同工作。
zh.hot: WSL 是开发者必备工具，star 数高达 3.3 万，今日新增 15 星，持续受到关注，因为它简化了跨平台开发流程。
uses: 开发者：在 Windows 上使用 Linux 命令行工具和开发环境
运维人员：无需虚拟机即可测试 Linux 脚本和配置
学生/学习者：轻松体验 Linux 系统，无需安装双系统

en.tag: Official subsystem to run Linux natively on Windows
en.what: WSL is Microsoft's official subsystem that lets users run unmodified Linux command-line tools, utilities, and applications directly on Windows without a traditional VM or dual boot. It provides a full Linux kernel via lightweight virtualization for seamless integration.
en.content: The repo contains WSL's source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., contributing guide, developer docs), and links to related projects like WSL2 kernel and WSLg.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, leveraging Windows kernel interfaces and virtualization platform, working with WSL2-Linux-Kernel and WSLg components.
en.hot: WSL is a must-have for developers, with 33k+ stars and 15 new today, remaining popular for simplifying cross-platform development workflows.
uses: Developers: Use Linux command-line tools and dev environments on Windows
Sysadmins: Test Linux scripts and configs without a VM
Students/Learners: Experience Linux easily without dual boot

zh.tag: 一站式 3D 高斯泼溅训练、编辑与导出工作站
zh.what: LichtFeld Studio 是一个原生桌面应用，用于训练、检查、编辑、自动化和导出 3D 高斯泼溅场景。它集成了模型训练、实时可视化、高斯编辑、导出、插件和自动化于一体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档（构建指南、插件系统、MCP 指南）、示例资源（如 logo、演示 GIF）以及发布版本。核心功能包括训练、检查、编辑、导出、插件和自动化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，可能依赖图形库和深度学习框架（如 CUDA、PyTorch）进行 3D 高斯泼溅训练和渲染。支持 Python 插件和 MCP 集成。
zh.hot: 3D 高斯泼溅是当前热门技术，该应用提供一站式解决方案，从训练到导出，且支持插件和自动化，吸引了大量关注。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但总星数已达 3496，位列 C++ 日榜第 10。
uses: 研究人员：迭代重建质量，实时检查训练过程
开发者：通过 Python 插件扩展功能，或使用 MCP 自动化工作流
3D 内容创作者：编辑和导出高斯场景用于可视化或发布
教育者：演示 3D 高斯泼溅技术

en.tag: All-in-one workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting training, editing, and export
en.what: LichtFeld Studio is a native desktop application for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It combines model training, real-time visualization, gaussian editing, export, plugins, and automation in one toolchain.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation (building guide, plugin system, MCP guide), sample assets (like logos, demo GIF), and release builds. Core features include training, inspection, editing, export, plugins, and automation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, likely leveraging graphics libraries and deep learning frameworks (e.g., CUDA, PyTorch) for 3DGS training and rendering. Supports Python plugins and MCP integration.
en.hot: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a hot technology, and this app offers an all-in-one solution from training to export with plugin and automation support, attracting significant attention. Despite modest daily stars, it has 3496 total stars and ranks #10 on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Researchers: iterate on reconstruction quality, inspect training in real-time
Developers: extend functionality via Python plugins or automate workflows with MCP
3D content creators: edit and export gaussian scenes for visualization or publication
Educators: demonstrate 3D Gaussian Splatting technology

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: ESP32 红队渗透测试固件
zh.what: Bruce 是一个多功能的 ESP32 固件，专注于支持红队操作，提供大量攻击性功能，如 WiFi 攻击、蓝牙攻击、GPS 等。它兼容 M5stack 和 Lilygo 产品，适用于 Cardputer、Sticks、M5Cores、T-Decks 和 T-Embeds 等设备。

en.tag: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces.
en.what: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that provides low-level utility classes to rapidly build modern interfaces without leaving your HTML. It encourages styling by composing utilities, avoiding context switching, and supports responsive and state variants.
en.content: The repository contains the framework's core source code, documentation, examples, and build/test configurations. Key directories include src (core implementation), tests, and scripts for docs generation and package publishing.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, requires Node.js, integrates as a PostCSS plugin, and supports various build tools.
en.hot: Tailwind CSS is popular for its efficient workflow and large community, gaining nearly 1,000 stars this week and approaching 100k total stars, ranking high on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers: rapidly build responsive interfaces with less custom CSS
Teams: unify design standards and customize design systems via config
Prototyping: quickly iterate UI concepts without complex styling

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含产品文档、快速入门指南、模型目录说明，以及各产品（桌面、CLI、Web、云、聊天）的详细介绍和安装链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 渐进式 JavaScript 前端框架，构建现代 Web 界面
zh.what: Vue.js 是一个渐进式、可增量采用的 JavaScript 框架，用于构建用户界面。它采用基于组件的架构，提供响应式数据绑定和组合式 API，使开发者能够高效地构建单页应用和复杂前端。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vue 3 的核心源码，包括编译器、运行时、响应式系统、SSR 等模块，以及测试、构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 esbuild、rollup 等构建工具，支持浏览器和 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: Vue 是长期热门的框架，本周新增 110 星，总星数超 5.4 万，持续吸引开发者关注，因其易用性和高性能而广受欢迎。
uses: 前端开发者：构建响应式单页应用和复杂交互界面
团队：快速搭建可维护的大型项目，利用组合式 API 组织代码
学习者：作为入门现代前端框架的首选，文档友好

en.tag: Progressive JavaScript framework for building modern web UIs
en.what: Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. It features a component-based architecture with reactive data binding and the Composition API, enabling developers to efficiently build single-page applications and complex frontends.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Vue 3, including the compiler, runtime, reactivity system, SSR, along with tests, build configs, and documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, using build tools like esbuild and rollup, supporting both browser and Node.js environments.
en.hot: Vue remains a long-time popular framework, gaining 110 stars this week with over 54k total, continuously attracting developers due to its ease of use and high performance.
uses: Frontend developers: build reactive SPAs and complex interactive UIs
Teams: quickly scaffold maintainable large projects with Composition API
Learners: first choice for learning modern frameworks with friendly docs

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室，智能对话与自主代理
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能对话、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手。它统一接入前沿大语言模型，让用户在一个应用中完成多种 AI 任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码（基于 Electron）、构建图标、多语言文档和开发指南。核心功能包括智能聊天、代理执行和助手市场。

希望使用预设助手提高工作效率的职场人士
对自主代理和自动化感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants. It unifies access to frontier LLMs, enabling users to handle various AI tasks in one app.
en.content: The repo contains desktop app source (Electron-based), build icons, multilingual docs, and dev guides. Core features include smart chat, agent execution, and assistant marketplace.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。

zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: 为浏览器中运行的一切提供快速、简单、可靠的测试
zh.what: Cypress 是一个现代化的前端端到端测试框架，旨在解决开发者在编写和运行浏览器测试时遇到的痛点。它提供了独特的交互式测试运行器、自动等待、实时重载等功能，让测试变得快速、简单且可靠。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cypress 的核心源码，包括命令行工具、测试运行器、Dashboard 服务集成等，以及文档、示例和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js，依赖 npm/yarn/pnpm 进行包管理，并集成 CircleCI 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: Cypress 因其开发者体验和可靠性而广受欢迎，本周新增 297 星，总星数超过 5 万，稳居 TypeScript 周榜前列。
uses: 前端开发者：编写端到端测试，确保应用在真实浏览器中正常工作
QA 工程师：自动化回归测试，提升测试效率
团队协作：通过 Cypress Cloud 共享测试结果，监控测试状态
学习测试框架：作为现代测试工具的参考实现

en.tag: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser
en.what: Cypress is a modern front-end end-to-end testing framework designed to solve the pain points developers face when writing and running browser tests. It offers a unique interactive test runner, automatic waiting, real-time reloads, and more, making testing fast, easy, and reliable.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Cypress, including the CLI, test runner, Dashboard service integration, as well as documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on Node.js, with package management via npm/yarn/pnpm, and integrated with CircleCI for continuous integration.
en.hot: Cypress is popular for its developer experience and reliability, gaining 297 stars this week with over 50k total stars, consistently ranking high on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers: write end-to-end tests to ensure apps work in real browsers
QA engineers: automate regression testing to improve efficiency
Team collaboration: share test results and monitor test status via Cypress Cloud
Learning testing frameworks: as a reference implementation of modern testing tools

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: GPU加速的RAW图像编辑器，轻量级Lightroom替代品
zh.what: RapidRAW是一款现代、高性能的RAW图像编辑器，专为摄影工作流设计。它提供非破坏性编辑，支持调整、遮罩等功能，体积小于20MB，跨平台支持Windows、macOS、Linux和Android。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust核心（使用wgpu进行GPU加速）、React前端（通过Tauri封装）、以及用于编辑器的资源文件。项目结构包括src-tauri（Tauri后端）、src（React前端）和文档目录。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括Rust、wgpu（WebGPU实现）、React、Tauri，以及TypeScript（用于前端）。依赖包括Tauri、wgpu、React等。
zh.hot: 作为Lightroom的轻量级替代品，RapidRAW在开发者中引发关注，因其高性能和跨平台特性。本周新增207星，总星数达9237，位列TypeScript周榜第8。
uses: 摄影爱好者：需要快速、轻量的RAW编辑工具，无需重型软件
开发者：对Rust、wgpu、Tauri等技术栈感兴趣，可学习跨平台应用开发
移动端用户：在Android上编辑RAW照片，享受桌面级功能

en.tag: GPU-accelerated RAW image editor, a lightweight Lightroom alternative
en.what: RapidRAW is a modern, high-performance RAW image editor designed for photography workflows. It offers non-destructive editing with adjustments, masking, and more, in a package under 20MB, available on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust core (using wgpu for GPU acceleration), a React frontend (wrapped with Tauri), and assets for the editor. The structure includes src-tauri (Tauri backend), src (React frontend), and docs.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Rust, wgpu (WebGPU implementation), React, Tauri, and TypeScript for the frontend. Dependencies include Tauri, wgpu, React, and more.
en.hot: As a lightweight Lightroom alternative, RapidRAW has gained traction among developers for its performance and cross-platform support. It added 207 stars this week, reaching 9,237 total, ranking #8 on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Photography enthusiasts: need a fast, lightweight RAW editor without heavy software
Developers: interested in Rust, wgpu, Tauri stack, can learn cross-platform app development
Mobile users: edit RAW photos on Android with desktop-grade features

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理变身韩国人的技能包

uses: 韩国开发者或居民：用 AI 代理自动预订火车票、查询地铁等
AI 代理爱好者：探索如何为代理构建实用的本地化技能

zh.content: 仓库包含 Svelte 编译器、核心运行时、示例项目、文档和贡献指南。主要代码在 packages/svelte 目录下，还包括用于支持开发的基础设施。

团队：追求高性能和较小包体积的 Web 应用

en.tag: A compiler-based frontend framework for simpler web development
en.what: Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It's a compiler that takes declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM. It aims to make web development simpler and more intuitive for everyone.
en.content: The repository contains the Svelte compiler, core runtime, examples, documentation, and contributing guidelines. Main code is in packages/svelte, along with supporting infrastructure for development.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it acts as a compiler outputting efficient JavaScript. It has minimal dependencies, but uses build tools and testing frameworks.
en.hot: Svelte is popular for its unique compile-time approach, eliminating virtual DOM overhead, offering high performance and smaller bundles. With 253 new stars this week and 87,925 total, it remains a developer favorite.
uses: Frontend developers: want cleaner, more efficient code with less framework overhead
Teams: seeking high performance and smaller bundle sizes for web apps
Learners: interested in compiler-based frameworks and modern frontend concepts

Teams/enterprises — need high-performance, SEO-friendly production web apps
Startups — quickly build MVP or production-grade websites

zh.what: axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，可用于浏览器和 Node.js。它支持请求和响应拦截、转换数据、取消请求、自动转换 JSON 数据，并防护 CSRF。
zh.content: 仓库包含 axios 的核心源代码、文档、示例和测试。主要文件包括 lib/（核心实现）、index.js（入口）、package.json（依赖配置）等。
zh.stack: 使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 的 http/https 模块和浏览器的 XMLHttpRequest。支持通过 npm 或 CDN 安装，并兼容多种模块格式（CommonJS、ES Module、UMD）。
zh.hot: axios 是 JavaScript 生态中最流行的 HTTP 客户端之一，拥有超过 10.9 万 star，本周新增 80 星，持续受到开发者青睐，因其简单易用且功能强大。
uses: 前端开发者：在浏览器中发送 AJAX 请求，处理响应数据。
Node.js 开发者：在服务端调用 REST API，支持拦截器和错误处理。
全栈项目：统一前后端 HTTP 请求逻辑，便于维护。

en.tag: Promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js
en.what: Axios is a Promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js. It supports request and response interceptors, transforms, cancellation, automatic JSON data transformation, and CSRF protection.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code, documentation, examples, and tests for axios. Key files include lib/ (core implementation), index.js (entry point), package.json (dependency configuration), etc.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js http/https modules and browser XMLHttpRequest. It can be installed via npm or CDN and supports multiple module formats (CommonJS, ES Module, UMD).
en.hot: Axios is one of the most popular HTTP clients in the JavaScript ecosystem, with over 109k stars and 80 new stars this week, remaining a favorite due to its simplicity and powerful features.
uses: Frontend developers: to send AJAX requests in the browser and handle response data.
Node.js developers: to call REST APIs on the server, with interceptors and error handling.
Full-stack projects: to unify HTTP request logic across frontend and backend for easier maintenance.

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢式协作空间
zh.what: Buzz 是一个自托管的协作平台，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个“房间”里共同工作。它基于 Nostr 协议，所有消息、操作和工作流步骤都作为签名事件记录在日志中，提供统一的身份模型和审计追踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Buzz 平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、Nostr 中继实现以及多个 Rust crate。提供了频道、画布、工作流、语音讨论等功能，并支持代理执行仓库操作、代码审查、CI/CD 等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，基于 Nostr 协议，依赖多个 Rust crate 实现事件日志、身份管理和中继功能。
zh.hot: Buzz 在 GitHub 上一天内获得 3252 颗星，总星数达 4148，因其创新的“人类与代理平等协作”理念和自托管、基于 Nostr 的架构吸引了大量关注。
uses: 团队协作 —— 人类与 AI 代理在同一工作空间中共同管理项目、代码审查和 CI/CD
AI 代理开发 —— 测试和部署具有完整操作权限（如仓库、工作流）的 AI 代理
事件驱动工作流 —— 利用 Nostr 事件日志构建可审计的自动化流程
自托管社区 —— 为需要完全控制数据和身份的组织提供私有协作平台

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents collaborate in shared rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on the Nostr protocol, every message, action, and workflow step is a signed event in a single log, providing a unified identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repository contains the full Buzz platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, Nostr relay implementation, and multiple Rust crates. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and enables agents to perform repo operations, code review, CI/CD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, based on the Nostr protocol, leveraging multiple Rust crates for event logging, identity management, and relay functionality.
en.hot: Buzz gained 3252 stars in a single day, reaching 4148 total, due to its innovative concept of equal collaboration between humans and agents, self-hosted nature, and Nostr-based architecture.
uses: Team collaboration — humans and AI agents manage projects, code review, and CI/CD in the same workspace
AI agent development — test and deploy agents with full operational capabilities (repos, workflows, etc.)
Event-driven workflows — build auditable automation using Nostr event logs
Self-hosted communities — provide a private collaboration platform for organizations needing full data and identity control

zh.tag: Rust 编写的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，极致性能与多会话支持
zh.what: jcode 是一款基于 Rust 的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，旨在提升 AI 编程助手的技能上限。它专为多会话工作流、无限可定制性与极致性能而设计，能够在本地以极低资源消耗运行复杂编程任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、跨平台 CLI 安装脚本（Linux/macOS/Windows），以及展示内存与启动速度优势的基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，强调零成本抽象与资源效率；支持可选本地嵌入模型，通过 Bash/PowerShell 脚本实现一键跨平台安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程工具同质化严重的背景下，jcode 凭借 8421 Star 和 Rust 日榜第 11 名的热度，以单会话 27.8 MB 的超低内存占用和多会话架构，精准击中开发者对高性能本地 Agent 的需求。
uses: 追求本地低内存、高性能 AI 编程体验的核心开发者
需要长期运行多会话复杂工作流的高级用户
希望深度定制 Coding Agent 行为与工具链的极客与团队

en.tag: Next-gen coding agent harness in Rust for multi-session, low-RAM workflows
en.what: jcode is a next-generation coding agent harness built in Rust to raise the skill ceiling of AI coding assistants. It is designed for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and extreme performance, allowing complex coding tasks to run locally with minimal resource usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core runtime, cross-platform CLI installers for Linux/macOS/Windows, and benchmark data highlighting its memory and boot-up speed advantages.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with zero-cost abstraction and resource efficiency in mind; supports optional local embeddings and one-click cross-platform installation via Bash/PowerShell scripts.
en.hot: With 8,421 stars and a spot at #11 on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, jcode stands out in the crowded AI coding space by delivering an ultra-low 27.8 MB RAM footprint per session and a multi-session architecture that meets developers' demand for high-performance local agents.
uses: Core developers seeking local, low-memory, high-performance AI coding experiences
Power users running long-term, complex multi-session workflows
Hackers and teams wanting infinite customizability of their coding agent behavior and toolchain

zh.tag: 硬件加速 GPU 终端模拟器，桌面与浏览器双端运行
zh.what: Rio 是一个用 Rust 编写的现代终端模拟器，利用 GPU 硬件加速实现流畅渲染，支持在桌面和浏览器中运行。它旨在提供跨平台一致体验，并支持自定义主题、分割视图等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端模拟器源码，提供安装文档、配置指南、变更日志和赞助入口。支持多种打包格式，如 Flatpak，并附带多平台演示截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPU 加速技术（如 WebGPU）实现渲染，支持跨平台（Windows、macOS、Linux）和 WebAssembly 浏览器版本。

跨平台用户：需要在桌面和浏览器间无缝切换的开发者

en.tag: Hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator for desktop and browser
en.what: Rio is a modern terminal emulator written in Rust, leveraging GPU hardware acceleration for smooth rendering, and runs on both desktop and browser. It aims to deliver a consistent cross-platform experience with advanced features like custom themes and split views.
en.content: The repository contains the full terminal emulator source code, along with installation docs, config guide, changelog, and sponsor links. It supports various packaging formats like Flatpak and includes demo screenshots across platforms.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GPU acceleration (e.g., WebGPU) for rendering, supporting cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) and WebAssembly for browser.
en.hot: Gaining popularity for its GPU acceleration and cross-platform (including browser) capabilities, it added 85 stars today, reaching 7239 total, ranking #4 on Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers seeking high-performance, smooth terminal experience
Cross-platform users needing seamless transition between desktop and browser
Customization enthusiasts wanting deep control over terminal appearance and behavior

zh.tag: 极速命令行搜索工具，尊重 gitignore
zh.what: ripgrep 是一个面向行的搜索工具，递归搜索当前目录中的正则表达式模式。默认情况下，它会尊重 gitignore 规则，并自动跳过隐藏文件和二进制文件。它旨在成为 grep、ack 和 The Silver Searcher 等工具的更快替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ripgrep 的 Rust 源代码、用户指南、FAQ、变更日志、配置文件示例、Shell 补全以及翻译文件。
zh.stack: 用 Rust 编写，依赖 regex 库进行正则表达式处理，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 凭借其惊人的速度和效率，ripgrep 已成为开发者的必备工具，在 GitHub 上拥有超过 67k 星标，本周新增 363 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第七。
uses: 开发者快速在代码库中搜索特定模式
系统管理员在日志文件中查找错误
任何需要比 grep 更快搜索的用户

en.tag: Ultra-fast line-oriented search tool that respects gitignore
en.what: ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern. By default, it respects gitignore rules and automatically skips hidden files and binary files. It aims to be a faster alternative to grep, ack, and The Silver Searcher.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for ripgrep, a user guide, FAQ, changelog, configuration file examples, shell completions, and translations.
en.stack: Written in Rust, depends on the regex crate for regex handling, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With its blazing speed and efficiency, ripgrep has become a must-have tool for developers, amassing over 67k stars on GitHub, with 363 new stars this week, ranking 7th on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers quickly searching for patterns in codebases
System administrators finding errors in log files
Anyone needing faster search than grep

zh.tag: 基于稀疏矩阵与线性代数的超快图数据库，为 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）而生
zh.what: FalkorDB 是一个超快的多租户图数据库，底层使用 GraphBLAS 的稀疏邻接矩阵表示图，并通过线性代数执行查询。它旨在为大型语言模型提供高性能的知识图谱（GraphRAG），支持属性图模型和 OpenCypher 查询语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的图数据库实现，包括稀疏矩阵表示、线性代数查询引擎、OpenCypher 兼容层、多租户支持，以及云服务（FalkorDB Cloud）和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GraphBLAS 库进行稀疏矩阵运算，支持 OpenCypher 查询语言，提供 Docker 部署和云服务。
zh.hot: 随着 GraphRAG 和 AI Agent 记忆需求的兴起，FalkorDB 作为专为 LLM 设计的图数据库，凭借其超低延迟和独特技术路线，在 Rust 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 49 星。
uses: 构建 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）的开发者，需要高性能图存储与查询
AI Agent 记忆管理场景，需要快速读写和检索实体关系
云安全、欺诈检测等需要实时图分析的应用
对图数据库底层技术（稀疏矩阵、线性代数）感兴趣的研究者

en.tag: Ultra-fast graph database leveraging sparse matrices & linear algebra, built for LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG)
en.what: FalkorDB is an ultra-fast, multi-tenant graph database that uses sparse adjacency matrices (GraphBLAS) under the hood and linear algebra for query execution. It aims to provide a high-performance knowledge graph for LLMs (GraphRAG), supporting the property graph model and OpenCypher queries.
en.content: The repository contains a full graph database implementation, including sparse matrix representation, linear algebra query engine, OpenCypher compatibility layer, multi-tenancy support, plus cloud service (FalkorDB Cloud) and Docker images.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging GraphBLAS for sparse matrix operations, supporting OpenCypher query language, with Docker deployment and cloud service.
en.hot: With the rise of GraphRAG and AI agent memory needs, FalkorDB, as a graph database designed specifically for LLMs, stands out with ultra-low latency and a unique technical approach, ranking #5 on the Rust daily trending with +49 stars today.
uses: Developers building LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG) needing high-performance graph storage and query
AI agent memory management scenarios requiring fast read/write and entity-relation retrieval
Applications like cloud security and fraud detection needing real-time graph analytics
Researchers interested in graph database internals (sparse matrices, linear algebra)

zh.tag: 多服务器部署与自动化管理平台
zh.what: Komodo 是一个用于在众多服务器上构建和部署软件的开源工具。它提供统一的界面来管理多台服务器，支持自动化部署、环境配置、同步更新等操作，并允许通过 API 进行扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心应用代码、文档、截图以及部署脚本。界面支持浅色和深色主题，涵盖仪表盘、堆栈管理、Compose、环境变量、同步、更新、统计和导出等功能模块。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，可能使用现代 Web 框架构建前端，后端采用 Rust 生态。依赖包括 Docker 等容器技术，用于构建和部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 104 星，总星数达 11854，位列 Rust 周榜第 10。其无限服务器连接和 API 自动化的承诺吸引了寻求轻量级自托管部署方案的用户。
uses: 需要管理多台服务器的 DevOps 工程师或系统管理员
寻求自托管、开源部署工具的个人开发者或小团队
希望利用 API 实现自动化部署和运维的自动化爱好者
对 Rust 构建的现代基础设施工具感兴趣的技术人员

en.tag: Multi-server deployment and automation platform
en.what: Komodo is an open-source tool for building and deploying software across many servers. It provides a unified interface to manage multiple servers, supporting automated deployments, environment configuration, sync updates, and extensibility via APIs.
en.content: The repository contains core application code, documentation, screenshots, and deployment scripts. The UI supports light and dark themes, featuring modules for dashboard, stack management, Compose, environment variables, sync, updates, stats, and export.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using modern web frameworks for the frontend and Rust ecosystem for the backend. Dependencies include container technologies like Docker for building and deploying.
en.hot: Gained 104 stars this week, reaching 11,854 total, ranking 10th on the Rust weekly trending. Its promise of unlimited server connections and API automation attracts users seeking lightweight self-hosted deployment solutions.
uses: DevOps engineers or sysadmins managing multiple servers
Individual developers or small teams seeking self-hosted, open-source deployment tools
Automation enthusiasts wanting to leverage APIs for automated deployment and ops
Tech professionals interested in modern infrastructure tools built with Rust

zh.tag: 透明 SSH/HTTPS/K8s/数据库堡垒机，无需客户端
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机/PAM 解决方案，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC。它不需要客户端软件或 SSH 包装器，可直接在 DMZ 中部署，并内置会话录制、浏览器访问、2FA/SSO 和暴力破解防护。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单一二进制文件，提供管理 Web UI、内置 SSH/RDP/VNC 客户端、会话录制与回放功能，以及详细的文档和 Docker 支持。
zh.stack: 基于 100% 安全 Rust 编写，无外部依赖，支持 Docker 部署，集成 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect 用于 2FA/SSO。
zh.hot: 凭借无需客户端的透明代理架构和内置会话录制等企业级功能，在 Rust 趋势榜上排名第 3，star 数达 7473，持续吸引安全运维与基础设施团队关注。
uses: 安全团队：集中管理 SSH/数据库访问并审计会话
运维人员：通过浏览器或原生客户端安全访问内网资源
Kubernetes 管理员：为集群提供统一入口与权限控制
需要符合合规要求的企业：利用 2FA/SSO 和登录保护

en.tag: Transparent SSH/HTTPS/K8s/DB bastion, no client needed
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host/PAM solution supporting SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC. It requires no client software or SSH wrapper, can be deployed in the DMZ, and includes session recording, browser-based access, 2FA/SSO, and brute-force protection.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary with an admin web UI, built-in SSH/RDP/VNC clients, session recording and replay, plus comprehensive docs and Docker support.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust with no dependencies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates TOTP and OpenID Connect for 2FA/SSO.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on Rust trending with 7.4k stars, its clientless transparent proxy and enterprise features like session recording attract security and infra teams.
uses: Security teams: centrally manage SSH/DB access and audit sessions
Ops: securely access internal resources via browser or native clients
K8s admins: unified entry and access control for clusters
Compliance-focused enterprises: leverage 2FA/SSO and login protection

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。

隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.

en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.

Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: Rust 异步运行时，构建可靠、高性能异步应用
zh.what: Tokio 是一个事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 的异步运行时，用于编写可靠、异步、精简的 Rust 应用。它提供多线程工作窃取调度器、基于操作系统事件队列的 reactor，以及异步 TCP/UDP 套接字等核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时核心库、调度器、reactor、网络模块、定时器等，以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖操作系统事件队列（epoll、kqueue、IOCP 等），提供异步 I/O 和并发原语。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中最流行的异步运行时，Tokio 凭借零成本抽象和高性能，成为构建网络服务的基石，持续获得大量关注。
uses: Rust 开发者构建高性能网络服务（如 Web 服务器、代理、数据库客户端）
需要异步 I/O 和并发处理的应用，如聊天系统、实时数据处理
学习 Rust 异步编程和运行时原理的开发者

en.tag: Rust async runtime for building reliable, high-performance async apps
en.what: Tokio is an event-driven, non-blocking I/O runtime for writing reliable, asynchronous, and slim applications in Rust. It provides a multithreaded work-stealing scheduler, a reactor backed by OS event queues, and async TCP/UDP sockets.
en.content: The repo contains the runtime core library, scheduler, reactor, networking modules, timers, and extensive examples and documentation.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages OS event queues (epoll, kqueue, IOCP), provides async I/O and concurrency primitives.
en.hot: As the most popular async runtime in the Rust ecosystem, Tokio's zero-cost abstractions and high performance make it a cornerstone for building network services, consistently attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers building high-performance network services (web servers, proxies, database clients)
Applications needing async I/O and concurrency, like chat systems, real-time data processing
Developers learning Rust async programming and runtime internals

zh.tag: 面向智能体 AI 的实时事件流处理平台
zh.what: RisingWave 是一个专为智能体 AI 设计的事件流处理平台，能够持续从数据库、事件流和 Webhook 摄取数据，进行增量处理，并以低延迟提供最新结果。它用一个系统替代了传统的 Debezium + Kafka + Flink + 数据库的组合。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 实现的流处理引擎，提供 SQL 接口统一处理流和表，支持多种数据源（Webhook、CDC、Kafka 等）和增量计算，还包含文档、演示和基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Kafka、Pulsar、Kinesis 等消息系统，以及 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库的 CDC 连接器。
zh.hot: 随着智能体 AI 对实时数据的需求激增，RisingWave 以单一系统替代复杂事件流栈，简化架构并降低延迟，因此在 GitHub 上受到广泛关注，周榜排名第 18。
uses: 智能体 AI 开发者：需要实时数据流和低延迟查询来驱动 AI 代理的决策。
数据工程师：希望简化事件流处理架构，避免维护多套系统。
实时应用团队：构建需要毫秒级新鲜度的仪表盘或监控系统。
