en.stack: Written in Go, requires GitHub CLI (gh) v2.0+, installed via `gh extension install`.
en.hot: Gained 541 stars this week (total 1139), ranking #6 on GitHub Trending (Go). It addresses the pain of large PR reviews and supports AI agent integration, drawing developer attention.
uses: Teams working on large features that want to split changes into reviewable PRs
Developers who need frequent rebasing and branch management
Developers using AI coding agents (e.g., Copilot) that can integrate via skill
Open-source maintainers who want to streamline contribution workflows

zh.tag: 基于 HTTP 的轻量级 pub-sub 消息推送服务，支持自托管
zh.what: ntfy 是一个基于 HTTP 的 pub-sub 通知服务，允许用户通过简单的 PUT/POST 请求从任何脚本或计算机向手机、桌面推送实时通知。它无需注册账号或支付费用即可使用官方托管服务，同时也支持完全开源的自托管部署，满足隐私与定制化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端核心与 Web 前端，并配合独立维护的开源 Android 与 iOS 客户端应用，形成端到端的推送生态。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Go 构建高性能 HTTP API，默认采用 SQLite 存储消息与订阅状态；客户端覆盖 Android、iOS 及 PWA 多平台。
zh.hot: 凭借「一行 curl 即可推送」的极简体验和完全开源可自托管的特性，ntfy 已获得近 3.2 万 Star，本月新增 1195 Star，跻身 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 8，成为开发者最喜爱的轻量消息基础设施之一。
uses: DevOps / SRE —— 将服务器告警、CI/CD 流水线结果实时推送到手机
开发者 / 极客 —— 脚本执行完毕、定时任务完成时接收桌面或移动端通知
隐私敏感用户 —— 通过自托管实例替代商业推送服务，掌控数据主权
IoT / 家庭自动化 —— 将设备状态、智能家居事件推送到家庭成员终端

en.tag: Lightweight HTTP pub-sub notification service with self-hosting support
en.what: ntfy is a simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service that lets you send real-time alerts to your phone or desktop via PUT/POST requests from any script or computer. It requires no sign-up or fees to use the hosted instance, and being fully open source, it also supports self-hosting for privacy and customization.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based server core and web frontend, complemented by separate open-source Android and iOS clients, forming an end-to-end push ecosystem.
en.stack: The backend is built in Go for a high-performance HTTP API, using SQLite by default for message and subscription storage, with clients available for Android, iOS, and PWA.
en.hot: With its 'one-line curl to push' simplicity and fully open-source, self-hostable nature, ntfy has earned nearly 32k stars, gaining 1,195 this month and ranking 8th on GitHub's Go monthly trending list as a favorite lightweight messaging infra tool.
uses: DevOps / SRE —— Push server alerts and CI/CD pipeline results to mobile in real time
Developers / Geeks —— Get notified on phone or desktop when scripts or cron jobs finish
Privacy-conscious users —— Self-host to replace commercial push services and retain data sovereignty
IoT / Home automation —— Push device status and smart-home events to family members' devices

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心框架、命令行界面、Web 图形界面以及 REST API 文档，支持通过外部 API、电话簿和搜索引擎进行 OSINT 足迹收集，并检查信誉报告、社交媒体和一次性号码等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，提供 REST API 和 Go 模块供编程使用，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了 Swagger 文档。
zh.hot: 尽管项目已停止维护，但因其强大的 OSINT 功能和易用性，仍保持 17k+ 星标，今日新增 29 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 14 名，说明社区对其需求依然旺盛。
uses: 安全研究人员进行电话号码情报收集
调查记者验证电话号码相关信息
渗透测试人员辅助社会工程学攻击前侦察
普通用户查询陌生号码的基本信息

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: Despite being unmaintained, its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use keep it at 17k+ stars, with 29 new stars today, ranking #14 on Go trending, showing sustained community demand.
uses: Security researchers for phone number intelligence gathering
Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

zh.tag: Kubernetes 的包管理器，像 apt/yum 一样管理应用
zh.what: Helm 是用于管理 Kubernetes 应用程序的工具，通过 Charts 打包预配置的 Kubernetes 资源。它简化了 Kubernetes 应用的安装、升级和管理，类似于 Linux 中的包管理器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Helm 的源代码、文档、测试和示例 Charts。核心是 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，支持模板渲染、发布管理和仓库交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API 和模板引擎。支持多种安装方式，包括二进制、Homebrew、Chocolatey 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 生态的标配工具，拥有 3 万+ Star，本月新增 189，持续活跃。v4 稳定版发布，v3 维护至 2026 年，社区关注度高。
uses: Kubernetes 开发者：快速打包和部署应用
DevOps 工程师：管理复杂应用的生命周期
平台团队：标准化应用交付和配置管理

en.tag: The Kubernetes package manager, like apt/yum for K8s apps
en.what: Helm is a tool for managing Kubernetes applications by packaging pre-configured resources as Charts. It streamlines installing, upgrading, and managing K8s apps, akin to a package manager for Kubernetes.
en.content: The repo contains Helm's source code, docs, tests, and example charts. Core is a Go CLI for templating, release management, and repo interactions.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API and templating. Supports multiple installation methods: binaries, Homebrew, Chocolatey, etc.
en.hot: As a standard tool in the K8s ecosystem, it has 30k+ stars, +189 this month, and remains active. v4 stable release and v3 support until 2026 keep community interest high.
uses: K8s developers: quickly package and deploy apps
DevOps engineers: manage complex app lifecycles
Platform teams: standardize app delivery and config management

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 后端、Web 前端（看板界面）、文档（README、自托管指南、愿景）、以及用于集成 20 种代理 CLI 的运行时适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建后端，前端为 Web 应用，支持多种代理 CLI 的集成，自托管部署。
zh.hot: 44.5k stars 且单日新增 274，登上 Go 趋势榜第二，因为解决了多代理协作中上下文丢失和重复解释的痛点，将代理真正纳入团队流程。
uses: 开发者团队：统一管理多个编码代理，减少切换和重复沟通成本
技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果
自托管用户：对数据隐私有要求，希望完全掌控代理运行环境

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: AI 工程化开源控制平面，编排跨工具工作流
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个用于 AI 驱动工程的开源自动化引擎，可跨 Git、LLM、CI/CD、可观测性、事件响应和基础设施等工具编排工程工作流，提供持久执行、审批和操作界面。它确定性执行流程，为人类和 AI 提供安全交互所需的护栏。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、CLI、文档和示例，核心概念包括应用（Apps）、画布（Canvases）、组件（Components）和事件触发。提供自托管和云服务两种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Git 进行版本控制，集成 LLM、CI/CD、可观测性等工具，支持 webhooks、调度和事件触发。
zh.hot: 本周新增 436 星，总星数达 4792，位列 Go 周榜第 11。作为开源 AI 代理控制平面，填补了 AI 工程自动化编排的空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要为代理提供安全护栏和审批流程的团队
平台工程团队：希望统一编排跨 Git、CI/CD、可观测性等工具的工作流
DevOps 工程师：需要持久执行和人工审批的复杂自动化场景
技术领导者：评估 AI 工程自动化平台，用于内部工具链集成

en.tag: Open-source control plane for agentic engineering, orchestrating workflows across tools
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source automation engine for AI-driven engineering, orchestrating engineering workflows across tools like Git, LLMs, CI/CD, observability, incident tools, and infrastructure, with durable execution, approvals, and an operational UI. It executes processes deterministically, providing guardrails for safe human-AI interaction.
en.content: The repo contains the core engine, CLI, docs, and examples, with core concepts like Apps, Canvases, Components, and event triggers. It offers self-hosted and cloud deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on Git for versioning, integrates with LLMs, CI/CD, observability tools, and supports webhooks, schedules, and event triggers.
en.hot: Gained 436 stars this week, reaching 4792 total, ranking 11th on the Go weekly trending. As an open-source control plane for AI agents, it fills a gap in AI engineering orchestration, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI agent developers: teams needing guardrails and approval workflows for agents
Platform engineering teams: wanting to orchestrate workflows across Git, CI/CD, observability, etc.
DevOps engineers: complex automation requiring durable execution and human approvals
Tech leaders: evaluating AI engineering automation platforms for internal toolchain integration

zh.tag: 开源中间人攻击框架，绕过双因素认证的钓鱼神器
zh.what: Evilginx2 是一个独立的中间人攻击框架，用于钓鱼登录凭证和会话 Cookie，从而绕过双因素认证。它通过代理浏览器与目标网站之间的流量，实时窃取敏感信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Evilginx 3.0 的完整源代码，使用 Go 编写，实现了自己的 HTTP 和 DNS 服务器，无需额外依赖。还包含官方 phishlets 数据库、文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Go 标准库和部分第三方库，支持 SQLite 数据库存储。
zh.hot: 作为经典的渗透测试工具，长期受到安全社区关注，本周新增 53 星，总星数达 15439，位列 Go 周榜第 12。
uses: 渗透测试人员：在授权测试中模拟钓鱼攻击，评估组织安全性
安全研究人员：研究钓鱼攻击手法和防御措施
红队成员：用于演练和验证安全防护的有效性
安全意识培训：演示双因素认证的弱点，提高用户警惕

en.tag: Open-source MITM framework for phishing credentials and bypassing 2FA
en.what: Evilginx2 is a standalone man-in-the-middle attack framework used for phishing login credentials and session cookies, allowing bypass of 2-factor authentication. It proxies traffic between the browser and the target site to steal sensitive data in real time.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Evilginx 3.0, written in Go, with its own HTTP and DNS server, requiring no extra dependencies. It also includes an official phishlets database, documentation, and configuration examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relying on the Go standard library and some third-party libraries, with SQLite database support.
en.hot: As a classic penetration testing tool, it has long been popular in the security community, gaining 53 stars this week, reaching 15,439 total, ranking 12th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Penetration testers: simulate phishing attacks in authorized tests to assess security
Security researchers: study phishing techniques and defenses
Red team members: use in exercises to validate security controls
Security awareness training: demonstrate 2FA weaknesses to raise user vigilance

zh.tag: Git 版数据库，可分支合并的 SQL 数据版本控制
zh.what: Dolt 是一个 SQL 数据库，支持像 Git 仓库一样进行 fork、clone、branch、merge、push 和 pull。你可以像连接 MySQL 一样连接 Dolt，并通过 SQL 或 Git 风格的命令行管理数据和 schema 的版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dolt 的完整源代码，包括 CLI、SQL 服务器、存储引擎以及相关文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，兼容 MySQL 协议，并支持与 Git 类似的命令行操作。
zh.hot: Dolt 将 Git 的版本控制能力引入数据库，解决了数据协作和追踪的痛点，在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，本周新增 89 星，总星数达 24k+。
uses: 数据科学家和数据分析师：用于追踪数据集变更，便于复现分析结果。
软件开发者：在应用开发中管理数据库 schema 迁移和测试数据。
团队协作：多人同时编辑数据库，通过分支和合并解决冲突。
AI 代理记忆：作为多智能体工作流中的共享状态存储。

en.tag: Git for Data: a SQL database with fork, clone, branch, merge, push, pull
en.what: Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a Git repository. Connect to it like any MySQL database to read or modify schema and data, with version control exposed via SQL and a Git-like CLI.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for Dolt, including the CLI, SQL server, storage engine, and related documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, MySQL-compatible, with a Git-like command-line interface.
en.hot: Dolt brings Git-like version control to databases, solving data collaboration and tracking pain points. It gained 89 stars this week, reaching 24k+ total stars.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: track dataset changes for reproducible analysis.
Software developers: manage database schema migrations and test data in app development.
Team collaboration: multiple people edit a database concurrently, resolving conflicts via branches and merges.
AI agent memory: as shared state storage in multi-agent workflows.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: K8s 全生命周期安全平台，从开发到运行时的防护
zh.what: Kubescape 是一个开源的 Kubernetes 安全平台，覆盖 IDE、CI/CD 流水线和集群，提供风险分析、安全合规和错误配置扫描。它帮助用户节省时间、精力和资源，确保集群安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubescape CLI 工具、扫描器、策略框架、运行时安全组件以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API、OCI 镜像、ARMO 策略等。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 孵化项目，Kubescape 提供全面的安全覆盖，star 数持续增长，本周新增 22 星，位列 Go 周榜第 21 名。
uses: Kubernetes 管理员：用于集群安全合规和错误配置扫描。
DevOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流水线进行安全左移。
安全团队：进行风险分析和运行时安全监控。
开发者：在 IDE 中快速检查 Kubernetes 配置安全。

en.tag: Comprehensive Kubernetes security platform from dev to runtime
en.what: Kubescape is an open-source Kubernetes security platform covering IDE, CI/CD pipelines, and clusters, offering risk analysis, security compliance, and misconfiguration scanning. It saves users time, effort, and resources while ensuring cluster security.
en.content: The repo contains the Kubescape CLI tool, scanners, policy framework, runtime security components, and documentation/examples.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API, OCI images, ARMO policies, etc.
en.hot: As a CNCF incubating project, Kubescape offers comprehensive security coverage, with steady star growth, adding 22 stars this week and ranking 21st on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Kubernetes administrators: for cluster security compliance and misconfiguration scanning.
DevOps engineers: integrate into CI/CD pipelines for shift-left security.
Security teams: for risk analysis and runtime security monitoring.
Developers: quick security checks on Kubernetes configs in IDE.

zh.tag: 自托管 Web 应用防火墙，保护应用免受攻击
zh.what: SafeLine 是一个自托管的 Web 应用防火墙（WAF）和反向代理，用于保护 Web 应用免受各种攻击和漏洞利用。它通过过滤和监控 Web 应用与互联网之间的 HTTP 流量，防御 SQL 注入、XSS、代码注入、RCE 等常见威胁。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 WAF 实现，包括核心引擎、管理界面、文档和示例配置。提供 Docker 镜像，支持快速部署，并配有详细的安装指南和中文文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，可能涉及 Nginx 或类似反向代理技术。
zh.hot: 作为自托管 WAF 的领先项目，SafeLine 在 GitHub 上获得了 22k+ 星标，并多次登上 Trending 榜首，本周新增 282 星。其易用性和强大功能吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队：为自建网站或应用提供简单易用的安全防护。
企业安全团队：部署在内部或云环境，保护关键 Web 应用免受攻击。
DevOps 工程师：作为 CI/CD 流程中的安全层，自动拦截恶意流量。

en.tag: Self-hosted WAF / reverse proxy to protect web apps from attacks
en.what: SafeLine is a self-hosted Web Application Firewall (WAF) and reverse proxy that protects web apps from attacks and exploits. It filters and monitors HTTP traffic between a web application and the Internet, defending against SQL injection, XSS, code injection, RCE, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full WAF implementation, including core engine, management UI, documentation, and example configurations. Docker images are provided for quick deployment, along with detailed installation guides and Chinese documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Docker for containerized deployment, possibly integrating with Nginx or similar reverse proxy technologies.
en.hot: As a leading self-hosted WAF, SafeLine has gained 22k+ stars on GitHub and topped the Trending charts multiple times, with 282 new stars this week. Its ease of use and powerful features attract many developers.
uses: Individual developers or small teams: provide easy-to-use security protection for self-hosted websites or apps.
Enterprise security teams: deploy in internal or cloud environments to protect critical web applications.
DevOps engineers: integrate as a security layer in CI/CD pipelines to automatically block malicious traffic.

zh.tag: 大规模 AI 代理的高密度运行时与生命周期管理平台
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 AI 代理部署提供高性能、高密度运行时的系统。它通过控制平面管理代理沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量代理复用映射到少量物理节点上。该系统基于 Kubernetes 构建，提供代理专用的调度和控制，以实现低延迟和高资源利用率。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心系统实现，提供控制平面、沙箱管理（支持 microVM 和 gVisor）、生命周期操作（创建/销毁、挂起/恢复）、实时工作节点分配和流量路由。还包含一个演示，展示约 250 个有状态 actor 在 8 个物理 Pod 上的多路复用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes（Pods 和 Pod 自动扩缩容）进行基础设施供应和工作节点生命周期管理，支持多种沙箱技术（microVM、gVisor）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 89 颗星，总星数达 1048，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 语言周榜）第 17 名。其高密度复用和亚秒级恢复能力解决了 AI 代理部署中的关键成本与延迟问题，吸引了基础设施开发者的关注。
uses: AI 代理平台开发者：需要大规模运行和管理有状态代理，降低基础设施成本。
基础设施工程师：希望基于 Kubernetes 构建高密度、低延迟的代理运行时。
强化学习（RL）场景：需要统一管理代理、推理和训练周期的团队。
研究机构：探索代理复用和资源优化技术的研究人员。

en.tag: High-density runtime & lifecycle management for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime for large-scale AI agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared infrastructure. Built on Kubernetes, it offers agent-specific scheduling and control for low latency and high resource efficiency.
en.content: The repo contains the core system implementation, including a control plane, sandbox management (supporting microVMs and gVisor), lifecycle operations (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time worker assignment, and traffic routing. It also includes a demo showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and Pod autoscaling) for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Gained 89 stars this week, reaching 1048 total and ranking #17 on GitHub Trending (Go weekly). Its high-density multiplexing and sub-second resume capabilities address key cost and latency issues in AI agent deployment, attracting infrastructure developers.
uses: AI agent platform developers: needing to run and manage stateful agents at scale with reduced infrastructure costs.
Infrastructure engineers: looking to build high-density, low-latency agent runtimes on Kubernetes.
Reinforcement learning (RL) teams: requiring unified management across agentic, inference, and training cycles.
Research institutions: exploring agent multiplexing and resource optimization techniques.

zh.tag: 高性能命令行模糊搜索工具与交互式终端应用框架
zh.what: fzf 是一个通用的命令行模糊查找器，能够在海量数据中通过模糊匹配快速定位目标。它既可以作为独立的文件、历史记录搜索工具，也可通过事件驱动架构嵌入脚本，构建丰富的交互式终端应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的单二进制可执行文件源码，以及针对 Bash、Zsh、Fish、Nushell、Vim 和 Neovim 的即用型集成脚本与插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，编译为无依赖的独立二进制文件；通过事件驱动架构提供可编程接口，并原生支持主流 Shell 与编辑器生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 81K+ Star 和月增 1,121 Star 的势头，fzf 已成为终端效率工具的标杆；其毫秒级检索速度、零依赖部署以及对全平台 Shell 和编辑器的深度集成，让它在开发者群体中经久不衰。
uses: 终端重度用户 —— 快速模糊定位文件、目录与命令历史，替代传统 grep/find 交互。
Shell 效率极客 —— 通过键盘驱动的工作流，在 Bash/Zsh/Fish 中构建自定义模糊菜单。
Vim/Neovim 用户 —— 作为编辑器插件实现文件、Buffer、LSP 符号等模糊搜索。
运维与 DevOps 工程师 —— 在日志、进程、K8s 资源等海量文本中秒级定位目标。

en.tag: A blazing-fast command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit
en.what: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder that lets you rapidly locate items in massive datasets using fuzzy matching. It works as a standalone tool for searching files and command history, and its event-driven architecture allows embedding into scripts to build rich interactive terminal applications.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for a single Go binary, along with ready-to-use integration scripts and plugins for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, Vim, and Neovim.
en.stack: Written in Go and distributed as a self-contained, dependency-free binary. It exposes a programmable, event-driven interface and natively integrates with major shells and editors.
en.hot: With 81K+ stars and 1,121 new stars this month, fzf is a benchmark for terminal productivity; its millisecond-level search speed, zero-dependency deployment, and deep integration across all major shells and editors make it a perennial favorite among developers.
uses: Power terminal users — Fuzzy-locate files, directories, and command history at speed, replacing traditional grep/find interactions.
Shell efficiency enthusiasts — Build custom fuzzy menus and keyboard-driven workflows in Bash, Zsh, Fish, or Nushell.
Vim/Neovim users — Use as an editor plugin for fuzzy searching files, buffers, LSP symbols, and more.
Ops & DevOps engineers — Instantly pinpoint targets in massive logs, processes, or Kubernetes resources.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理和 IDE 打造的高性能代码智能引擎
zh.what: Gortex 是一个高性能的代码智能引擎，将代码索引成图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 暴露给 AI 代理和 IDE。它支持 257 种语言和多仓库，能显著减少 AI 编码代理的 token 消耗（最高 50 倍）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心引擎、tree-sitter 解析器、编译器级解析器（针对多种语言）、175 个可配置的 MCP 工具、CLI 和 Web UI，以及文档和基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法解析，支持多种编译器级解析器，生成持久化的知识图谱。
zh.hot: 本周新增 109 颗星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Go 语言）。其亮点是能大幅降低 AI 编码代理的 token 消耗（最高 50 倍），且完全本地化、零依赖，支持 19 种编码代理。
uses: AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）的开发者，希望减少 token 消耗并提升代码理解能力。
IDE 用户，需要高效的代码导航和智能提示。
大型多仓库项目团队，需要跨服务的调用链和契约分析。

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDE
en.what: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine that indexes code into a graph and exposes it via CLI, MCP Server, and Web UI for AI agents and IDEs. It supports 257 languages and multiple repositories, reducing token usage for AI coding agents by up to 50x.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based core engine, tree-sitter parsers, compiler-grade resolvers for multiple languages, 175 configurable MCP tools, CLI and Web UI, along with documentation and benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, uses tree-sitter for syntax parsing, supports compiler-grade resolvers, and generates a persistent knowledge graph.
en.hot: Gained 109 stars this week, trending on GitHub (Go). Its key appeal is reducing token usage for AI coding agents by up to 50x, fully local, zero dependencies, and supporting 19 coding agents.
uses: Developers of AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) seeking to reduce token usage and improve code understanding.
IDE users needing efficient code navigation and intelligent suggestions.
Teams working on large multi-repository projects requiring cross-service call chains and contract analysis.

zh.tag: 网络侦察与中间人攻击的瑞士军刀
zh.what: bettercap 是一个用 Go 编写的强大、易扩展且可移植的框架，旨在为安全研究人员、红队和逆向工程师提供一站式解决方案，用于对 WiFi、蓝牙低功耗（BLE）、CAN 总线、无线 HID 设备和以太网网络进行侦察和中间人（MITM）攻击。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 bettercap 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Linux/macOS/Windows）、Docker 镜像、模块化文档（如 WiFi、BLE、CAN-bus 等模块），以及一个基于 Web 的用户界面（UI）用于实时事件展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 libpcap 等网络库，支持跨平台编译，并提供 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 作为一款功能全面的网络攻击与侦察工具，bettercap 在安全社区广受欢迎，拥有近 2 万 Star，本周新增 185 个，持续位列 GitHub Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于渗透测试和漏洞验证，快速评估网络安全性。
红队成员：在授权评估中执行中间人攻击和网络侦察。
网络安全爱好者：学习网络协议和攻击原理，提升技能。
物联网开发者：测试 BLE 和 CAN-bus 设备的安全性。

en.tag: Swiss Army knife for network recon and MITM attacks
en.what: bettercap is a powerful, easily extensible and portable framework written in Go, offering security researchers, red teamers and reverse engineers an easy-to-use, all-in-one solution for reconnaissance and MITM attacks on WiFi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), CAN-bus, wireless HID devices and Ethernet networks.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of bettercap, cross-platform build configurations (Linux/macOS/Windows), Docker images, modular documentation (e.g., WiFi, BLE, CAN-bus modules), and a web-based UI for real-time event visualization.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on network libraries like libpcap, supports cross-platform compilation, and offers Docker containerized deployment.
en.hot: As a comprehensive network attack and recon tool, bettercap is highly popular in the security community, with nearly 20k stars, adding 185 this week, consistently ranking on GitHub's Go trending list.
uses: Security researchers: for penetration testing and vulnerability validation to quickly assess network security.
Red teamers: to perform MITM attacks and network recon during authorized assessments.
Cybersecurity enthusiasts: to learn network protocols and attack principles, enhancing skills.
IoT developers: to test the security of BLE and CAN-bus devices.

zh.tag: 轻量 Docker VPN 客户端，支持多供应商与代理
zh.what: Gluetun 是一个用 Go 编写的轻量级 Docker 容器 VPN 客户端，支持多种 VPN 服务提供商，使用 OpenVPN 或 WireGuard 协议，并内置 DNS over TLS 和多个代理服务器。它旨在作为瑞士军刀式的工具，方便用户快速连接 VPN 并管理网络流量。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源代码、Dockerfile、CI 配置、文档和 Wiki 链接，以及用于构建和发布的自动化脚本。项目结构清晰，包含命令行入口、VPN 客户端逻辑、代理服务器实现和 DNS 配置模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 OpenVPN 和 WireGuard 协议，集成 DNS over TLS 和 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理。Docker 镜像基于 Alpine Linux，保持轻量。
zh.hot: Gluetun 因其轻量、多供应商支持和内置代理而广受欢迎，本周新增 95 星，总星数达 15102，位列 Go 周榜第三。其即将迁移到新组织并保持镜像名称不变，也引发了社区关注。
uses: 自托管用户：想要在 Docker 中轻松连接 VPN 并管理多个供应商的用户。
隐私爱好者：需要 DNS over TLS 和代理功能以增强隐私保护的用户。
开发运维：在容器化环境中集成 VPN 客户端，用于测试或生产环境。
网络管理员：需要统一管理多个 VPN 连接和代理服务的场景。

en.tag: Lightweight Docker VPN client for multiple providers with built-in proxies
en.what: Gluetun is a lightweight Docker container VPN client written in Go, supporting multiple VPN providers via OpenVPN or WireGuard, with DNS over TLS and several built-in proxy servers. It acts as a Swiss-army-knife for VPN connections, simplifying network traffic management.
en.content: The repository includes complete Go source code, Dockerfile, CI configuration, documentation, and links to the wiki, along with automation scripts for building and releasing. The project is well-structured with CLI entry, VPN client logic, proxy server implementation, and DNS configuration modules.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging OpenVPN and WireGuard protocols, with DNS over TLS and HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies. Docker images are based on Alpine Linux for minimal footprint.
en.hot: Gluetun is popular for its lightweight design, multi-provider support, and built-in proxies, gaining 95 stars this week to reach 15,102, ranking #3 on the Go weekly trending. The upcoming migration to a new org with unchanged image names also draws community attention.
uses: Self-hosters: users who want an easy VPN client in Docker with multi-provider support.
Privacy enthusiasts: those needing DNS over TLS and proxies for enhanced privacy.
DevOps: integrating a VPN client in containerized environments for testing or production.
Network admins: managing multiple VPN connections and proxy services in one tool.

zh.tag: K8s 异构 GPU 共享与虚拟化调度中间件
zh.what: HAMi 是一个 Kubernetes 原生中间件，用于 GPU 和其他 AI 加速器的虚拟化与共享。它允许平台团队将物理 GPU 切分为多个虚拟设备，按需分配给不同 Pod，并实现设备内存与算力的隔离，同时支持多种加速器厂商的设备感知调度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 HAMi 的核心代码、架构图、多语言 README（中/英/日）、部署清单、设备插件与调度器组件，以及 CNCF 孵化项目相关的文档和徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 的 device plugin 和调度器扩展机制，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Ascend 等多种 GPU 厂商。
zh.hot: HAMi 是 CNCF 孵化项目，本月新增 582 星，总星数 4248，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。它解决了 AI 基础设施中 GPU 利用率低、厂商锁定等痛点，受到云原生社区广泛关注。
uses: 平台团队：在 Kubernetes 集群中共享 GPU，提高利用率并降低成本
AI 基础设施工程师：为多租户环境实现设备隔离与公平调度
云原生开发者：集成异构加速器（NVIDIA/AMD/Ascend）到 K8s 工作负载
研究机构：在有限 GPU 资源上运行多个实验或训练任务

en.tag: K8s-native heterogeneous GPU sharing & virtualization middleware
en.what: HAMi is a Kubernetes-native middleware for virtualizing and sharing GPUs and other AI accelerators. It enables platform teams to partition physical GPUs into multiple virtual devices, allocate them to pods on demand, and isolate device memory and compute, while supporting device-aware scheduling across multiple accelerator vendors.
en.content: The repo contains HAMi's core code, architecture diagrams, multi-language READMEs (EN/CN/JA), deployment manifests, device plugin and scheduler components, plus CNCF incubating project docs and badges.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging Kubernetes device plugin and scheduler extender mechanisms, supporting multiple GPU vendors like NVIDIA, AMD, and Ascend.
en.hot: HAMi is a CNCF incubating project, gaining 582 stars this month (total 4248) and trending on GitHub. It addresses pain points like low GPU utilization and vendor lock-in in AI infrastructure, drawing wide attention from the cloud-native community.
uses: Platform teams: share GPUs across K8s clusters to boost utilization and cut costs
AI infra engineers: implement device isolation and fair scheduling for multi-tenant environments
Cloud-native developers: integrate heterogeneous accelerators (NVIDIA/AMD/Ascend) into K8s workloads
Research institutions: run multiple experiments or training jobs on limited GPU resources

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gh 的完整源码、安装脚本、文档以及用于编码代理的 Agent skill。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方 CLI，拥有 45k+ Star，是开发者日常高频使用的工具。今日新增 16 Star，持续活跃。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中快速管理 GitHub 仓库、PR、Issue 等
DevOps 工程师 —— 集成到 CI/CD 脚本中自动化 GitHub 操作
编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.
en.hot: As the official GitHub CLI, it has over 45k stars and is a daily essential for developers. It gained 16 stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Developers — manage GitHub repos, PRs, issues quickly from the terminal
DevOps engineers — automate GitHub operations in CI/CD scripts
Coding agents — use the Agent skill to let AI agents invoke gh commands

zh.tag: 轻量级多实例 qBittorrent Web 管理界面
zh.what: qui 是一个快速、现代的 qBittorrent Web 界面，支持从单个轻量级应用管理多个 qBittorrent 实例。它提供跨种、自动化规则、备份恢复等功能，优化了大型种子集合的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码，提供 Linux、Docker 和 macOS 的安装方式，以及多语言支持（含简体中文）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，编译为单一二进制文件，无外部依赖。
zh.hot: 因其轻量、多实例管理和自动化功能受到欢迎，本周新增 50 星，总星数达 4333，位列 Go 周榜第 23 名。
uses: qBittorrent 用户：希望统一管理多个实例的下载任务。
PT 玩家：需要跨站自动辅种，提升上传量。
自动化爱好者：通过规则和自动化简化种子管理流程。

en.tag: A fast, single-binary web UI for managing multiple qBittorrent instances
en.what: qui is a fast, modern web interface for qBittorrent, allowing you to manage multiple qBittorrent instances from a single lightweight application. It offers cross-seeding, automation rules, backup and restore, and is optimized for large torrent collections.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the web app, with installation methods for Linux, Docker, and macOS, and multi-language support including Simplified Chinese.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, compiled into a single binary with no external dependencies.
en.hot: It's popular for its lightweight design, multi-instance management, and automation features, gaining 50 stars this week to reach 4333 total, ranking 23rd on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: qBittorrent users: want to manage multiple instances' download tasks in one place.
Private tracker users: need automatic cross-seeding to boost upload ratio.
Automation enthusiasts: simplify torrent management with rules and automations.

zh.tag: Agent Skills 的评估与进化工具
zh.what: skill-up 是一个用于评估和进化 Agent Skills 的工具。它通过声明式 YAML 用例在多个 Agent 引擎上运行评估，支持规则、脚本或 Agent 评判，并生成结构化报告。它还通过对话驱动的 skill-upper 自动修复和扩展评估套件，形成评估到进化的闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具、YAML 配置示例、文档（用户手册、设计文档）以及用于展示评估与进化流程的图表。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.25+，支持多 Agent 引擎（Qoder CLI、Claude Code、Codex 及自定义），使用 YAML 配置，输出多种报告格式（JSON、JUnit XML、HTML）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 117 星，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 周榜第 24）。它填补了 Agent Skills 评估与自动迭代的空白，由阿里出品，吸引开发者关注。
uses: Agent 开发者：需要量化评估和持续改进 Agent Skills 的团队或个人
AI 工程师：在 CI 中集成评估，确保 Skill 质量可重复
研究者：探索 Agent 能力的自动进化与迭代方法

en.tag: Evaluation and evolution tool for Agent Skills
en.what: skill-up is a tool for evaluating and evolving Agent Skills. It runs declarative YAML cases across multiple Agent engines, supports rule, script, or Agent judges, and produces structured reports. It also uses a conversation-driven skill-upper to automatically repair and expand the eval suite, closing the loop from evaluation to evolution.

uses: 安全团队：用于端点检测与响应（EDR）、入侵检测和合规审计，通过 SQL 快速查询系统状态。
DevOps/运维：监控服务器健康、排查性能问题，并自动化收集系统信息。
开发人员：利用表 API 编写自定义插件，扩展 osquery 功能以适配特定场景。
取证分析：在数字取证中快速提取系统快照，辅助事件调查。

en.tag: SQL-powered OS instrumentation, monitoring, and analytics framework
en.what: osquery exposes the operating system as a high-performance relational database, allowing users to query system data like processes, network connections, and kernel modules via SQL. It supports Linux, macOS, and Windows, and is widely used for security monitoring, compliance, and troubleshooting.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of osquery, including the core daemon, interactive query shell (osqueryi), command-line tool (osqueryd), table implementations, plugin and extension APIs, along with documentation and build configurations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, and integrates third-party libraries like Boost, SQLite, and Google Test. It supports cross-platform compilation and offers a rich table API for extension.
en.hot: As a benchmark project in security monitoring and system analysis, osquery has 23k+ stars, popular for its powerful SQL query capabilities and cross-platform support. It gained 23 stars this week, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Security teams: for endpoint detection and response (EDR), intrusion detection, and compliance audits, quickly querying system state via SQL.
DevOps/SysAdmins: to monitor server health, troubleshoot performance issues, and automate system information collection.
Developers: to write custom plugins using the table API, extending osquery for specific use cases.
Forensics analysts: to quickly extract system snapshots for incident investigation.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 开发的 C++ 测试框架，提供单元测试、模拟对象和丰富的断言。它支持自动测试发现、死亡测试、参数化测试等特性，是 C++ 社区最广泛使用的测试工具之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的合并源码、构建系统（CMake/Bazel）、文档和示例。目录结构包括 googletest（核心框架）、googlemock（模拟库）和 docs（文档）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖 C++17 及以上标准（1.17.x 分支）。构建支持 CMake 和 Bazel，计划引入 Abseil 依赖。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 测试的行业标准，持续稳定更新（本周新增 45 star）。1.17.0 版本要求 C++17，吸引新用户关注。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 编写单元测试和集成测试
质量保证工程师 —— 自动化测试和持续集成
开源项目维护者 —— 为项目添加测试覆盖
教学场景 —— 学习 C++ 测试最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework providing unit testing, mocking, and a rich set of assertions. It supports automatic test discovery, death tests, parameterized tests, and is one of the most widely used testing tools in the C++ community.
en.content: The repository contains merged source code of GoogleTest and GoogleMock, build systems (CMake/Bazel), documentation, and examples. Directory structure includes googletest (core framework), googlemock (mocking library), and docs.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation, requires C++17 or later (1.17.x branch). Build supports CMake and Bazel, with planned dependency on Abseil.
en.hot: As the industry standard for C++ testing, it maintains steady updates (45 stars this week). The 1.17.0 release requires C++17, attracting new users.
uses: C++ developers — writing unit and integration tests
QA engineers — automated testing and CI
Open-source maintainers — adding test coverage to projects
Educational settings — learning C++ testing best practices

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，包括 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云服务、下载服务）以及推理管线的架构说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 管理状态，Hive 本地存储，Dio 网络请求，以及 Firebase 消息推送。本地推理依赖 Vulkan 加速。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 日榜（C++）排名第 5，今日新增 23 星，总星数 834。其亮点是同时支持本地离线运行和云端 API，且针对多种 Android 设备进行了图像生成测试，满足了用户对隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud service, download service), and architecture documentation for the inference pipeline.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 23 stars today and 834 total. Its appeal lies in combining local offline execution with cloud API fallback, tested on various Android devices for image generation, addressing privacy and flexibility needs.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without data leaving their device.
Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: 轻量级多协议命令行下载工具
zh.what: aria2 是一个轻量级、多协议、多来源的命令行下载工具，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、FTP、SFTP、BitTorrent 和 Metalink。它能够从多个来源或协议同时下载文件，并利用最大下载带宽，还支持将 HTTP/FTP/SFTP 下载的数据上传到 BitTorrent 群。
zh.content: 仓库包含 aria2 的完整源代码、构建配置、文档（在线手册）以及测试。主要组件包括命令行接口、下载引擎、协议支持（HTTP、FTP、SFTP、BitTorrent、Metalink）、JSON-RPC/XML-RPC 接口等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenSSL、libexpat、libxml2、zlib 等库，支持跨平台（Linux、Windows、macOS 等）。
zh.hot: 作为一款经典且高效的下载工具，aria2 拥有 4.1 万+ Star，本周新增 88 个，位列 C++ 周榜第 10。其强大的多协议支持和命令行效率使其在开发者中持续流行。
uses: 开发者/运维：在服务器或脚本中批量下载文件，支持断点续传和速度限制。
下载爱好者：结合前端工具（如 AriaNg）实现图形化下载管理，支持 BT 和磁力链接。
自动化场景：通过 JSON-RPC/XML-RPC 接口集成到自动化工作流中。

en.tag: Lightweight multi-protocol command-line download utility
en.what: aria2 is a lightweight, multi-protocol, multi-source command-line download utility supporting HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, BitTorrent, and Metalink. It can download files from multiple sources/protocols simultaneously, utilizing maximum bandwidth, and can upload data downloaded via HTTP/FTP/SFTP to the BitTorrent swarm.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build configuration, documentation (online manual), and tests for aria2. Key components include the command-line interface, download engine, protocol support (HTTP, FTP, SFTP, BitTorrent, Metalink), and JSON-RPC/XML-RPC interfaces.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libraries like OpenSSL, libexpat, libxml2, zlib, and supports cross-platform (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: As a classic and efficient download utility, aria2 has over 41k stars, with 88 new this week, ranking 10th on the C++ weekly trending. Its powerful multi-protocol support and command-line efficiency keep it popular among developers.
uses: Developers/DevOps: batch download files on servers or scripts, supporting resume and speed throttling.
Download enthusiasts: combine with front-end tools (e.g., AriaNg) for graphical download management, supporting BT and magnet links.
Automation scenarios: integrate into automated workflows via JSON-RPC/XML-RPC interfaces.

zh.tag: 开源最强国际象棋引擎，UCI 协议，支持 NNUE 神经网络评估
zh.what: Stockfish 是一个免费且强大的 UCI 国际象棋引擎，用于分析棋局并计算最佳走法。它不包含图形界面，需要配合第三方 GUI 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、Makefile 构建脚本、NNUE 神经网络权重文件，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种 CPU 架构和指令集，采用 NNUE 神经网络评估，通过 Fishtest 分布式测试框架进行性能测试。
zh.hot: 作为国际象棋引擎的标杆，持续保持顶级棋力，社区活跃，今日新增 7 星，总星数 16257，长期受到棋手和开发者的关注。
uses: 国际象棋爱好者：使用 Stockfish 分析棋局、提高棋艺
开发者：研究高性能 C++ 代码、NNUE 神经网络在棋类中的应用
研究者：用于 AI 博弈、搜索算法和评估函数的实验平台

en.tag: The strongest open-source UCI chess engine with NNUE evaluation
en.what: Stockfish is a free and strong UCI chess engine that analyzes chess positions and computes optimal moves. It does not include a GUI, requiring third-party interfaces for use.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, Makefile build scripts, NNUE neural network weights, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports various CPU architectures and instruction sets, uses NNUE neural network evaluation, and leverages the Fishtest distributed testing framework.
en.hot: As the benchmark of chess engines, it consistently maintains top-level strength, with an active community, gaining 7 stars today and 16,257 total, long appreciated by players and developers.
uses: Chess enthusiasts: analyze games and improve skills with Stockfish
Developers: study high-performance C++ and NNUE applications in chess
Researchers: use as a platform for AI game-playing, search algorithms, and evaluation functions

zh.tag: 最强开源围棋AI引擎，自对弈训练
zh.what: KataGo 是一个基于 AlphaZero 式自对弈训练的围棋 AI 引擎，能从零开始训练达到顶尖水平。它提供强大的棋力和分析功能，支持多种 GPU 加速后端，是围棋爱好者和开发者的重要工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源码、训练脚本、预训练模型下载链接，以及详细的文档（如编译指南、性能调优、常见问题）。还提供 GTP 扩展和分析引擎，方便集成到 GUI 或自定义工具中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenCL、CUDA、TensorRT 或 Eigen 进行加速，支持多平台（Windows/Linux/MacOS）。
zh.hot: KataGo 是当前最强的开源围棋 AI 之一，持续活跃的分布式训练和社区贡献使其保持热度。本周新增 50 星，总星数近 5000，位列 C++ 周榜第六。
uses: 围棋爱好者：使用 KataGo 进行棋局分析、打谱和陪练
AI 研究者：研究自对弈训练、强化学习算法，或将其应用于其他棋类游戏
开发者：集成 KataGo 到 GUI 或自定义围棋工具中，或利用其分析引擎开发应用

en.tag: Top open-source Go engine with self-play training
en.what: KataGo is a Go AI engine trained via AlphaZero-like self-play, capable of reaching top levels from scratch. It offers strong play and analysis features, supporting multiple GPU backends, making it a key tool for Go players and developers.
en.content: The repo contains full engine source code, training scripts, links to pretrained models, and extensive docs (compilation, tuning, FAQ). It also provides GTP extensions and an analysis engine for GUI integration.
en.stack: Written in C++, accelerated via OpenCL, CUDA, TensorRT, or Eigen, cross-platform (Windows/Linux/MacOS).
en.hot: KataGo remains one of the strongest open-source Go bots, with ongoing distributed training and community contributions. Gaining 50 stars this week, it ranks 6th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Go enthusiasts: use KataGo for game analysis, study, and practice
AI researchers: study self-play training and RL, or apply techniques to other games
Developers: integrate KataGo into GUIs or custom tools, or leverage its analysis engine

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台
zh.what: Wazuh是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测和响应。它保护本地、虚拟化、容器化和云环境中的工作负载，由端点安全代理和管理服务器组成，并集成Elastic Stack提供搜索和可视化。
zh.content: 仓库包含Wazuh的核心代码，包括C++编写的代理和管理服务器，以及规则集、文档和集成组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++，依赖Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch、Kibana）进行数据存储和可视化，支持多平台部署。
zh.hot: 作为开源安全平台的领先者，Wazuh提供全面的XDR和SIEM功能，star数达16k+，本周新增111，受到安全社区广泛关注。
uses: 安全运营中心（SOC）分析师：用于威胁检测和响应
IT管理员：监控日志和文件完整性，确保合规
DevOps团队：保护容器和云工作负载

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM security platform
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It protects workloads across on-premises, virtualized, containerized, and cloud-based environments, consisting of an endpoint security agent and a management server, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Wazuh, including the agent and manager written in C++, along with rulesets, documentation, and integration components.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, supports multi-platform deployment.
en.hot: As a leading open-source security platform, Wazuh offers comprehensive XDR and SIEM capabilities, with 16k+ stars and 111 new this week, gaining significant attention in the security community.
uses: SOC analysts: for threat detection and response
IT administrators: to monitor logs and file integrity for compliance
DevOps teams: to secure container and cloud workloads

zh.tag: 统一分布式存储平台，对象、块、文件三合一
zh.what: Ceph 是一个开源的分布式存储系统，提供对象存储、块存储和文件系统存储三种接口。它设计为可扩展、高可用，无单点故障，广泛用于云基础设施和企业级存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ceph 的核心源代码，包括 RADOS、RBD、RGW、CephFS 等组件，以及构建脚本、文档和测试。主要用 C++ 编写，支持多种平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Boost、gRPC、RocksDB 等库，构建系统采用 CMake 和 Ninja。
zh.hot: Ceph 是分布式存储领域的标杆项目，star 数持续增长，本周新增 31 个，进入 C++ 周榜前 20，反映了其在云原生和私有云中的持续重要性。
uses: 云平台存储后端，如 OpenStack、Kubernetes 的持久化存储
企业级统一存储，替代传统 SAN/NAS
大数据分析平台的数据存储层
开发者和研究者学习分布式系统设计

en.tag: Unified distributed storage for object, block, and file
en.what: Ceph is an open-source distributed storage system that provides object, block, and file storage interfaces. It is designed to be scalable, highly available, and without single points of failure, widely used in cloud infrastructure and enterprise storage.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Ceph, including components like RADOS, RBD, RGW, and CephFS, along with build scripts, documentation, and tests. It is primarily written in C++ and supports multiple platforms.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on Boost, gRPC, RocksDB, etc. Build system uses CMake and Ninja.
en.hot: Ceph is a benchmark project in distributed storage, with steady star growth (31 this week) and ranking #20 on the C++ trending list, reflecting its enduring importance in cloud-native and private cloud environments.
uses: Storage backend for cloud platforms like OpenStack and Kubernetes persistent storage
Enterprise unified storage replacing traditional SAN/NAS
Data storage layer for big data analytics platforms
For developers and researchers learning distributed system design

zh.tag: 开源金融终端，提供市场分析与投资研究工具
zh.what: FinceptTerminal 是一个现代金融应用，提供高级市场分析、投资研究和经济数据工具。它旨在通过用户友好的环境支持交互式探索和数据驱动的决策。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端应用源代码，基于 C++20 和 Qt6 构建，并集成 Python 3.11+ 脚本。项目采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证，提供丰富的文档和社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++20 和 Qt6 框架，辅以 Python 3.11+ 进行脚本扩展。依赖包括 Qt 库和 Python 解释器。
zh.hot: 尽管项目已宣布减少维护频率，但凭借强大的功能和活跃的用户基础，本周仍新增 631 星，总星数达 3 万，位列 C++ 周榜第 21 名。
uses: 金融分析师和投资者：用于市场数据分析和投资研究。
量化开发者：利用其数据工具进行策略回测和模型开发。
教育用途：作为学习金融应用开发和 C++/Qt 编程的参考。

en.tag: Open-source finance terminal for market analytics and investment research
en.what: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance application offering advanced market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools. It is designed for interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making in a user-friendly environment.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the terminal application, built with C++20 and Qt6, with Python 3.11+ integration. It is licensed under AGPL-3.0 and includes extensive documentation and community resources.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++20 and Qt6 framework, supplemented by Python 3.11+ for scripting. Dependencies include Qt libraries and Python interpreter.
en.hot: Despite the announcement of reduced maintenance, the project gained 631 stars this week, reaching 30k total, ranking 21st on the C++ weekly trending list, thanks to its robust features and active user base.
uses: Financial analysts and investors: for market data analysis and investment research.
Quant developers: utilize its data tools for backtesting and model development.
Educational purposes: as a reference for learning finance app development and C++/Qt programming.

zh.tag: 去中心化蓝牙+ Nostr 双协议即时通讯
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码，支持蓝牙 Mesh 多跳中继、Nostr 全球中继、地理频道、IRC 风格命令、端到端加密（Noise 协议 + NIP-17）及紧急擦除等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。
zh.hot: 凭借去中心化、无服务器、离线可用等特性，在隐私和抗审查需求高涨的当下迅速走红，24 小时内获 1720 星，总星数达 28722。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 无需手机号或账户，完全匿名通信
离线/灾难场景 —— 蓝牙 Mesh 在无网络环境下仍可通信
抗议或审查环境 —— 去中心化架构难以被封锁
技术爱好者 —— IRC 风格命令和开源代码便于探索

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — anonymous without phone or account
Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 为设计工程师打造的 AI 技能包，提升 UI 动画品味
zh.what: 这是一套面向设计工程师的 AI 技能集合，旨在帮助构建更好的用户界面。它基于作者在 Vercel 和 Linear 等公司的多年经验，列出了 AI 代理在动画和设计上常犯的细微错误，并给出修复方案。

zh.hot: 本月新增 17933 星，总星数超 2.1 万，排名 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8。它精准切中了 AI 代理在 UI 设计上的痛点，提供“品味”解决方案，受到设计工程师和 AI 开发者的追捧。

AI 代理开发者 —— 为代理注入设计专业知识，避免常见错误
前端开发者 —— 学习动画最佳实践和设计原则

en.tag: AI skill pack for design engineers to level up UI animation taste
en.what: A collection of AI skills for design engineers to build better user interfaces. Based on the author's years of experience at Vercel and Linear, it lists common subtle mistakes AI agents make in animation and design, and provides fixes.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules like emil-design-eng (animation & design advice), review-animations (strict animation review), improve-animations (audit and optimize codebase animations), each as a standalone SKILL.md file.
en.stack: Installed via npx CLI tool, requires Node.js. Skills are Markdown files that can be read and executed by AI agents.
en.hot: Gained 17,933 stars this month, total over 21k, ranked #8 on GitHub Trending monthly. It precisely addresses the pain point of AI agents' lack of design taste, offering a 'taste' solution, popular among design engineers and AI developers.
uses: Design engineers — improve taste in UI animation and design decisions
AI agent developers — inject design expertise into agents to avoid common mistakes
Frontend developers — learn animation best practices and design principles

zh.tag: AI 驱动的全球实时态势感知仪表盘
zh.what: World Monitor 是一个实时全球情报仪表盘，利用 AI 聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件和基础设施状态，提供统一的态势感知界面。它支持多个垂直领域（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等）的定制化视图。

zh.hot: 凭借 AI 驱动的实时全球情报聚合和多个垂直领域定制视图，上线后迅速获得 6.5 万+ Star，日增近 1300，登顶 GitHub 日榜。

金融投资者 —— 跟踪大宗商品、能源等市场动态
科技从业者 —— 获取科技领域新闻与趋势

en.tag: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard for situational awareness

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。

zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 在聊天里一键生成可交互系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 Agent 技能，让 AI 编程助手（如 Cursor、Claude Code 等）根据代码库或系统描述，直接在对话中生成精美的交互式技术地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种视觉预设、明暗主题和有限动画，并能在合并前对比架构快照，确保每次交互都有据可依。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和画廊，核心是生成自包含的 HTML 文件（含 PNG/SVG/WebM 导出和分享卡片）。
zh.stack: 基于 HTML/JavaScript，通过类型化 JSON IR 和确定性校验生成图表，支持 npx 安装，兼容多个 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 本月 star 新增 7074，总星数近万，说明开发者急需在 AI 工作流中直观呈现架构，而 Archify 提供了开箱即用的解决方案。
uses: 开发者用 AI 助手快速理解陌生代码库的运行时架构
架构师在代码审查前对比不同版本的架构差异
技术写作者生成可分享的交互式系统说明文档
团队在演示或培训中用可视化地图讲解系统设计

en.tag: Turn codebases into interactive system maps right in chat
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that lets AI coding assistants (like Cursor, Claude Code) generate polished, interactive technical maps directly in chat from a codebase or system description. It supports five diagram types, four visual presets, dark/light themes, and optional motion, and can compare architecture snapshots before merge, keeping every interaction grounded.
en.content: The repo contains the skill definition, docs, examples, and a gallery; the core output is a self-contained HTML file with PNG/SVG/WebM exports and share cards.
en.stack: Built on HTML/JavaScript, generates diagrams via typed JSON IR and deterministic checks; installable via npx, compatible with multiple AI agents.
en.hot: With 7,074 new stars this month and nearly 10k total, developers clearly need intuitive architecture visualization in AI workflows, and Archify delivers an out-of-the-box solution.
uses: Developers using AI assistants to quickly understand unfamiliar codebases
Architects comparing architecture changes before code review
Technical writers creating shareable interactive system docs
Teams presenting or training with visual system maps

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。

zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
