uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线
zh.what: Hugging Face 推出的开源语音代理框架，通过一条 VAD → STT → LLM → TTS 的模块化流水线，让用户能在本地或混合环境中搭建低延迟语音对话系统。它对外暴露兼容 OpenAI Realtime API 的 WebSocket 接口，任何兼容客户端都能直接接入，且每个环节均可替换为自托管或开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含可插拔的流水线引擎、OpenAI Realtime 兼容的 WebSocket 服务端、开箱即用的 CLI，以及支持多语言和 Pocket TTS 的脚本与文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，默认集成 Parakeet TDT（STT）与 Qwen3-TTS（语音合成），LLM 端支持 OpenAI API、HF Inference Providers、vLLM 及 llama.cpp 等任意兼容后端。
zh.hot: 在语音 Agent 爆发期，它以「全模块可替换 + 全本地可运行」直击开发者对隐私与可控性的痛点；本月新增 1,334 Star，总星数 6,149，冲上 Python 月榜第 10，并已实际部署在数千台 Reachy Mini 机器人上。
uses: 希望搭建本地语音助手、避免数据外泄的开发者与初创团队
需要将 LLM 快速接入语音交互、并要求兼容 OpenAI Realtime 协议的硬件/机器人厂商
关注低延迟对话系统、想自定义 VAD/STT/TTS 模块的研究者与工程师

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments. It exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API so any compatible client can connect, with every component swappable for self-hosted or open-source models.
en.content: The repo includes a pluggable pipeline engine, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket server, a ready-to-use CLI, plus scripts and docs supporting multi-language and Pocket TTS.
en.stack: Built in Python, defaulting to Parakeet TDT for STT and Qwen3-TTS for synthesis, with the LLM slot supporting any OpenAI-compatible backend including hosted APIs, HF Inference Providers, vLLM, and llama.cpp.
en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.
uses: Developers and startups building local voice assistants who need to keep data on-premise
Hardware/robotics vendors looking to add LLM-powered voice interfaces via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible protocol
Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

zh.tag: 让 AI 一键操控 Office 文档的开源命令行套件
zh.what: OfficeCLI 是专为 AI 智能体设计的 Office 办公套件，让 AI 能够通过一行代码读取、编辑和自动化生成 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件。它内置高保真 HTML 渲染引擎，可将文档转为 HTML 或 PNG，使 AI 具备可视化审阅与修正的能力。无需安装 Microsoft Office，单个二进制文件即可跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OfficeCLI 的核心源码、单一可执行二进制发布文件，以及丰富的示例资源（GIF 展示、文档模板等）和多语言 README。其核心是一个内置 HTML 渲染引擎的 C# 命令行工具，支持 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 的高保真解析与渲染。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C# 开发，以单一二进制文件形式发布，不依赖 Microsoft Office 或任何外部运行时，支持跨平台运行。内置自研 HTML 渲染引擎负责将 Office 文档转换为 HTML/PNG 供 AI 视觉闭环使用。
zh.hot: 作为首个专为 AI 智能体打造的 Office 自动化工具，它精准切中了 Agent 时代 AI 处理办公文档的刚需；凭借「一行代码 + 无需 Office」的极简体验，一周内激增 4,611 Star，总星数逼近 1.9 万，强势登上 GitHub 周榜第 10。
uses: AI 智能体开发者 —— 需要让 Agent 具备读写 Office 文档能力的工程师
自动化办公场景 —— 批量生成报告、幻灯片、数据表格的无代码/低代码工作流
RAG / 企业知识库建设者 —— 需要高精度解析 Word/Excel/PPT 内容并供 AI 理解的团队
跨平台运维人员 —— 在无 Office 环境的 Linux/服务器上处理 Office 文件

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents
en.what: OfficeCLI is an open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files through a single command. It features a built-in high-fidelity HTML rendering engine that converts documents to HTML or PNG, giving AI agents visual 'eyes' for review and correction. It runs as a single binary without requiring any Microsoft Office installation or dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains the core C# source code, single-binary releases, and rich showcase assets including GIF demos and multi-language documentation. Its centerpiece is a CLI tool with a built-in HTML rendering engine that faithfully parses and renders .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files.
en.stack: Built primarily in C# and distributed as a single, self-contained binary with zero external dependencies and no Microsoft Office installation required. It includes a custom-built HTML rendering engine that converts Office documents into HTML or PNG for AI visual feedback loops.
en.hot: As the world's first Office suite built specifically for AI agents, it directly addresses the urgent need for automated document processing in the Agent era. Its 'one-line command, zero Office install' experience fueled a surge of 4,611 stars this week, bringing the total to nearly 19,000 and landing it at #10 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers who need to equip agents with the ability to read and write Office documents
Automation workflows that batch-generate reports, presentations, and spreadsheets with minimal setup
RAG and enterprise knowledge-base builders requiring high-fidelity parsing of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Cross-platform DevOps users who need to process Office files on Linux or servers without Microsoft Office installed

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频
zh.what: 它通过 /watch 命令为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 助手赋予“观看”视频的能力。用户粘贴任意视频链接或本地路径后，它会自动下载、提取关键帧、获取时间戳字幕，并将视觉和音频信息完整交给 Claude 理解。最终让 AI 真正“看到”画面并“听到”内容，而非仅靠标题猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Python 的 /watch 插件核心源码，以及面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 余种 Agent Skills 平台的安装配置与文档。整体以命令行插件形态交付，采用零配置设计，首次运行时自动引导安装 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，使用 yt-dlp 负责视频下载，ffmpeg 处理帧提取与音视频分离，优先调用免费字幕接口，无字幕时回退至 OpenAI Whisper API。通过标准化插件协议与 Claude Code 等 Agent 环境集成。
zh.hot: 在 8992 颗 Star 的基础上本周再增 1876，跻身 GitHub Python 周榜第 15 名。它精准解决了 AI Agent 无法感知视频这一痛点，以零配置、多平台兼容和“真正看懂视频”的体验迅速获得开发者青睐。
uses: 内容创作者与营销人员：快速拆解竞品视频结构、分析热门视频开场钩子与广告创意
开发者与测试工程师：通过录屏诊断 Bug，让 AI 直接定位问题帧并分析故障原因
学习者与研究者：将长视频或课程播放列表转为可搜索的带时间戳笔记，跳过无效信息
产品经理与分析师：过滤发布会和更新视频中的营销话术，直接提取实质功能更新

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.
uses: Content creators & marketers: analyze competitor video structures, viral hooks, and ad creatives
Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

zh.tag: pi 编码代理的本地 Web 工作台
zh.what: Pi Web 是 pi 编码代理的本地 Web UI，读取本地会话文件，提供浏览器工作区，用于会话浏览、实时聊天、模型配置、技能管理和项目文件预览。它让用户可以在浏览器中查看和操作 pi 的会话，而无需依赖终端。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 Web 应用，可通过 npx 直接运行或全局安装。提供命令行选项（端口、主机名、认证等），并支持 HTTP 代理环境变量。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（要求 22.19.0+）和 TypeScript，使用标准 HTTP 服务器，无额外依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2755 星，总星数达 3797，因为 pi 编码代理本身受欢迎，而 Pi Web 提供了更友好的图形界面，降低了使用门槛。
uses: pi 代理用户：在浏览器中浏览和管理会话，无需终端。
开发者：通过图形界面配置模型、管理技能，提升编码效率。
团队协作：通过 Web 界面共享会话，便于审查和协作。

en.tag: Local web workspace for the pi coding agent
en.what: Pi Web is a local web UI for the pi coding agent. It reads local pi session files and provides a browser workspace for session browsing, real-time chat, model configuration, skill management, and project file preview. It lets users view and interact with pi sessions in the browser without relying on the terminal.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript web app that can be run via npx or installed globally. It offers CLI options (port, hostname, auth, etc.) and supports HTTP proxy environment variables.
en.stack: Built on Node.js (22.19.0+) and TypeScript, using a standard HTTP server with no extra dependencies.
en.hot: Gained 2755 stars this month, reaching 3797 total, because the pi coding agent is popular and Pi Web offers a friendlier GUI, lowering the barrier to entry.
uses: Pi agent users: browse and manage sessions in the browser without terminal.
Developers: configure models and manage skills via GUI to boost coding efficiency.
Team collaboration: share sessions via web interface for review and collaboration.

zh.tag: 个人 AI 交易代理，一条命令赋予全栈交易能力
zh.what: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人化的 AI 交易代理框架，只需一条命令即可部署具备完整市场分析、策略执行与风险管理能力的交易 Agent。它支持通过 API 和 MCP 协议与外部工具链集成，并配备 Shadow Account 模拟环境用于策略验证。项目由香港大学数据科学研究院（HKUDS）维护，提供从后端到前端的一站式解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 FastAPI 的 Python 后端、React 19 构建的可视化前端，以及支持 PyPI 一键安装的 CLI 工具。同时提供示例代码、API/MCP 接口文档和 Shadow Account 模拟交易模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 开发，后端采用 FastAPI，前端使用 React 19，通过 PyPI 包 `vibe-trading-ai` 分发。支持 API 与 MCP 协议扩展，便于接入外部数据源和交易工具。
zh.hot: 仓库已积累 24.7k Star，本周激增 5,616 并冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 4，反映出 AI Agent 与量化金融结合的巨大关注度。其「一键启动个人交易代理」的极低门槛和 HKUDS 的学术背书，持续吸引开发者与交易者涌入。
uses: 量化交易者 —— 希望用 AI Agent 自动化策略执行与风险监控。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要基于 MCP 协议扩展金融交易能力的工具链。
金融科技爱好者 —— 想通过 Shadow Account 零成本验证和迭代交易策略。
全栈开发者 —— 寻求基于 FastAPI + React 的开源交易系统参考架构。

en.tag: Personal AI trading agent empowering comprehensive capabilities with one command
en.what: Vibe-Trading is a personal AI trading agent framework that can be deployed with a single command to deliver comprehensive market analysis, strategy execution, and risk management. It supports integration with external toolchains via API and MCP protocols, and includes a Shadow Account simulation environment for strategy backtesting. Maintained by HKUDS, it provides an end-to-end solution from FastAPI backend to React frontend.
en.content: The repository includes a FastAPI-based Python backend, a React 19 visualization frontend, and a CLI tool installable via PyPI. It also ships with example code, API/MCP interface documentation, and a Shadow Account simulation module.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with a FastAPI backend and React 19 frontend, distributed via the PyPI package `vibe-trading-ai`. Supports API and MCP protocol extensions for easy integration with external data sources and trading tools.
en.hot: With 24.7k stars and a weekly surge of 5,616 to rank #4 on GitHub Trending, it reflects massive interest in the intersection of AI agents and quantitative finance. Its extremely low barrier to entry via "one command" deployment, backed by HKUDS's academic credibility, continues to attract developers and traders.
uses: Quantitative traders — looking to automate strategy execution and risk monitoring via AI agents.
AI agent developers — who need a toolchain for extending financial trading capabilities through MCP protocols.
Fintech enthusiasts — wanting to validate and iterate trading strategies at zero cost using the Shadow Account.
Full-stack developers — seeking an open-source trading system reference architecture based on FastAPI and React.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的渗透测试工具包，支持侦察、漏洞利用与验证开箱即用；同时提供 GitHub Actions 集成与 CI/CD 流水线插件，可自动扫描 Pull Request 并在代码合并前阻断不安全提交。
zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的网页爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网页爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计。它能够将网页内容转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，便于用于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 库、Docker API 服务器、Playwright 集成、异步爬虫、内存自适应调度器，以及详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持异步并发，可选 GPU 加速的 Docker 构建。
zh.hot: 凭借 77k+ 星标和日增 714 星，Crawl4AI 成为 LLM 数据准备的热门选择，其安全更新和云 API 预告进一步推动了热度。
uses: AI 开发者：为 RAG 和代理抓取网页数据
数据工程师：构建数据管道，提取结构化内容
研究者：批量爬取网页用于分析和训练

en.tag: LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper for clean Markdown
en.what: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper designed for LLMs. It converts web content into clean, structured Markdown, ready for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines.
en.content: The repository includes a full Python library, Docker API server, Playwright integration, async crawler, memory-adaptive dispatcher, and extensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Built on Python, uses Playwright for browser automation, supports async concurrency, and offers optional GPU-accelerated Docker builds.
en.hot: With 77k+ stars and +714 today, Crawl4AI is a go-to for LLM data prep, boosted by security updates and a cloud API teaser.
uses: AI developers: scrape web data for RAG and agents
Data engineers: build pipelines for structured extraction
Researchers: batch crawl for analysis and training

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。
计算机视觉研究者 —— 探索流式 3D 基础模型、几何 Transformer 与长程漂移校正的前沿方向。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.

zh.tag: 终端AI编程代理，支持代码编辑、Shell命令与网页搜索
zh.what: Kimi CLI 是一个运行在终端中的 AI 代理，帮助开发者完成软件开发任务和终端操作。它可以读写代码、执行 Shell 命令、搜索和获取网页内容，并在执行过程中自主规划和调整行动。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kimi CLI 的完整源代码、文档和示例配置。支持 Shell 命令模式、VS Code 扩展集成以及通过 Agent Client Protocol 与 IDE 集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，依赖 Kimi 大模型 API，支持 ACP 协议与 Zed、JetBrains 等 IDE 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 MoonshotAI 出品的终端 AI 代理，Kimi CLI 在 GitHub 上获得 10269 星，日增 410 星，位列日榜第 12 名。其强大的代码编辑和 Shell 命令执行能力吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：在终端中通过自然语言完成代码编辑、调试和项目构建
运维人员：使用 Shell 命令模式执行系统管理任务
AI 爱好者：体验和测试终端 AI 代理的能力与集成

en.tag: Terminal AI agent for coding, shell commands, and web search
en.what: Kimi CLI is an AI agent that runs in the terminal, assisting developers with software development tasks and terminal operations. It can read and edit code, execute shell commands, search and fetch web pages, and autonomously plan and adjust actions during execution.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, and example configurations for Kimi CLI. It supports shell command mode, VS Code extension integration, and IDE integration via the Agent Client Protocol.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on Kimi's large language model API, and supports the Agent Client Protocol for integration with IDEs like Zed and JetBrains.
en.hot: As a terminal AI agent from MoonshotAI, Kimi CLI has gained 10,269 stars on GitHub with 410 stars added today, ranking 12th on the daily trending list. Its powerful code editing and shell command execution capabilities have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers: complete code editing, debugging, and project building via natural language in the terminal
Sysadmins: execute system administration tasks using shell command mode
AI enthusiasts: experience and test the capabilities and integrations of a terminal AI agent

zh.tag: LLM 结构化输出生成引擎
zh.what: Outlines 是一个保证 LLM 输出符合预定义结构（如 JSON、XML、Pydantic 模型）的库。它在生成过程中直接约束输出，避免事后解析的脆弱性。支持多种模型后端（OpenAI、vLLM、Ollama 等），提供统一的 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、模型集成（OpenAI、vLLM、Transformers 等）、结构化输出类型（JSON、Regex、Pydantic 等）、以及示例和文档。
zh.stack: Python 为主，依赖 Pydantic、正则表达式、以及各模型后端的 SDK（如 openai、vllm）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 813 星，总星数超 1.5 万。LLM 应用开发中结构化输出是刚需，Outlines 提供优雅的解决方案，被 NVIDIA、Cohere、HuggingFace 等采用。
uses: 开发者构建需要可靠 JSON 输出的 LLM 应用（如 API 调用、数据提取）
需要跨模型切换且保持输出格式一致的项目
希望避免手动解析和验证 LLM 输出的团队

en.tag: Structured output generation engine for LLMs
en.what: Outlines is a library that guarantees LLM outputs conform to predefined structures (JSON, XML, Pydantic models, etc.). It constrains outputs during generation, avoiding fragile post-hoc parsing. Supports multiple model backends (OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama, etc.) with a unified API.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, model integrations (OpenAI, vLLM, Transformers, etc.), structured output types (JSON, Regex, Pydantic, etc.), examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depends on Pydantic, regex, and model backend SDKs (e.g., openai, vllm).
en.hot: Gained 813 stars this week, total over 15k. Structured output is a must-have in LLM app development; Outlines provides an elegant solution, adopted by NVIDIA, Cohere, HuggingFace, etc.
uses: Developers building LLM apps requiring reliable JSON output (e.g., API calls, data extraction)
Projects needing consistent output formats across different models
Teams wanting to avoid manual parsing and validation of LLM outputs

zh.tag: 代理评估与优化框架，支持并行实验与RL训练
zh.what: Harbor 是一个用于评估和优化 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、OpenHands、Codex CLI）及语言模型的框架。它支持运行任意代理、构建自定义基准、在数千个环境中并行实验，并可生成用于强化学习优化的 rollout 数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Harbor 框架的 Python 包，提供命令行工具（harbor run）、数据集管理（harbor datasets list）以及丰富的文档和 Cookbook 示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Docker 进行本地容器化运行，支持通过 Daytona、Modal、LangSmith、Blaxel 等云提供商进行大规模并行执行。
zh.hot: 由 Terminal-Bench 团队打造，作为 Terminal-Bench-2.0 的官方测试工具，本月新增近千 star，成为 AI 代理评估领域的热门选择。
uses: AI 代理开发者：评估和比较不同代理（如 Claude Code、OpenHands）的性能
研究人员：构建自定义基准，进行大规模并行实验，生成 RL 训练数据
企业团队：在云端环境中测试代理的可靠性和效率，优化模型选择

en.tag: Framework for evaluating and optimizing agents and LLMs in parallel environments
en.what: Harbor is a framework for evaluating and optimizing AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI) and language models. It supports running arbitrary agents, building custom benchmarks, running parallel experiments across thousands of environments, and generating rollouts for RL optimization.
en.content: The repo contains the Harbor Python package with CLI tools (harbor run, harbor datasets list), comprehensive docs, and a Cookbook with end-to-end examples.
en.stack: Built on Python, uses Docker for local containerized runs, and integrates with cloud providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel for large-scale parallel execution.
en.hot: Created by the Terminal-Bench team, it's the official harness for Terminal-Bench-2.0, gaining nearly 1,000 stars this month as a go-to tool for agent evaluation.
uses: AI agent developers: evaluate and compare agents like Claude Code, OpenHands
Researchers: build custom benchmarks, run large-scale parallel experiments, generate RL training data
Enterprise teams: test agent reliability and efficiency in cloud environments, optimize model selection

zh.tag: 社区驱动的文档管理系统，扫描、索引、归档
zh.what: Paperless-ngx 是一个文档管理系统，能将实体文档转换为可搜索的在线档案，帮助用户减少纸张使用。它支持自动扫描、OCR识别、分类和标签管理，让文档管理更高效。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文档管理应用代码，包括前端界面、后端API、OCR处理管道、数据库模型以及Docker部署配置。提供在线演示和详细的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，依赖 Django 框架、Celery 任务队列、Tesseract OCR 引擎、PostgreSQL 数据库等。前端采用现代 Web 技术。
zh.hot: 作为 Paperless 项目的官方继任者，社区活跃度高，拥有 43k+ 星标，今日新增 60 星，持续吸引希望数字化管理文档的用户。
uses: 个人用户：希望将纸质文档数字化，实现无纸化办公
小型企业：需要集中管理合同、发票等文档
档案管理员：需要高效归档和检索大量文档

en.tag: Community-driven document management system: scan, index, archive
en.what: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that transforms physical documents into a searchable online archive, helping users reduce paper usage. It supports automatic scanning, OCR recognition, classification, and tag management for efficient document organization.
en.content: The repository contains the full document management application code, including frontend UI, backend API, OCR processing pipeline, database models, and Docker deployment configuration. An online demo and detailed documentation are available.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, relying on Django framework, Celery task queue, Tesseract OCR engine, PostgreSQL database, etc. The frontend uses modern web technologies.
en.hot: As the official successor to the Paperless project, it has high community activity with 43k+ stars and 60 stars today, continuously attracting users seeking digital document management.
uses: Individuals: want to digitize paper documents for a paperless office
Small businesses: need to centrally manage contracts, invoices, etc.
Archivists: need efficient archiving and retrieval of large document volumes

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 高性能大模型与多模态模型推理服务框架
zh.what: SGLang 是一个专为大型语言模型和多模态模型设计的高性能推理服务框架。它通过先进的技术（如 RadixAttention、 speculative decoding 等）实现极快的推理速度和高效的资源利用，支持多种硬件（包括 GPU 和 TPU）。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎、前端 API（兼容 OpenAI）、多种解码算法（如 speculative decoding）、模型优化工具（如量化支持）以及丰富的文档和示例。还提供与主流模型（如 DeepSeek、GLM）的集成和性能优化指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、CUDA 等，支持多种后端（如 NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU）。还集成了 vLLM 等生态工具，并支持模型量化（如 NVFP4）。
zh.hot: SGLang 在 GitHub 上拥有 31.5k 星标，本月新增 1560，位列 Python 趋势榜第 21。其热度源于对最新模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、Kimi K3）的 day-0 支持，以及显著的性能提升（如 25 倍推理加速）。
uses: AI 服务提供商：需要高吞吐、低延迟的大模型推理服务，如聊天机器人、API 后端。
模型开发者：需要快速部署和测试最新开源模型，利用 day-0 支持。
研究机构：进行大规模模型推理性能优化和实验，如 speculative decoding 研究。
企业用户：在 GPU/TPU 集群上部署多模态模型，处理图像、视频生成等任务。

en.tag: High-performance serving framework for LLMs and multimodal models
en.what: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework designed for large language models and multimodal models. It achieves extremely fast inference and efficient resource utilization through advanced techniques like RadixAttention and speculative decoding, supporting various hardware including GPUs and TPUs.
en.content: The repository includes the core inference engine, frontend APIs (OpenAI-compatible), various decoding algorithms (e.g., speculative decoding), model optimization tools (e.g., quantization support), and extensive documentation and examples. It also provides integrations and performance optimization guides for mainstream models like DeepSeek and GLM.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on PyTorch, CUDA, etc., supporting multiple backends (e.g., NVIDIA GPU, Google TPU). It also integrates with ecosystem tools like vLLM and supports model quantization (e.g., NVFP4).
en.hot: SGLang has 31.5k stars on GitHub, with 1,560 added this month, ranking 21st on the Python trending list. Its popularity stems from day-0 support for the latest models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K3) and significant performance improvements (e.g., 25x inference speedup).
uses: AI service providers: needing high-throughput, low-latency LLM inference for chatbots, API backends, etc.
Model developers: wanting to quickly deploy and test the latest open models with day-0 support.
Research institutions: conducting performance optimization and experiments on large-scale model inference, e.g., speculative decoding research.
Enterprise users: deploying multimodal models on GPU/TPU clusters for image, video generation, etc.

zh.tag: 终端AI编码代理，开箱即用支持视频输入与子代理
zh.what: Kimi Code CLI 是一个运行在终端中的 AI 编码代理，能够读取和编辑代码、执行 shell 命令、搜索文件、抓取网页，并根据反馈自主决策下一步操作。它默认使用月之暗面的 Kimi 模型，也支持配置其他兼容的模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kimi Code CLI 的完整源代码、安装脚本、文档和示例。CLI 采用单二进制分发，无需 Node.js 环境，通过一条命令即可安装。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，依赖 Kimi 模型或兼容 API，终端界面基于 TUI 框架，支持 MCP 协议和插件生态系统。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1400+ Star，GitHub 周榜第 4。作为月之暗面推出的 AI 编码代理，其视频输入、子代理并行工作等创新功能吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中使用 AI 辅助编码、调试和项目理解
团队 —— 通过子代理并行处理多个任务，提升开发效率
AI 爱好者 —— 探索视频输入、MCP 配置等前沿 AI 代理功能

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with video input and subagents out of the box
en.what: Kimi Code CLI is an AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, capable of reading and editing code, running shell commands, searching files, fetching web pages, and autonomously deciding next steps based on feedback. It works out of the box with Moonshot AI's Kimi models and can be configured to use other compatible providers.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and examples for Kimi Code CLI. The CLI is distributed as a single binary, requiring no Node.js setup, and can be installed with a single command.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Kimi models or compatible APIs, terminal UI based on TUI framework, supports MCP protocol and plugin ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 1400+ stars this week, ranking 4th on GitHub weekly trending. As Moonshot AI's AI coding agent, its innovative features like video input and parallel subagents have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers — use AI to assist coding, debugging, and project understanding in the terminal
Teams — leverage subagents for parallel task processing to boost development efficiency
AI enthusiasts — explore cutting-edge AI agent features like video input and MCP configuration

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 为 Claude 等 AI 提供终端控制、文件搜索与 diff 编辑的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的服务器，它让 Claude 等 AI 客户端能够直接控制用户终端、搜索文件系统并执行基于 diff 的代码编辑。它超越了传统 AI 编辑器的局限，允许 AI 在获得授权后运行长时间命令、管理进程和自动化本地开发任务，且无需额外 API Token 成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器源码、基于 TypeScript 的终端与文件系统工具集，以及一个独立的 Desktop Commander App（Beta），后者提供可视化文件预览、Markdown 编辑器和对多模型（Claude/GPT-4.5/Gemini 等）的支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 MCP Filesystem Server 构建，通过 Model Context Protocol 与 Claude Desktop 等客户端通信，并支持 npm 分发安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手爆发式增长的背景下，该仓库凭借 8,467 Star（本周新增 1,657，冲至周榜第 5）的势头，精准解决了 AI 无法直接操作本地终端和文件系统的痛点，让开发者能用自然语言驱动完整的本地开发工作流。
uses: 开发者 —— 想通过自然语言让 AI 直接执行终端命令、批量修改代码文件
AI 工具链集成者 —— 需要在 Claude Desktop 或其他 MCP 客户端中扩展本地文件与命令行能力
追求效率的自动化用户 —— 希望在一个聊天界面中完成代码检索、编辑和进程管理的全流程

en.tag: MCP server granting Claude terminal control, file search & diff editing
en.what: DesktopCommanderMCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that grants Claude and other AI clients terminal control, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing capabilities. It goes beyond conventional AI editors by letting AI execute long-running commands, manage processes, and automate local development tasks using the host client's subscription instead of extra API tokens.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, a TypeScript-based toolkit for terminal and filesystem operations, and a standalone Desktop Commander App (Beta) with visual file previews, a Markdown editor, and support for multiple AI models.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript on top of the MCP Filesystem Server, it communicates with clients like Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: Amid the AI coding assistant boom, it has surged to 8,467 stars with 1,657 added this week (ranking 5th on GitHub Trending), precisely solving the pain point of AI being unable to directly operate local terminals and filesystems, enabling developers to drive entire local workflows via natural language.
uses: Developers who want to execute terminal commands and batch-edit code via natural language instructions
AI toolchain integrators looking to extend Claude Desktop or other MCP clients with local filesystem and shell capabilities
Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集克隆、合成与听写于一体
zh.what: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集语音克隆、文本转语音与实时语音输入于一体。它能够在本地运行 7 种 TTS 引擎，支持 23 种语言的语音合成，并通过全局热键向任意文本框听写。此外，它还能为 MCP 兼容的 AI 智能体赋予自定义语音，实现完整的语音输入输出闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 TypeScript 的桌面应用源码、7 套 TTS 引擎的本地集成、语音克隆与听写核心模块，以及配套落地页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 主技术栈为 TypeScript，构建跨平台桌面应用；依赖本地运行的 LLM 进行语音文本优化，并集成 7 种 TTS 引擎与语音克隆模型实现完整语音 I/O。
zh.hot: 在 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 等云端方案之外，Voicebox 以完全本地运行和隐私保护击中用户痛点，月增 12,138 Star 达 42,229 颗，跻身 TypeScript 月榜第 8。它一次性覆盖语音克隆、合成与听写全链路，降低了创作者与开发者对闭源语音服务的依赖。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 快速克隆音色并生成多语言旁白，无需依赖云端付费 API。
隐私敏感用户 —— 语音数据完全本地处理，适合对数据安全有较高要求的个人与企业。
AI 开发者 —— 为 MCP 智能体快速接入自定义语音，构建具备语音交互能力的本地应用。
效率办公人群 —— 通过全局热键向任意文本框实时语音输入，替代传统键盘录入。

en.tag: Local-first open-source AI voice studio for cloning, synthesis and dictation
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio that combines voice cloning, text-to-speech, and real-time dictation in one app. It runs seven TTS engines locally for speech synthesis across 23 languages, and lets you dictate into any text field via a global hotkey. It also gives MCP-aware AI agents a custom voice, closing the full voice I/O loop on your machine.
en.content: The repository contains the TypeScript-based desktop application source, integrations for seven local TTS engines, voice-cloning and dictation modules, plus a landing site and documentation.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app; it relies on a bundled local LLM for speech refinement and integrates seven TTS engines plus voice-cloning models for complete on-device voice I/O.
en.hot: Hitting a pain point against cloud incumbents like ElevenLabs and WisprFlow, Voicebox offers fully local, privacy-preserving voice I/O; it gained 12,138 stars this month to reach 42,229, ranking 8th on the TypeScript monthly trending list. Its all-in-one coverage of cloning, synthesis, and dictation lowers reliance on proprietary voice services for creators and developers.
uses: Content creators — quickly clone voices and generate multilingual narrations without cloud APIs.
Privacy-conscious users — process all voice data locally for individuals and enterprises with strict data-security needs.
AI developers — give MCP-compatible agents custom voices to build locally running voice-interactive applications.
Productivity-focused users — dictate into any text field via a global hotkey as a keyboard alternative.

zh.tag: 自托管 AI 伴侣，复刻 Neuro-sama，支持实时语音与游戏
zh.what: AIRI 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，旨在复刻虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的交互体验。它支持实时语音聊天、Minecraft 和 Factorio 等游戏互动，让用户拥有属于自己的 AI 虚拟角色。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端（Web/macOS/Windows）、服务端代码、文档和 Discord/Telegram 等社区链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 和现代 Web 技术栈，支持跨平台部署。
zh.hot: 4.4 万 Star 且日增 572，因其复刻热门虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的独特概念，结合自托管与游戏互动功能，吸引了大量 AI 和二次元爱好者。
uses: AI 爱好者 —— 自托管专属 AI 伴侣，体验实时语音互动
二次元/虚拟主播粉丝 —— 复刻 Neuro-sama，打造个性化虚拟角色
游戏玩家 —— 在 Minecraft/Factorio 中与 AI 伴侣一起游玩
开发者 —— 学习或贡献 TypeScript 全栈 AI 应用

en.tag: Self-hosted AI companion, recreating Neuro-sama, with real-time voice and game support
en.what: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion project that recreates the interactive experience of virtual streamer Neuro-sama. It supports real-time voice chat and game interactions like Minecraft and Factorio, giving users their own AI virtual character.
en.content: The repo includes full client (Web/macOS/Windows) and server code, documentation, and community links like Discord/Telegram.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Node.js and modern web tech stack, supports cross-platform deployment.
en.hot: 44k stars with 572 daily, driven by the unique concept of recreating popular virtual streamer Neuro-sama, combined with self-hosting and game interaction, attracting AI and anime fans.
uses: AI enthusiasts — self-host a personal AI companion with real-time voice
Anime/vTuber fans — recreate Neuro-sama and customize virtual characters
Gamers — play Minecraft/Factorio with an AI companion
Developers — learn or contribute to a full-stack TypeScript AI app

zh.tag: Meta 开源的设计系统，支持 AI 代理与深度定制
zh.what: Astryx 是 Meta 内部使用八年、驱动 13000+ 应用的设计系统，现已开源。它提供 150+ 无障碍组件、品牌级主题、暗色模式、模板和 CLI，支持人类和 AI 代理以相同方式构建界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心组件库 @astryxdesign/core、主题包 @astryxdesign/theme-neutral、CLI 工具、Storybook 文档、沙盒 playground 以及贡献指南。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 StyleX 构建，但消费者无需学习 StyleX，可通过 className 覆盖样式。主题使用 CSS 自定义属性实现。
zh.hot: 本月新增 10532 星，总星数 10877，位列 TypeScript 月榜第 13。Meta 背书、AI 代理友好、无样式锁定等特性引发开发者关注。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 快速构建一致、可访问的 React UI
设计系统团队 —— 参考 Meta 内部最佳实践，或直接定制主题
AI 代理开发者 —— 利用同一 API 和文档让 AI 生成 UI 组件

en.tag: Meta's open-source design system, fully customizable and agent-ready
en.what: Astryx is an open-source design system used inside Meta for eight years, powering 13,000+ apps. It offers 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, templates, and a CLI, enabling both humans and AI agents to build UIs with the same tooling.
en.content: The repo includes the core component library @astryxdesign/core, theme package @astryxdesign/theme-neutral, CLI tool, Storybook docs, sandbox playground, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Built on React and StyleX, but consumers don't need to learn StyleX; styles can be overridden via className. Theming uses CSS custom properties.
en.hot: Gained 10,532 stars this month, total 10,877, ranking #13 in TypeScript monthly. Meta's backing, AI-agent readiness, and no styling lock-in have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Frontend developers — quickly build consistent, accessible React UIs
Design system teams — reference Meta's internal best practices or customize themes directly
AI agent developers — leverage the same API and docs for AI-generated UI components

zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个运行在你机器上的 AI 求职申请框架，基于 Claude Code 构建。它可以帮助你评估职位信息、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。你只需 fork 仓库，填写个人资料，即可让 Claude 自动处理求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Claude Code 工作流，包括 /setup、/scrape、/apply 等命令，以及用于搜索丹麦求职网站（如 Jobindex、Jobnet）的技能模块。还包含吉祥物动画和详细的 README 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Claude Code 作为 AI 引擎。工作流设计为语言和国别无关，但默认的职位搜索技能针对丹麦市场。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 上迅速走红，本月新增超过 16k stars，总 stars 超过 30k。作者亲测通过该框架获得工作，证明了其实际效果，吸引了大量求职者和开发者关注。
uses: 求职者：希望自动化求职流程，节省时间并提高申请质量。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流感兴趣，想学习如何构建基于 Claude Code 的应用。
招聘人员：了解 AI 在求职中的应用，以便更好地评估候选人。

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: An AI-powered job application framework that runs on your machine, built on Claude Code. It evaluates job postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and prepares you for interviews. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude handle the job search process.
en.content: The repo contains a structured Claude Code workflow with commands like /setup, /scrape, /apply, plus skills for searching Danish job boards (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.). It also includes a mascot animation and detailed README documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, leveraging Claude Code as the AI engine. The workflow is language- and country-agnostic, but the default job portal search skills target the Danish market.
en.hot: The project went viral on GitHub Trending, gaining over 16k stars this month and 30k+ total. The author's personal success story of landing a job using the framework proves its effectiveness, attracting job seekers and developers alike.
uses: Job seekers: Automate the application process, save time, and improve application quality.
Developers: Interested in AI agent workflows, learn how to build applications on Claude Code.
Recruiters: Understand AI's role in job applications to better evaluate candidates.

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 官方检出仓库动作
zh.what: actions/checkout 是 GitHub Actions 的官方动作，用于将仓库代码检出到工作区，供工作流使用。它默认只获取触发工作流的单个提交，可通过 fetch-depth 控制历史深度。
zh.content: 仓库包含动作的源代码、文档和版本发布，主要实现为 TypeScript，支持多种输入参数如 repository、ref、token、fetch-depth 等。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 GitHub Actions 工具包（@actions/*），使用 Node.js 运行时，并迁移至 ESM 模块。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub Actions 最基础的动作之一，几乎每个工作流都会使用，本月新增 435 星，持续保持高热度。
uses: CI/CD 流水线：在构建、测试、部署前检出代码
自动化脚本：需要访问仓库文件的工作流
学习 GitHub Actions：参考官方动作的最佳实践

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to check out a repository
en.what: actions/checkout is the official GitHub Action to check out a repository into the workspace for workflows. By default, it fetches only a single commit for the triggering ref/SHA, with fetch-depth controlling history depth.
en.content: The repository contains the action's source code, documentation, and releases, implemented in TypeScript, with inputs like repository, ref, token, fetch-depth, etc.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and the GitHub Actions toolkit (@actions/*), running on Node.js, migrated to ESM modules.
en.hot: As one of the most fundamental GitHub Actions, used in nearly every workflow, it gained 435 stars this month, maintaining high popularity.
uses: CI/CD pipelines: check out code before build, test, deploy
Automation scripts: workflows needing repository files
Learning GitHub Actions: reference official action best practices

zh.tag: 代码驱动、实时更新的软件架构可视化工具
zh.what: LikeC4 是一种建模语言和工具集，用于从代码描述生成软件架构图。它受 C4 模型启发，但允许自定义符号、元素类型和嵌套层级，使架构图始终与实际代码同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LikeC4 语言规范、CLI 工具、VS Code 扩展以及示例模板。核心是 `likec4` 包，提供 `start` 命令启动本地预览服务器，并支持导出为静态站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时。前端使用 React 渲染交互式图表，支持 VS Code 和 Open VSX 扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 58 星，总星数 4019，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 12。开发者对“代码即架构”的自动化、可视化需求强烈，LikeC4 提供了比传统 UML 更灵活、更现代的替代方案。
uses: 软件架构师 —— 用代码定义并维护系统架构图，确保文档与实现一致
开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动生成架构图，用于代码审查和文档
技术写作者 —— 为开源项目或内部系统创建可交互的架构文档

en.tag: Code-driven, always up-to-date software architecture visualization
en.what: LikeC4 is a modeling language and toolset that generates software architecture diagrams from code descriptions. Inspired by the C4 model, it allows custom notation, element types, and nested levels, keeping diagrams always in sync with the actual code.
en.content: The repository includes the LikeC4 language specification, CLI tool, VS Code extension, and example templates. The core `likec4` package provides a `start` command to launch a local preview server and supports exporting to static sites.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js. The frontend uses React for interactive diagram rendering, with extensions for VS Code and Open VSX.
en.hot: Gained 58 stars today, total 4019, ranked #12 on TypeScript daily trending. Developers have a strong demand for automated, code-driven architecture visualization, and LikeC4 offers a more flexible, modern alternative to traditional UML.
uses: Software architects — define and maintain system architecture diagrams in code, ensuring docs match implementation
Development teams — auto-generate architecture diagrams in CI/CD for code reviews and documentation
Technical writers — create interactive architecture docs for open-source or internal systems

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，可创建与分享项目
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享 3D 建筑项目。它提供了丰富的编辑工具和渲染能力，支持实时协作与导出。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo 单体仓库，包含核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点（nodes）和 UI 包，以及一个 Next.js 应用。每个包有独立的 Zustand 状态管理。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 TypeScript、React Three Fiber、WebGPU、Zustand、Turborepo、Next.js。依赖 @pascal-app/core、@pascal-app/viewer、@pascal-app/editor、@pascal-app/nodes 等 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 高性能渲染和模块化架构，在开发者社区中迅速走红，今日新增 412 星，总星数达 18105，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 4。
uses: 建筑师与设计师 —— 快速创建 3D 建筑概念模型并分享
前端开发者 —— 学习 React Three Fiber 与 WebGPU 结合的最佳实践
教育场景 —— 用于建筑学教学或 3D 编程入门

en.tag: WebGPU-powered 3D building editor for creating and sharing architectural projects
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share 3D architectural projects. It offers comprehensive editing tools and rendering capabilities, supporting real-time collaboration and export.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo with packages: core (schemas, state), viewer (3D rendering), editor (tools), nodes (built-in nodes), and ui, plus a Next.js app. Each package has its own Zustand store.
en.stack: Tech stack includes TypeScript, React Three Fiber, WebGPU, Zustand, Turborepo, Next.js. Depends on npm packages like @pascal-app/core, @pascal-app/viewer, @pascal-app/editor, @pascal-app/nodes.
en.hot: With WebGPU high-performance rendering and modular architecture, it quickly gained popularity, adding 412 stars today, reaching 18,105 total, ranking #4 on TypeScript daily trending.
uses: Architects and designers — quickly create and share 3D architectural concept models
Frontend developers — learn best practices combining React Three Fiber and WebGPU
Educational settings — used for architecture teaching or introductory 3D programming

zh.tag: 开源后台编码代理，支持多模型与多人协作
zh.what: 这是一个受 Ramp 的 Inspect 启发的开源后台编码代理系统，允许你在处理其他事务时，代理在后台完成编码任务。它提供完整的开发环境（Node.js、Python、git、浏览器自动化、VS Code），并支持从 Web UI、Slack、GitHub PR、Linear 或 webhook 连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统核心代码，包括控制平面、沙箱代理、GitHub App 集成、WebSocket 通信以及多种 AI 模型适配器。支持并行子任务、定时任务和多人实时协作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js、Python、git、浏览器自动化工具（如 Puppeteer）以及 VS Code 集成。支持 Anthropic Claude、OpenAI Codex、xAI Grok 和 OpenCode Zen 等模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 547 星，总星数达 2642，因为它是少有的开源后台代理系统，借鉴了 Ramp 的 Inspect 设计，提供多模型支持和多人协作，吸引了开发者的关注。
uses: 希望自动化后台编码任务的开发者，例如处理 PR 审查、bug 修复等
需要多人实时协作编码的团队，可通过 Slack 或 Web UI 共同操作
想要集成 AI 编码代理到 CI/CD 流程的工程团队，支持定时任务和 webhook 触发
对后台代理架构感兴趣的研究者，可参考其单租户安全模型和 token 设计

en.tag: Open-source background coding agent with multi-model and multiplayer support
en.what: An open-source background coding agent system inspired by Ramp's Inspect, enabling you to delegate coding tasks to run in the background while you focus elsewhere. It provides full dev environments (Node.js, Python, git, browser automation, VS Code) and connects from anywhere via web UI, Slack, GitHub PRs, Linear, or webhooks.
en.content: The repo contains the core system code, including control plane, sandbox agents, GitHub App integration, WebSocket communication, and adapters for multiple AI models. It supports parallel sub-tasks, scheduled jobs, and real-time multiplayer collaboration.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, leveraging Node.js, Python, git, browser automation (e.g., Puppeteer), and VS Code integration. Supports models like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok, and OpenCode Zen.
en.hot: Gained 547 stars this month, reaching 2642 total, because it's a rare open-source background agent system inspired by Ramp's Inspect, offering multi-model support and multiplayer collaboration, which attracts developers.
uses: Developers wanting to automate background coding tasks like PR reviews, bug fixes, etc.
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding via Slack or Web UI.
Engineering teams integrating AI coding agents into CI/CD pipelines with scheduled jobs and webhook triggers.
Researchers interested in background agent architecture, referencing its single-tenant security model and token design.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的CAD与机器人设计技能库
zh.what: Text-to-CAD 是一个为AI代理提供CAD、机器人和硬件设计技能的库。它允许代理通过自然语言或图像生成、编辑CAD模型，并导出为STEP、STL、3MF等格式，同时支持机器人描述文件（URDF、SDF、SRDF）的生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块：CAD建模、CAD预览、标准件查找、切片、机器人描述文件生成等，每个技能都有独立的文档和实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python 3.11+，依赖CAD内核（如CadQuery）和机器人描述库，前端预览基于Web浏览器。
zh.hot: 将大语言模型与CAD/机器人设计结合，极大降低了硬件设计门槛，今日新增297星，总星数8649，登顶JavaScript日榜。
uses: AI代理开发者：为代理集成CAD和机器人设计能力
硬件工程师：通过自然语言快速生成3D模型
机器人爱好者：自动生成URDF等机器人描述文件
创客与教育：降低CAD学习曲线，快速原型设计

en.tag: A skill library for AI agents to generate CAD, robotics, and hardware designs
en.what: Text-to-CAD is a library of agent skills for CAD, robotics, and hardware design. It enables agents to generate and edit CAD models from plain language or images, export to STEP, STL, 3MF, and produce robot description files (URDF, SDF, SRDF).
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules: CAD modeling, CAD viewer, off-the-shelf parts sourcing, slicing, and robot description file generation, each with its own documentation and implementation.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python 3.11+, with CAD kernel (e.g., CadQuery) and robot description libraries; frontend preview is web-based.
en.hot: Combining LLMs with CAD and robotics design dramatically lowers the barrier to hardware design. Gained 297 stars today, total 8649, topping the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate CAD and robotics design skills into agents
Hardware engineers: quickly generate 3D models from natural language
Robotics enthusiasts: auto-generate robot description files like URDF
Makers and educators: lower CAD learning curve for rapid prototyping

zh.tag: 微软官方 Power Platform 开发插件市场
zh.what: 这是一个插件市场，为 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 提供 Power Platform 开发插件。包含可复用的技能、代理和命令，帮助开发者构建和部署 Power Platform 解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件，如 Power Pages、Model Apps、MCP Apps、Code Apps、Mobile Apps、Canvas Apps 和 Power Automate。每个插件都有独立的 README 和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot CLI。部分插件使用 React、TypeScript、Expo、.NET 等技术栈。
zh.hot: 本周新增 49 颗星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 3。作为微软官方项目，它填补了 AI 编码助手与 Power Platform 之间的空白，吸引大量低代码开发者。
uses: Power Platform 开发者 —— 使用 AI 助手快速构建和部署应用
低代码/无代码爱好者 —— 结合 Claude Code 或 Copilot 提升开发效率
企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

en.tag: Official Microsoft plugin marketplace for Power Platform development
en.what: This is a plugin marketplace providing Power Platform development plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. It includes reusable skills, agents, and commands to help developers build and deploy Power Platform solutions.
en.content: The repository contains multiple plugins such as Power Pages, Model Apps, MCP Apps, Code Apps, Mobile Apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate. Each plugin has its own README and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI. Some plugins use React, TypeScript, Expo, .NET, etc.
en.hot: Gained 49 stars this week, ranking 3rd in JavaScript weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it bridges AI coding assistants and Power Platform, attracting many low-code developers.
uses: Power Platform developers — quickly build and deploy apps using AI assistants
Low-code/no-code enthusiasts — boost development efficiency with Claude Code or Copilot
Enterprise IT teams — standardize Power Platform development workflows

zh.tag: Claude Code 的 OpenAI Codex 插件，实现代码审查与任务委托
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方为 Claude Code 开发的插件，让开发者无需离开终端环境即可调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。用户可通过斜杠命令执行只读评审、对抗性压力测试，或将编码任务后台交给 Codex 代理处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、Claude Code 市场清单配置，以及内置的 /codex:* 斜杠命令和 codex-rescue 子代理。同时提供完整安装文档与演示视频，支持通过 npm 安装 Codex CLI 并自动处理登录与会话交接。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 18.18+ 构建，作为 Claude Code 插件运行，需 OpenAI Codex CLI 及 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。通过 Claude Code 插件市场分发，并使用 npm 管理 Codex 全局安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 OpenAI 官方背书与 Claude Code 的庞大用户基础，该插件本周新增 1801 Star，以近 3 万总星标数冲入 GitHub 周榜第 12 名。它精准击中了开发者希望在同一终端内无缝切换 Claude 与 Codex 两大 AI 工作流的痛点。
uses: Claude Code 忠实用户 —— 希望在熟悉的终端工作流中直接复用 Codex 的审查与代理能力。
追求代码质量的团队 —— 需要对多文件变更进行常规审查或对抗性压力测试，发现潜在设计缺陷。
高频使用 AI 辅助编程的开发者 —— 想将耗时任务后台委托给 Codex，通过异步状态查询和结果拉取保持专注。
多 AI 工具链整合者 —— 试图打通 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 生态，构建统一的命令行 AI 开发环境。

en.tag: Claude Code plugin integrating OpenAI Codex for code review and task delegation
en.what: An official OpenAI plugin that embeds Codex capabilities directly into Claude Code, letting developers review and delegate coding tasks without leaving their terminal. It exposes slash commands for read-only reviews, adversarial pressure-testing, and background task delegation to Codex agents.
en.content: The repo hosts the plugin source, Claude Code marketplace manifest, and built-in slash commands such as /codex:review plus the codex-rescue subagent. It also includes comprehensive installation docs and a demo video, supporting npm-based Codex CLI setup and automated session hand-off.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript for Node.js 18.18+, it runs as a Claude Code plugin and requires the OpenAI Codex CLI along with a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key. It is distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace and uses npm for global Codex CLI installation.
en.hot: Backed by OpenAI and Claude Code's large user base, the plugin gained 1,801 stars this week and reached #12 on GitHub Trending with nearly 29k total stars. It directly addresses developer demand for seamlessly switching between Claude and Codex within a single terminal workflow.
uses: Claude Code power users who want to leverage Codex review and agent capabilities inside their existing terminal workflow.
Teams focused on code quality looking to run standard or adversarial reviews on multi-file changes to uncover design flaws.
Developers heavily using AI-assisted coding who want to delegate long-running tasks to Codex in the background and check results asynchronously.
Multi-AI toolchain integrators aiming to bridge Anthropic and OpenAI ecosystems within a unified CLI environment.

zh.tag: 用 Claude 操控 TradingView 图表的 AI 助手桥
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议将 Claude Code 连接到本地运行的 TradingView 桌面应用，实现 AI 辅助的图表分析、Pine Script 开发和流程自动化。所有数据处理均在本地完成，不传输外部。
zh.content: 包含 MCP 服务器实现、CDP 通信模块、Pine Script 辅助工具和示例配置。提供工具让 LLM 读取图表状态、执行脚本并获取反馈。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js，使用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 与 Electron 应用通信，MCP 协议与 Claude Code 集成。
zh.hot: 将 LLM 代理与专业交易工具结合，满足交易者自动化分析需求，4543 Stars 日增 28，登顶 JavaScript 日榜第 3。
uses: 交易者：用自然语言分析图表、编写 Pine Script 策略
开发者：研究 LLM 代理与桌面金融应用的交互模式
量化研究员：自动化回测与指标提取

en.tag: AI bridge connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop for chart analysis & automation
en.what: An MCP server that connects Claude Code to your locally running TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling AI-assisted chart analysis, Pine Script development, and workflow automation. All data processing stays local.
en.content: Includes MCP server implementation, CDP communication module, Pine Script helpers, and example configs. Provides tools for LLM to read chart state, execute scripts, and get feedback.
en.stack: Node.js-based, uses Chrome DevTools Protocol to communicate with Electron apps, integrates with Claude Code via MCP protocol.
en.hot: Combines LLM agents with professional trading tools, meeting traders' automation needs. 4543 stars (+28/day), #3 on JavaScript daily trending.
uses: Traders: analyze charts and write Pine Script strategies via natural language
Developers: study LLM agent interaction with desktop financial apps
Quant researchers: automate backtesting and indicator extraction

zh.tag: 跨平台隐私优先语音转文字工具，支持本地与云端模型
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的桌面端语音听写应用，用户可通过全局热键在任何软件中将语音实时转为文字。它支持完全离线的本地转录（Whisper / NVIDIA Parakeet），也允许接入自有密钥的云模型，确保音频数据不出本地即可隐私可控地完成输入。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的跨平台桌面客户端源码与构建产物，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 的全局热键、语音听写、会议转录、AI 笔记及 Agent 功能模块，并附带安装包、API 文档与官网。
zh.stack: 项目以 JavaScript 为主语言开发，基于 Electron 或同类跨平台桌面框架，前端采用现代 Web 技术栈，后端通过本地绑定集成 Whisper 与 NVIDIA Parakeet，并提供 REST API 以对接第三方云服务。
zh.hot: 在 WisprFlow、Granola 等付费语音转写工具备受关注的背景下，OpenWhispr 以“完全开源、零数据收集”的隐私定位成为热门替代方案，本月新增 802 Star，累计达 4,617 Star，跻身 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 10 名。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的写作者与开发者——通过全局热键在任意编辑器中快速 dictation。
对隐私敏感的用户与团队——利用本地模型实现完全离线的会议转录与笔记生成。
寻求免费替代方案的知识工作者——以开源方案替换 WisprFlow/Granola 进行日常语音记录。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation with local & cloud models
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source desktop dictation app that turns speech into text anywhere via a global hotkey. It offers fully offline transcription with local engines like Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing via BYOK, keeping user audio data private and under their own control.
en.content: The repository includes the full cross-platform desktop client source and release builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, featuring global hotkey handling, voice dictation, meeting transcription, AI note-taking, and agent modules, plus API docs and a website.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and built on a cross-platform desktop framework (likely Electron or Tauri) with a modern web-based UI, it binds locally to Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet for on-device inference and exposes REST APIs for optional cloud integration.
en.hot: Positioned as a free, open-source and zero-telemetry alternative to paid tools like WisprFlow and Granola, OpenWhispr gained strong traction this month with 802 new stars, reaching 4,617 total stars and ranking #10 on GitHub’s JavaScript monthly trending chart.
uses: Writers and developers needing efficient voice input — dictate into any editor via a global hotkey.
Privacy-conscious users and teams — run fully offline meeting transcription and note-taking with local models.
Knowledge workers seeking free alternatives — replace paid tools like WisprFlow or Granola for daily voice logging.

zh.tag: 非官方 ChatGPT Linux 桌面端，从 macOS 官方包提取并本地构建
zh.what: 该项目将 OpenAI 官方仅提供 macOS 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 Chat、Work、Codex）转换为可在 Linux 运行的 Electron 应用。它通过提取上游 DMG 文件、应用 Linux 兼容性补丁并重建原生模块，最终打包成多种 Linux 发行版支持的安装格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含从 macOS DMG 提取、打补丁、构建原生模块的完整脚本，以及用于 Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 和 Nix 的安装包配置；可选的 Linux 专属功能存放在 `linux-features/` 目录，同时提供 AppImage 自构建和本地更新管理器支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 与 JavaScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时；构建系统使用 Makefile 驱动，通过 CI 工作流自动化打包 .deb、.rpm、pacman 及 AppImage，并支持 Wayland 与 X11 显示协议。
zh.hot: OpenAI 迟迟未推出官方 Linux 客户端，该项目填补了空白；本周新增 395 Star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 5，反映出 Linux 开发者对原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验的强烈需求。
uses: Linux 开发者/用户 —— 想在 Debian、Fedora、Arch 等发行版上获得原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验
AI 重度使用者 —— 需要本地安装 Chat、Work 和 Codex 功能，而非仅使用网页版
偏好桌面端工作流的用户 —— 希望利用系统级快捷键、本地集成和离线更新管理
开源社区贡献者 —— 参与非官方 Linux 适配、Electron 跨平台补丁与打包流程改进

en.tag: Unofficial ChatGPT Desktop for Linux, extracted & rebuilt from official macOS DMG
en.what: This project converts OpenAI's official macOS-only ChatGPT Desktop app (including Chat, Work, and Codex) into a runnable Linux Electron application. It extracts the upstream DMG, applies Linux compatibility patches, rebuilds native modules, and packages the result for various Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains complete scripts for extracting the macOS DMG, applying patches, and rebuilding native modules, alongside packaging configs for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and Nix. Optional Linux-only integrations live in `linux-features/`, with support for AppImage self-builds and a local update manager.
en.stack: Built with Electron and JavaScript, requiring Node.js; the build system is driven by Makefiles and CI workflows that automate packaging into .deb, .rpm, pacman, and AppImage formats, with support for both Wayland and X11.
en.hot: With no official Linux client from OpenAI, this project fills a critical gap; it gained 395 stars this week and hit #5 on the JavaScript Trending list, reflecting strong demand from Linux users for a native ChatGPT desktop experience.
uses: Linux developers/users seeking a native ChatGPT desktop experience on Debian, Fedora, Arch, and other distros.
Power users who need local access to Chat, Work, and Codex features instead of relying solely on the web app.
Desktop-centric workflow users wanting system-level shortcuts, local integrations, and an offline update manager.
Open-source contributors interested in unofficial Linux ports, Electron cross-platform patching, and packaging improvements.

zh.tag: 全球主流AI系统提示词泄露收录与透明度研究
zh.what: 持续抓取并归档 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 的系统提示词（system prompts），揭示模型在接收用户消息前的隐藏指令与行为规则。项目被《华盛顿邮报》等权威媒体引用，成为 AI 透明度研究的重要信源。
zh.content: 按厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等）分目录存放各产品的完整系统提示词文本，涵盖常规对话、编程助手（Claude Code、Copilot）、深度研究（Perplexity）等多场景版本。
zh.stack: 以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以简单的 JavaScript 脚本和 GitHub Actions 自动化更新，无需复杂后端依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 3,000 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 3，反映出行业与公众对 AI 黑箱指令的极强好奇心；模型版本快速迭代也让提示词考古成为开发者刚需。
uses: AI 研究者与媒体 —— 分析不同厂商的系统级安全策略与价值观对齐方式
提示词工程师与开发者 —— 逆向学习顶级产品的指令工程技巧以优化自身应用
关注 AI 伦理的公众 —— 了解聊天机器人在对话前的隐藏规则与行为边界

en.tag: Leaked system prompts archive for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more
en.what: This repository systematically collects and archives leaked system prompts from leading AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, exposing the hidden instructions and behavioral rules they receive before processing user messages. Cited by major outlets like The Washington Post, it serves as a key resource for AI transparency research.
en.content: Organized by vendor (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, etc.), the repo stores verbatim system prompt texts across products and scenarios, including general chat, coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot), and deep research modes (Perplexity).
en.stack: Primarily Markdown documentation with lightweight JavaScript utilities and GitHub Actions for automated updates, requiring no complex backend dependencies.
en.hot: Surging with nearly 3,000 new stars this month to hit #3 on GitHub Trending, it reflects intense curiosity about AI black box instructions; rapid model iteration has also made prompt archaeology essential for developers.
uses: AI researchers and journalists — analyze system-level safety policies and value alignment across vendors
Prompt engineers and developers — reverse-engineer instruction-engineering techniques from top products to optimize their own apps
AI-ethics-minded public — understand the hidden rules and behavioral boundaries chatbots follow before responding

zh.tag: Nuclei 引擎的社区漏洞检测模板库

zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器核心实现，包括世界加载、区块生成、玩家管理、实体 AI、红石、插件系统等模块，目前处于积极开发中。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust，利用多线程和零成本抽象实现高性能；依赖 tokio 异步运行时和自定义网络协议实现。
zh.hot: Rust 语言的高性能和安全性吸引了大量 Minecraft 社区关注，今日新增 108 星，总星数 8415，位列 GitHub 日榜第 18 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 希望部署高性能、低资源占用的服务端
Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.
en.stack: Tech stack is Rust, leveraging multi-threading and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; relies on tokio async runtime and custom network protocol implementation.
en.hot: The high performance and safety of Rust attract massive attention from the Minecraft community, with 108 stars added today and 8415 total, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Minecraft server admins — seeking high-performance, low-resource server software
Rust developers — learning Rust in game server development
Minecraft mod/plugin developers — extending functionality via its plugin system

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
